raw.description:
About ConnectPrep: Our goal is to redefine “tutoring” – to use data, insight, and our extensive teaching experience find solutions for our students. ConnectPrep is about connecting – connecting students, parents, educators, and the community. We have bold ideas and an eye towards the future.

The Opportunity: We are offering a Data Analyst Internship for qualified candidates. This is a cross-disciplinary role, both instructional and technical. You’ll engage with our team of educators to validate and iterate the models that drive our analytics. Our Data Analysts develop an understanding of our algorithms, the technologies and platforms that support our products, and our proprietary educational content. This knowledge will then be synthesized into actionable tests to build modules that will assist in identifying the academic needs of each individual student. You will engage with team members that think outside of the box, with the goal of improving education through the creation of a data infrastructure and insightful analytics.

Requirements

What we are looking for:

  • Core skills
  • You enjoy creative problem solving and working with messy, real-world data.
  • You have strong math/quantitative skills and excellent attention to detail.
  • You are curious about how data can improve learning and student outcomes.
  • Academic & technical background
    • You are studying (or have studied) Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field.
    • You have some coding experience and a strong interest in technology and AI.
    • You have experience with at least one of the following:
    • SQL, Python data tools (Pandas, NumPy, or similar)
    • Building simple data pipelines or analysis scripts in Python
  • Excel & analysis skills
  • You are comfortable doing serious work in Excel, including several of the following:
  • Advanced formulas and functions
  • Tables and formatting
  • Conditional formatting
  • Advanced charting and visualizations
  • Pivot tables and pivot reporting
  • Using Excel productively for analysis, not just basic spreadsheets
  • Data tables, simulations, and Solver
  • (Bonus) VBA and macros
  • AI, data, and analytics work you will support
  • Work with AI tools and workflows to support data-driven decision-making
  • Perform data mining and cleaning from multiple sources (web, internal trackers, marketing platforms)
  • Support projects involving AI and chatbot development for ConnectPrep’s programs and website
  • Conduct SEO and keyword research to identify growth opportunities and track performance
  • Analyze website analytics (traffic, engagement, conversions) and prepare simple dashboards or summary reports
  • Assist with data analysis for marketing campaigns, content performance, and business operations
  • Help test, document, and iterate on new data and AI workflows as they are developed
  • Nice to have
  • Prior internship or project experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or marketing analytics
  • Familiarity with web analytics and marketing tools (for example, Google Analytics, GA4, Search Console, Looker Studio, or similar platforms)
  • Experience visualizing data in tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Data Studio
  • Experience working with SEO tools or keyword platforms
  • Experience collaborating in remote or hybrid teams (Slack, Zoom, project management boards)

Benefits

Why join ConnectPrep?

  • Get in on the ground floor of an exciting new company, with the potential to help shape our direction
  • Be involved with a team that has bold ideas, with the goal of reinventing education across the globe
  • Gain valuable experience, meet technology innovators, and learn about the business side of our company

Sound Interesting?

Please submit your resume and letter of interest at .

All applicants must be a U.S. Citizen or National of the U.S., an alien lawfully admitted for permanent residence, or an alien authorized to work in the U.S. for this employer. ConnectPrep is an equal opportunity employer EEO/M/F/D/V.

Who we are:

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit to learn more.

About the Role:

As a Senior Solutions Engineer on our Enterprise team, you’ll play a key role in driving successful outcomes for Motive’s Enterprise customers. You’ll partner closely with Account Executives to shape deal strategy, showcase the value of our platform, and act as a trusted advisor to technical and business stakeholders. This role requires a balance of technical expertise, business acumen, and strong communication skills, as you map customer challenges to Motive’s solutions and influence buying decisions. Reporting directly to an Enterprise Solutions Engineering leader, you’ll collaborate across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to ensure customer needs are met while driving Motive’s growth and strategic success.

What You'll Do:

  • Partner with Enterprise Account Executives to shape deal strategy, drive discovery conversations, and deliver high-impact demonstrations that influence executive-level decisions
  • Showcase Motive’s value by tailoring demos that resonate across technical, operational, and business audiences — positioning yourself as a trusted advisor to customers
  • Translate complex customer challenges into clear, compelling solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes
  • Develop deep expertise in the competitive landscape, playing a key role in winning strategic displacement opportunities
  • Establish yourself as a product authority — mastering today’s platform while shaping conversations around future innovations
  • Collaborate on RFIs and RFPs to position Motive as the partner of choice for Enterprise organizations
  • Act as a visible connector between Sales and cross-functional teams (Product, Engineering, Customer Success, Marketing), ensuring customer insights fuel continuous improvement and innovation

What We're Looking For:

  • 5+ years of experience supporting Enterprise-level sales in a pre-sales or solutions engineering role (SaaS and hardware experience a plus)
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred; advanced degree a plus
  • Experience in a customer-facing pre-sales field role with the flexibility and willingness to travel 30%+
  • Deep knowledge of value-based selling frameworks and methodologies (e.g., MEDDIC, MEDDPICC, Command of the Message) and solutions engineering methodologies (e.g., Demo2Win, Great Demo!, or comparable)
  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence technical and executive audiences
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with a solutions-oriented mindset
  • Demonstrated success supporting complex solution sales within Enterprise organizations
  • Hands-on experience with Enterprise sales cycles and navigating multiple stakeholders
  • Experience with APIs, integrations, and technical solution design

Pay Transparency

Your compensation may be based on several factors, including education, work experience, and certifications. For certain roles, total compensation may include restricted stock units (RSUs). Motive offers benefits including health, pharmacy, optical and dental care benefits, paid time off, sick time off, short term and long term disability coverage, life insurance as well as 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). Learn more about our benefits by visitingMotive Perks & Benefits.

The compensation range for this position will depend on where you reside. For this role, the on-target earnings (base pay + commissions) are:

Canada
$180,000—$230,000 USD

Creating a diverse and inclusive workplace is one of Motive's core values. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives.

Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 115,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

  • Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
  • Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year.
  • An excellent retirement savings plan with high employer contribution.
  • Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree.
  • A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.

The Opportunity

In Abbott’s Electrophysiology (EP) business, we’re advancing the treatment of heart disease through breakthrough medical technologies in atrial fibrillation, allowing people to restore their health and get on with their lives.

What You’ll Work On

We are seeking an experienced high caliber Sales Representative/Territory Manager, EP. The Sales Rep calls on physicians and hospitals to sell a variety of Abbott's medical devices in an assigned territory. May conduct marketing surveys, effectiveness reviews of calls/sales activities, and territory analysis. Services accounts and suggests and presents new products. Employees act on their strong desire to make a difference, partner with others and put ideas into action. Employees are engaged by a work culture that is team-oriented, fast paced and progressive. Provides medical professionals with information and training on the use of Company products and with staff education, in-services and technical troubleshooting. Analyses sales statistics; prepares reports; and performs required administrative sales duties, e.g., filing expense account reports, scheduling appointments, and making travel plans. May attend trade shows where new products and technologies are showcased and conferences to meet other sales representatives and clients and discuss new product developments.

  • Experience leading a team of clinicals
  • A demonstrated ability to analyze and evaluate technologically complex devices; ability to work with and direct others effectively; ability to prepare and present strong written and verbal communications; and familiarity with medical device industry policies, operations and procedures

  • Responsible for selling EP disposables, capital equipment, and service/warranty
  • Ability to establish and maintain good working relationships with customers, physicians, hospital administrators, government agencies, medical groups, and other sales representatives
  • Demonstrated verbal and written communication, negotiation, sales, interpersonal and presentation skills
  • Demonstrated working knowledge of frequently used personal computer programs and relevant applications

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant technical field or equivalent and typically five plus years of progressively more responsible sales experience, including experience with cardiovascular medical devices.
  • Verification that you will satisfy all vendor credentialing requirements, which may include vaccination for COVID-19. If you require a medical or religious accommodation from these requirements or if you would like to understand more about these requirements, please advise HR so that we can provide additional information and if needed, we can explore any needed accommodation(s).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Cardiac Electrophysiology mapping/sales a plus

raw.description:
Sr. Director II – Media Agencies, Client Sales & Insights / L19

Let’s be unstoppable together!

Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behavior, and drive growth—powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high-quality data set.

At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives.  We’re a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work.  Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana.

Learn more at

Our Critical Sales Skills

At the heart of our commercial success is a team of professionals who combine strategic insight, customer-centricity, and executional excellence. These skills represent the core capabilities required to drive value for our clients and sustainable growth for our business.

  • Effectively Presents Solutions: Delivers tailored, compelling solutions that align with customer needs and drive action.
  • Knows the Buying Influences: Identifies key decision-makers and understands their motivations and influence.
  • Manages Buyer Indifference: Recognizes and explores customer hesitation to uncover new needs or opportunities.
  • Understands Customer Needs: Operates as a recognized expert to articulate customer needs in the customer's business language and business context.
  • Being Resilient: Bounces back from setbacks with composure and positivity; helps others stay productive during tough times.
  • Manages Ambiguity: Stays focused and calm in uncertain situations; guides others through change.

What will you be doing?

Reporting to the Senior Vice President (SVP) Agency partnerships, you will be the Client Sales & Insights leader for the Media Vertical with specific focus on our large and growing Agency & Walled Garden clients. You will be responsible for strategic planning, executive alignment, revenue generation and client success, serving as the subject matter expert and key decision maker for the Market Measurement and CSIA business within the Media Vertical.

Job Responsibilities

Commercial Growth & Business Leadership

  • Own and grow revenue for Circana's Market Measurement and CSIA solutions across the Media Vertical, with primary focus on Advertising Agency Holding Companies and Walled Garden partners.
  • Develop and execute strategies that expand existing client relationships and drive new business opportunities for these solutions.
  • Identify emerging market trends, competitive dynamics, and client needs to inform commercial strategy and growth priorities.

Product Market Fit & Solution Strategy

  • Lead the optimization of product-market fit for Agency and Walled Garden clients by identifying, prioritizing, and documenting key client use cases and business requirements.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Analytics, and Commercial teams to ensure Circana solutions address high-value client needs and deliver measurable business outcomes.
  • Influence solution packaging, pricing, and go-to-market strategies to maximize client value and commercial performance.

Client Success & Executive Relationship Management

  • Drive customer success, retention, and growth by increasing client adoption, engagement, and utilization of Circana solutions.
  • Build and maintain trusted advisor relationships with senior client stakeholders and decision-makers, fostering strategic partnerships and identifying opportunities for innovation and expansion.
  • Ensure the consistent delivery of exceptional client experiences through effective coordination and alignment of internal stakeholders and resources.
  • Lead executive business reviews and strategic planning discussions that demonstrate value, strengthen partnerships, and support long-term growth objectives.

Strategic Planning & Operational Excellence

  • Own the strategic planning, execution, and performance management for Market Measurement & CSIA solutions at Agencies and Walled Gardens.
  • Develop annual plans, account strategies, and revenue targets that align with organizational objectives.
  • Lead quarterly business reviews, revenue forecasting, and performance assessments to ensure achievement of growth and profitability goals.
  • Maintain accountability for pipeline health, forecast accuracy, CRM integrity, and sales process excellence.
  • Drive alignment across Commercial, Finance, Product, Technology, and other cross-functional partners to achieve business objectives and resolve complex challenges.

Leadership & Team Development

  • As the business grows, build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of Customer Intelligence Managers, creating a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning.
  • Provide coaching, mentorship, and performance leadership to ensure team capability scales with business growth and evolving client needs.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Enterprise Influence

  • Partner closely with Commercial leaders, Customer Success, Product, Analytics, and Support teams to deliver integrated client solutions and drive business outcomes.
  • Integrate and align with Circana’s best practices & ways-of-working across the broader Circana CI organization.
  • Integrate and champion Circana's best practices, operating models, and ways of working across the Media business.
  • Influence enterprise priorities and strategic initiatives by serving as the voice of Agency and Walled Garden clients across the organization.

Thought Leadership & Subject Matter Expertise

  • Serve as the senior business leader and subject matter expert for Market Measurement and CSIA solutions within the Media Vertical.
  • Represent Circana with key industry stakeholders, clients, and partners, providing thought leadership on business intelligence, and industry innovation.
  • Drive strategic decision-making and innovation initiatives that strengthen Circana's market position and create long-term value for clients and the organization.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of experience in Market Measurement, Media Analytics, Customer Insights, or related data and analytics solutions.
  • 3+ years of experience leading revenue growth, retention, and strategic client relationships for enterprise accounts.
  • Strong knowledge of advertising agencies, media platforms, and the digital advertising ecosystem.
  • Demonstrated success driving renewals, revenue growth, client adoption, customer satisfaction, and new business opportunities.
  • Proven ability to translate client needs into scalable solutions by partnering across Commercial, Product, Analytics, and Customer Success teams.
  • Experience developing strategic business plans, account plans, forecasts, and budgets to achieve growth objectives.
  • Ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive cross-functional alignment on business priorities and client outcomes.
  • Experience leading, coaching, and developing high-performing teams in a growth-oriented environment.
  • Strong business acumen, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills with the ability to engage executive-level stakeholders.
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented leader with a growth mindset, strong attention to detail, and a commitment to continuous improvement.

Circana Behaviors

As well as the technical skills, experience and attributes that are required for the role, our shared behaviors sit at the core of our organization. Therefore, we always look for people who can continuously champion these behaviors throughout the business within their day-to-day role:

  • Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions.
  • Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action.
  • Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices.
  • Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers.
  • Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement.
  • Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity.
  • Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone.

Location:This position can be located in the following area(s): Remote

Prospective candidates may be asked to consent to background checks (in accordance with local legislation and ourcandidate privacy notice)Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission.

The below range reflects the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue-based metrics, any collective bargaining agreements, and business or organizational needs. The salary range for this role is $138K to $179K.

This job is also eligible for bonus pay.

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.

An offer of employment may be conditional upon successful completion of a background check in accordance with local legislation and our candidate privacy notice. Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission.

You can apply for this role through the Circana careers website or Intranet site for internal candidates. This role is subject to AI-assisted screening. Circana uses artificial intelligence (AI) to assess resumes for alignment with job requirements by helping locate details in resumes that relate to the job description.

This position is expected to remain open for approximately 30 days and may close earlier if sufficient qualified candidates are identified.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

Internship Term: Spring 2027

Compensation: College credit [MUST be enrolled in college course]

Desired Fields of Study: Digital Marketing, Advertising, Analytics

  • Strong interest in a career that blends creativity and analytics
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills

  • Must have a passion for storytelling
  • Must be enrolled in a course at a college or university and receiving credit for their participation in this internship program

Benefits & Perks:

  • Monthly & quarterly team bonding activities
  • Fun, savvy, and hard-working team(s)
  • Full-remote flexibility

Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. 📋 Tâches et responsabilités

FR

Ingénieur systèmes en cybersécurité SIEM

Vous rejoignez l'équipe projet chargée d'intégrer une solution SIEM / Log Analytics pour le Security Operations Center (SOC) et l'équipe SecOps. En collaboration avec l'architecte et le Project Manager, vous accompagnez l'onboarding des logs et apportez les adaptations nécessaires aux outils SIEM / Log Analytics.

La mission porte sur la mise en œuvre et l'administration de l'environnement Elastic, notamment Elasticsearch, Kibana, Logstash et Kafka. Vous gérez les applications Elasticsearch et Kibana, réalisez les changements nécessaires après concertation, concevez des tableaux de bord et des rapports selon les besoins définis, et veillez à la documentation associée.

Délivrables

  • Infrastructure Log Analytics et environnement Elasticsearch
  • Connexion de la liste prévue de systèmes et d'applications
  • Rapports et tableaux de bord

Type de responsabilités

  • Concevoir, administrer, configurer et optimiser la plateforme Elastic Security (SIEM) pour la collecte et la corrélation des événements de sécurité.
  • Construire et maintenir, avec l'équipe, des solutions de sécurité basées sur Elastic.
  • Intégrer des flux de threat intelligence dans le SIEM afin de soutenir une détection proactive.
  • Réaliser les mises à niveau de la plateforme SIEM et en garantir la fiabilité ainsi que la scalabilité.
  • Surveiller les logs, alertes et rapports de sécurité pour détecter les anomalies et problèmes potentiels, y compris dans des environnements cloud.
  • Utiliser Elasticsearch pour l'indexation, la recherche et l'analyse de données liées à la sécurité.

📝 Votre profil

Compétences

  • Expérience confirmée comme Security Engineer ou System Engineer orienté cybersécurité, avec un focus sur le SIEM et la stack Elastic, notamment Kibana, Logstash, Kafka et Elasticsearch.
  • Maîtrise d'Elasticsearch, y compris l'indexation, les requêtes et la visualisation de données.
  • Bonne pratique du scripting d'API et de langages tels que Python ou ES/QL pour l'automatisation et le développement d'outils spécifiques.
  • Expérience solide de l'intégration de logs dans des environnements cloud comme AWS et Azure.
  • Bonne connaissance de Linux, ainsi que d'environnements Windows.
  • Capacité à analyser et résoudre des incidents dans des contextes exigeants.
  • Aisance rédactionnelle et orale pour documenter les solutions et communiquer des sujets de sécurité de manière claire.
  • Expérience avec des environnements cloud native, notamment Kubernetes.
  • Connaissance des cadres et normes de cybersécurité tels que SOC2 et ISO 27001.
  • Expérience avec EDR, outils SIEM, gestion des logs, détection d'intrusion, sécurité réseau et passerelles de messagerie.
  • Approche rigoureuse, proactive et orientée service.

Connaissances

  • Elasticsearch, Kibana, Logstash, Kafka
  • ES/QL
  • Dashboards
  • Module APM d'Elastic
  • Module SIEM d'Elastic
  • Elastic Agent (équivalents FileBeat, LogBeats, WinBeats, Syslog, ...)

NL

System Engineer Cyber Security SIEM

Je sluit aan bij het projectteam dat de integratie van een SIEM/Log Analytics-oplossing verzorgt voor het Security Operations Center (SOC) en het SecOps-team. Samen met de architect en de Project Manager ondersteun je de onboarding van logdata en voer je de nodige aanpassingen uit in de SIEM/Log Analytics-tools.

De opdracht focust op de implementatie en het beheer van de Elastic-omgeving, meer bepaald Elasticsearch, Kibana, Logstash en Kafka. Je beheert Elasticsearch- en Kibana-applicaties, voert wijzigingen uit na overleg, ontwerpt dashboards en rapportering op basis van de vooraf bepaalde noden en zorgt voor de nodige documentatie.

Vaardigheden

raw.description:
Releaf is the UK's leading medical cannabis clinic. A certified B Corp, with over 170 staff, we connect patients with specialist clinicians, streamline access to prescriptions, and support thousands of people across the UK. We're on a mission to rethink healthcare - making specialist medical care more accessible, more human, and more effective.

This is an exciting moment to join Releaf. We have strong product-market fit, a growing patient base, and ambitious international plans. We're now looking for a Head of CRM to own the full post-acquisition patient journey - keeping patients engaged, on treatment, and deriving real value from everything Releaf has to offer.

The role

You'll report directly to the Marketing Director and lead a team of 5. You'll own Releaf's retention strategy end-to-end, from subscription and loyalty mechanics through to how we communicate and market the products and benefits that keep patients with us long-term.

This is a strategic role with real commercial weight. You'll need to think clearly about patient lifetime value, move fast on opportunities, and build deep cross-functional relationships across Marketing, Clinical, Operations, and Patient Support.

Main Responsibilities

Retention Strategy

  • Own Releaf's retention strategy, setting clear goals across patient activation, engagement, subscription growth, and churn reduction
  • Lead the ongoing development of Releaf+ - our subscription model - ensuring it delivers genuine value to patients and performs commercially
  • Develop and manage loyalty mechanics, refer-a-friend programmes, and other retention incentives that drive long-term patient engagement
  • Work alongside the Brand Team to market and communicate Releaf's retention products - including the Releaf medical cannabis card, Releaf Protect, and free legal support for Releaf+ patients - ensuring patients understand and use what's available to them
  • Build proactive intervention programmes that identify early signs of patient drop-off and act on them before churn happens

CRM & Communications

  • Work closely with the CRM & Lifecycle Lead to develop and execute a patient communications strategy across the full lifecycle - from onboarding through to long-term retention
  • Ensure CRM activity is data-led, well-segmented, and aligned to retention goals
  • Own the feedback loop between patient communications and operational reality - medication changes, formulary updates, patient support changes - ensuring comms reflect what's actually happening across the business

CRO

  • Work in lockstep with the CRO & Experimentation Lead and the CRO and UX Designers. to ensure the pre-payment and post-login patient experiences are continuously tested, optimised, and improving
  • Connect CRO activity to retention outcomes - what happens on the dashboard should be as informed by retention data as it is by UX insight

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Build strong working relationships with Clinical, Dev, Operations, and Patient Support teams to stay close to changes that affect the patient experience
  • Act as the commercial bridge between operational change and patient-facing communications - when something changes inside the business, you make sure it's reflected in how we communicate and retain patients
  • Work closely with the Head of Performance Marketing to ensure a clean handoff from acquisition into retention, with shared visibility on patient quality and LTV
  • Collaborate with the Marketing Director and senior stakeholders to report on retention performance, surface insights, and make the case for investment

What we're looking for

  • Proven experience in a senior growth, retention, or lifecycle marketing role, ideally in a digital health, healthtech, or subscription business
  • A track record of owning and improving retention metrics - churn, LTV, activation, engagement - not just reporting on them
  • Strong understanding of CRM strategy and patient or customer lifecycle communications
  • Experience marketing subscription products or membership programmes, including auditing and rebuilding what isn't working
  • Commercially sharp - you build business cases, set goals, and hold yourself accountable to outcomes
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with clinical, operational, and commercial teams, not just marketing
  • Experience working in a regulated industry - you understand the constraints and know how to operate effectively within them
  • Strong analytical skills, able to translate data into clear strategy and communicate findings to non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience leading and developing a small team

At Releaf, we believe that diverse teams build better businesses. We're committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and able to do their best work. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences — and we're happy to make reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process if you need them. If you'd like to discuss this, please don't hesitate to get in touch.

Radiology Associates of Florida (RAF) isseekingafull-time, remote Neuroradiologistto join our academic practice supportingTampa General Hospital, a nationally recognized health system and stroke center of excellence. This position offers the opportunity to worka7 on/14 offschedule to cover either ourevening or overnight shifts.

This role features a100% neuroradiology case mixand serves a growing healthcare system that provides a diverse and rewarding spectrum of cases. Our neuroradiologists interpret the full breadth of neuroimaging studies, including trauma, stroke (with CT perfusionutilizingRAPID software), oncology, dementia, movement disorders, and functional MRI. Through collaboration with RAF divisions across Florida, radiologistsbenefitfrom a robust and optimized study mix.

Why This Role Stands Out

✔ 100% Remote – Work anywhere in the U.S.

Why You Should Choose RAF

RAF is affiliated with theUniversity of South Florida Morsani College of Medicineand is deeply committed to academic excellence. We train eight radiology residents annually and one neuroradiology fellow. The ideal candidate will have an interest in teaching and mentoring trainees, particularly our neuroradiology fellow. Opportunities for facultyappointmentare available. While dedicated didactic lectures are notrequired, candidates interested in contributing to educational programs are encouraged to do so.

Our practice embraces a collaborative, team-oriented culture where subspecialists work closely together to deliver exceptional patient care. In addition, RAF offers aninternal moonlighting program with unmatched flexibility, allowing radiologists to workadditionalshifts from home whenever they choose, without ongoing commitments orminimumrequirements.

RAF is the largest radiology practice in Florida. We serve the most prestigious, established health systems in the state, including on the east and west coasts, the Florida Panhandle, and the Keys. Our scale affords our practice stability and affords our radiologists flexibilityin study mix and scheduling. We also recognize that scale alone does not beget excellence. We are quality-oriented, and we practice radiology at thecutting edge, encouragingsubspecialty-level interpretations across the practice, andfacilitatingcollaboration and consultation between our radiologists.

Ourstate-of-the-artIT suite includes universal PACS acrossthe practice, AI tools, and integrated doc-to-doc communication widgets.

Our practice is locally and democratically led, with decisions vested in the hands of the group at large, rather than in a few founders or a small group of shareholders.In Sarasota, our physiciansstaffthe Florida State University College of Medicine, hosting medical students in their 3rd and 4th years. We also invite residents from the FSU Internal Medicine and Emergency Medicine Residency programs to rotate in our departments.

Our diverse group of radiologists work and socialize together in our communities around Florida. Even between our communities across the state, we are one practice. We look forward to letting you get to knowusbetter!

In Tampa, discover blue skies and sunshine, a sparkling waterfront, world-classchefsand family fun! There is beautiful weather year-round, with average highs of 82 degrees and average lows of 65 degrees. Florida has no state income tax, estate tax, or inheritance tax.

Financial Aid Advisor
American Public University/American Military University

The Financial Aid Advisor is responsible for providing phone-based financial aid support and counseling services to students attending American Public University or American Military University (APU/AMU). This role functions in a call center type of environment and is heavily focused on providing a high level of customer service. Financial Aid Advisors will spend the majority of their workday engaged in inbound phone-based activities.

Responsibilities:

  • Conducts inbound phone-based discussions, advising and educating students on various forms of Federal Student Aid
  • Provides a high level of customer service, ensuring that the student is packaged with funding to access courses and pursue degree completion
  • Actively engages in problem solving and regularly works with basic math skills to review financial aid package information to ensure correct processing.
  • Seeks out opportunities to enhance the student experience and promote high-quality service
  • Leverages financial aid and student databases to performs research while on phone calls to assist students and parents through the financial aid cycle in real time
  • Ensures daily duties are met within established Service Level Agreements and remains flexible to daily workflow as a result of staffing and business needs
  • Consistently meets department quality and productivity metrics
  • Collaborates with other University departments including Admissions, Advising & Student Support on an as needed basis
  • Maintains accurate knowledge of the University’s products and services
  • Understands and adheres to laws, regulations, policies and procedures, and compliance requirements, staying current on industry standards
  • Maintains eligibility to access the National Student Loan Data System (NSLDS),as defined by the US Department of Education. To maintain access to NSLDS, one must not have defaulted on any student loan in the past, be in default currently or have issues with access to NSLDS in the future
  • Supports and contributes to the organization’s commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging.
  • Performs other duties as directed, requested or assigned

Requirements/Education:

  • 1-2 years of demonstrated customer service experience
  • Strong interpersonal, verbal and written communications skills
  • Associate's degree required
  • Solutions oriented attitude with demonstrated critical thinking and problem solving skills
  • Excellent organization and time management skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple demands with minimal supervision
  • High level of telephone etiquette and professionalism
  • Basic math skills
  • General proficiency with Microsoft Office products, including Word, Excel, Outlook & Teams

Work Schedule:

  • Schedule will depend on the need at the time of hiring.

About Us:

American Public University System (the System) is accredited by the Higher Learning Commission (HLC) (www.hlcommission.org), an institutional accreditation agency recognized by the U.S. Department of Education. HLC accredits degree-granting institutions nationwide and is also recognized by the Council for Higher Education Accreditation. The System is comprised of American Military University, American Public University, Rasmussen University, and Hondros College of Nursing. MWDN is a global IT outstaffing company with 23+ years of experience that connects exceptional tech talent with leading companies across Israel, the USA, Great Britain, and Western Europe. We offer opportunities to work on international products in a stable and professional environment.

Why does MWDN rock?

Here’s what you can expect when you join MWDN:

  • Career support: If a project isn’t the right fit, we support you and actively help find new opportunities that match your skills and career goals.

Domain: Media and Entertainment

Client Location: Israel

Company size: 11-50 employees

Founded in: 2025

What makes this project exciting?

Our new client is something really innovative! This Israel-based startup is building a mobile-first app for micro dramas - a short, scripted series made for smartphones. Think of it as TikTok with short episodes lasting 1 to 1.5 minutes.

The project already has strong support from an investor who believes in its massive potential. As it is still in the early development stage, this job is your chance to be part of a unique entertainment product. Are you ready to work on something fresh and impactful? Check out the opportunity below!

We are looking for a passionate and resourceful User Support Engineer to own the entire support function

  • 4+ years of experience in customer support or a customer-facing role, ideally supporting a mobile app or digital product.

raw.description:
Job Title: Member of Technical Staff, Model Training (post-training research)

Job Type: Full-time

Location: Remote

The Role

In this role, you will investigate how learning algorithms, training data, and evaluation methodologies interact to produce stronger reasoning, generalization, and agent capabilities. You will explore new approaches to reinforcement learning, distillation, and data-efficient training, translating research insights into scalable methods that improve model intelligence.

This is a highly experimental role at the intersection of fundamental machine learning research and large-scale model development. You will have the opportunity to formulate research hypotheses, design ambitious experiments, and develop training methods that directly influence the capabilities of our models.

What You'll Do

  1. Research, implement, and scale advanced post-training methods, including supervised fine-tuning (SFT), reinforcement learning (RL), and on-policy distillation (OPD), across large language and multimodal models.
  2. Investigate learning objectives, optimization dynamics, exploration strategies, and credit assignment mechanisms to improve training stability, sample efficiency, and capability acquisition.
  3. Develop and refine training recipes by jointly optimizing data mixtures, sampling strategies, curricula, and evaluation methodologies.
  4. Design methods for learning from expert demonstrations, human preferences, corrections, and model-generated trajectories, identifying where human feedback delivers the greatest improvements.
  5. Research the co-evolution of generators, reward models, and graders, developing approaches that improve both model performance and the quality of the training signals they consume.
  6. Design rigorous experiments, ablation studies, and evaluation frameworks to measure generalization, reasoning, and performance on realistic downstream tasks.
  7. Own research initiatives end-to-end, from identifying promising directions and implementing new algorithms to executing large-scale experiments and validating results.

What We're Looking For

  1. Strong foundations in machine learning, deep learning, optimization, and modern model training techniques.
  2. Hands-on experience training, fine-tuning, or post-training large-scale language or multimodal models.
  3. Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as reinforcement learning, model distillation, reward modeling, data selection, or learning dynamics.
  4. Strong proficiency in Python and PyTorch, with the ability to implement, debug, and optimize complex training pipelines.
  5. Experience designing controlled experiments, interpreting model behavior, and translating empirical findings into actionable research directions.
  6. Ability to independently navigate ambiguous research problems, formulate hypotheses, and iterate quickly based on experimental evidence.
  7. Strong analytical thinking and a research-driven mindset, with an emphasis on reproducibility, scientific rigor, and measurable improvements.

Nice to Have

  1. Experience with RLHF, RLAIF, preference optimization, or reinforcement learning for reasoning and agentic tasks.
  2. Familiarity with distributed training, large-scale experimentation, and GPU-based model optimization.
  3. Experience developing reward models, verifiers, graders, or automated evaluation systems.
  4. Research contributions to post-training, reinforcement learning, or related areas through publications, open-source projects, or production systems.
  5. Experience investigating synthetic data generation, curriculum learning, or iterative self-improvement techniques.

Compensation & Benefits Notice

The national pay range for this full-time position is base salary of $200,000 –$320,000. All employees are eligible for equity compensation, and employees may also receive performance-based bonuses, dependent on role and subject to company policies. micro1 provides a comprehensive benefits package, including up to 100% reimbursement for health-insurance premiums, paid time off, a 401(K) plan with a company match, and additional benefits designed to support a high-performing, remote-first workforce.

Required Skills and Experience

Physical Requirements

Company Overview

You will develop the core routing engine responsible for intelligent distribution of voice and digital interactions across agents, queues, skills, channels, and business units in real time. The role includes building highly scalable backend services capable of processing large volumes of routing decisions with strict latency, availability, and resiliency requirements. You will work primarily with Java, Spring Boot, distributed architectures, event-driven systems, and cloud-native technologies, collaborating closely with product, architecture, workforce management, telephony, and CX platform teams.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop enterprise-scale routing engines that distribute voice and digital interactions in real time.
  • Implement intelligent routing algorithms based on skills, priorities, capacity, availability, and business rules.
  • Ensure high availability, scalability, resilience, and performance across queues, routing paths, and interaction workloads.
  • Design and maintain APIs supporting routing configuration, administration, monitoring, and integration requirements.
  • Optimize systems for high concurrency, fault tolerance, resiliency, and predictable performance.
  • Integrate routing services with telephony, digital messaging, workforce management, CRM, identity, reporting, and analytics platforms.
  • Design and develop critical Java and Spring Boot services, APIs, integration components, and reference implementations.
  • Translate business journeys and operational requirements into solution components, interaction flows, deployment views, and technical roadmaps.
  • Define non-functional requirements for availability, performance, concurrency, security, privacy, observability, disaster recovery, and supportability.
  • Review designs and code, identify technical risks, challenge assumptions, and drive pragmatic decisions that balance quality, time, and cost.
  • Establish engineering standards, reusable patterns, quality gates, documentation expectations, and technology adoption guidance.
  • Collaborate with CX domain experts to translate operational requirements into routing capabilities.
  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, including substantial ownership of architecture and technical delivery for distributed applications.
  • Expert-level hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, implementing distributed systems and microservices architectures, REST APIs, persistence, security, testing, and performance engineering.
  • Experience developing routing logic for contact center, communications, or customer engagement platforms.
  • Knowledge of ACD concepts, agent states, queue management, skill-based routing, priority routing, proficiency routing, and workload balancing.
  • Experience building high-throughput, low-latency transaction processing systems.Deep understanding of API-first design, event-driven architecture, messaging, distributed systems, and cloud-native engineering.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL or comparable relational databases, data modeling, integration data flows, and transactional design.
  • Hands-on experience with contact center or CX platforms and the operational concepts behind customer routing and engagement.
  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to produce clear technical documentation and lead client-facing workshops.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with real-time communications platforms such as FreeSWITCH or Kamailio.
  • Knowledge of optimization algorithms, decision engines, or scheduling systems.
  • Experience with Genesys, NICE, Five9, Amazon Connect, Cisco, Avaya, or comparable contact center platforms.
  • Exposure to WFM processes and integrations involving forecasting, schedules, adherence, etc.
  • Familiarity with Kafka or RabbitMQ, Kubernetes, Jenkins, observability platforms, API gateways, and security architecture.
  • Practical experience with AI-assisted software development or AI-enabled solutions, including tools such as Claude or GitHub Copilot, is a plus.

We offer:

  • Culture of Relentless Performance: join an unstoppable technology development team with a 99% project success rate and more than 30% year-over-year revenue growth.
  • Competitive Pay and Benefits: enjoy a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, and a relocation program.
  • Work From Anywhere Culture: make the most of the flexibility that comes with remote work.
  • Growth Mindset: reap the benefits of a range of professional development opportunities, including certification programs, mentorship and talent investment programs, internal mobility and internship opportunities.
  • Global Impact: collaborate on impactful projects for top global clients and shape the future of industries.
  • Welcoming Multicultural Environment: be a part of a dynamic, global team and thrive in an inclusive and supportive work environment with open communication and regular team-building company social events.
  • Social Sustainability Values: join our sustainable business practices focused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality.

* Miratech is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status under applicable law.

Miratech helps visionaries change the world. We are a global IT services and consulting company that brings together enterprise and start-up innovation. Today, we support digital transformation for some of the world's largest enterprises. By partnering with both large and small players, we stay at the leading edge of technology, remain nimble even as a global leader, and create technology that helps our clients further enhance their business. We are a values-driven organization and our culture of Relentless Performance has enabled over 99% of Miratech's engagements to succeed by meeting or exceeding our scope, schedule, and/or budget objectives since our inception in 1989.

raw.description:
Description

MEDvidi is an AI-powered mental healthcare clinic setting a new standard for safe, effective, and scalable psychiatric care in the United States.

We combine licensed providers with proprietary AI tools to deliver consistent, outcomes-driven treatment for conditions like ADHD, anxiety, depression, and more. MEDvidi's technology automates charting, follow-ups, and treatment planning, freeing providers to focus on patient care while improving efficiency and clinical quality.

We're looking for a Senior Backend (NodeJS) Engineer to join our AI Automation team and lead the development of AI-driven integrations within our telemedicine platform. You will design and scale the backend systems that connect our core product with AI services, directly improving how thousands of patients and providers interact with MEDvidi every day.

You'll work at the intersection of backend engineering and applied AI, building production-grade systems that automate clinical and operational workflows. You'll collaborate closely with AI engineers, product teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to ship reliable, scalable automation, from multi-agent orchestration to RAG pipelines.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build backend architecture for AI-powered automation systems, with a focus on performance, scalability, and resilience.
  • Integrate and scale LLM-based product features in close collaboration with AI engineers and product teams.
  • Implement and evolve agent-based systems (e.g., ReAct, supervisor-agent models) supporting complex decision-making flows.
  • Optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and context enrichment using structured and unstructured data.
  • Develop robust APIs for internal services and external integrations.
  • Ensure strong observability, monitoring, and alerting practices using tools like Grafana and OpenSearch.
  • Participate in code reviews, contribute to architecture discussions, and maintain high-quality technical documentation for newly designed systems and APIs.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of commercial backend development with Node.js in product companies (preferably SaaS), with deep understanding of complex backend systems end-to-end.
  • Strong experience designing backend architectures and technical solutions, including system decomposition, scalability trade-offs, long-term maintainability, and technology choices.
  • Proven track record building scalable, high-performance backend systems and robust APIs, with solid understanding of data flows, failure modes, and performance bottlenecks.
  • Hands-on experience integrating LLMs into production systems (not demos), with focus on reliability, predictability, cost control, and measurable quality improvements.
  • Experience designing and implementing multi-agent AI workflows in production, including orchestration logic, ReAct patterns, supervisor-agent architectures, and clear understanding of when such approaches are justified.
  • Practical experience with modern AI frameworks
  • Solid experience designing and optimizing RAG pipelines: embeddings, vector databases, retrieval strategies, ranking, chunking, and quality vs. latency trade-offs.
  • Strong prompt engineering skills, including structured outputs (JSON/YAML), schema validation, evaluation-based iteration (e.g., AI eval frameworks), and reliability techniques beyond prompt-only solutions.
  • Understanding of LLM infrastructure in production environments: tracing and observability (LangSmith, Langfuse, or similar), evaluation frameworks and quality metrics, tooling and orchestration, safety mechanisms and guardrails, performance and cost optimization.
  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL (schema design, migrations, performance optimization) and AWS (CDK, Lambda, API Gateway, ElastiCache).
  • Good understanding of observability and debugging (Grafana, OpenSearch, or similar).
  • Strong engineering culture: testing, CI/CD, reliability, and technical ownership.
  • Product-oriented mindset with the ability to build user-centered automation, not isolated technical components.
  • Proactive AI enthusiast mindset: explores and validates new AI approaches and patterns applicable to product use cases.
  • Fluent Russian; English B2+.

Would be a plus

  • Experience working with medical/healthcare AI or regulated environments.
  • Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) in Node.js.

What we offer

  • High-impact environment: A chance to contribute to a product-driven company in the medical tech space.
  • Growth & compensation: Clear growth opportunities and a competitive compensation package.
  • Remote-first: Fully remote long-term collaboration under a B2B model.
  • Health & wellness: Health insurance after the probation period, plus sports and wellness compensation.
  • Career development: Personalized English lessons via Preply and clear growth paths.
  • Time off: 19 paid vacation days annually, 4 additional wellness days each year, and paid sick leave for the first 5 working days.
  • Culture: Thoughtful gifts for key life events and offline corporate events.

Ready to make an impact? Send us your profile, let's build something meaningful together.

﻿

All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

  • Strong linux chops.

Let’s be unstoppable together!

Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behavior, and drive growth—powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high-quality data set.

At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives.  We’re a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work.  Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana.

Learn more at

Our Critical Sales Skills

At the heart of our commercial success is a team of professionals who combine strategic insight, customer-centricity, and executional excellence. These skills represent the core capabilities required to drive value for our clients and sustainable growth for our business.

  • Effectively Presents Solutions: Delivers tailored, compelling solutions that align with customer needs and drive action.
  • Knows the Buying Influences: Identifies key decision-makers and understands their motivations and influence.
  • Manages Buyer Indifference: Recognizes and explores customer hesitation to uncover new needs or opportunities.
  • Understands Customer Needs: Operates as a recognized expert to articulate customer needs in the customer's business language and business context.
  • Being Resilient: Bounces back from setbacks with composure and positivity; helps others stay productive during tough times.
  • Manages Ambiguity: Stays focused and calm in uncertain situations; guides others through change.

What will you be doing?

Reporting to the Senior Vice President (SVP) Agency partnerships, you will be the Client Sales & Insights leader for the Media Vertical with specific focus on our large and growing Agency & Walled Garden clients. You will be responsible for strategic planning, executive alignment, revenue generation and client success, serving as the subject matter expert and key decision maker for the Market Measurement and CSIA business within the Media Vertical.

Job Responsibilities

Commercial Growth & Business Leadership

  • Own and grow revenue for Circana's Market Measurement and CSIA solutions across the Media Vertical, with primary focus on Advertising Agency Holding Companies and Walled Garden partners.
  • Develop and execute strategies that expand existing client relationships and drive new business opportunities for these solutions.
  • Identify emerging market trends, competitive dynamics, and client needs to inform commercial strategy and growth priorities.

Product Market Fit & Solution Strategy

  • Lead the optimization of product-market fit for Agency and Walled Garden clients by identifying, prioritizing, and documenting key client use cases and business requirements.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Analytics, and Commercial teams to ensure Circana solutions address high-value client needs and deliver measurable business outcomes.
  • Influence solution packaging, pricing, and go-to-market strategies to maximize client value and commercial performance.

Client Success & Executive Relationship Management

  • Drive customer success, retention, and growth by increasing client adoption, engagement, and utilization of Circana solutions.
  • Build and maintain trusted advisor relationships with senior client stakeholders and decision-makers, fostering strategic partnerships and identifying opportunities for innovation and expansion.
  • Ensure the consistent delivery of exceptional client experiences through effective coordination and alignment of internal stakeholders and resources.

📋 Tâches et responsabilités

FR

Ingénieur systèmes en cybersécurité SIEM

Vous rejoignez l'équipe projet chargée d'intégrer une solution SIEM / Log Analytics pour le Security Operations Center (SOC) et l'équipe SecOps. En collaboration avec l'architecte et le Project Manager, vous accompagnez l'onboarding des logs et apportez les adaptations nécessaires aux outils SIEM / Log Analytics.

La mission porte sur la mise en œuvre et l'administration de l'environnement Elastic, notamment Elasticsearch, Kibana, Logstash et Kafka. Vous gérez les applications Elasticsearch et Kibana, réalisez les changements nécessaires après concertation, concevez des tableaux de bord et des rapports selon les besoins définis, et veillez à la documentation associée.

Délivrables

  • Infrastructure Log Analytics et environnement Elasticsearch
  • Connexion de la liste prévue de systèmes et d'applications
  • Rapports et tableaux de bord

Type de responsabilités

  • Concevoir, administrer, configurer et optimiser la plateforme Elastic Security (SIEM) pour la collecte et la corrélation des événements de sécurité.
  • Construire et maintenir, avec l'équipe, des solutions de sécurité basées sur Elastic.
  • Intégrer des flux de threat intelligence dans le SIEM afin de soutenir une détection proactive.
  • Réaliser les mises à niveau de la plateforme SIEM et en garantir la fiabilité ainsi que la scalabilité.
  • Surveiller les logs, alertes et rapports de sécurité pour détecter les anomalies et problèmes potentiels, y compris dans des environnements cloud.
  • Utiliser Elasticsearch pour l'indexation, la recherche et l'analyse de données liées à la sécurité.

📝 Votre profil

Compétences

  • Expérience confirmée comme Security Engineer ou System Engineer orienté cybersécurité, avec un focus sur le SIEM et la stack Elastic, notamment Kibana, Logstash, Kafka et Elasticsearch.
  • Maîtrise d'Elasticsearch, y compris l'indexation, les requêtes et la visualisation de données.
  • Bonne pratique du scripting d'API et de langages tels que Python ou ES/QL pour l'automatisation et le développement d'outils spécifiques.
  • Expérience solide de l'intégration de logs dans des environnements cloud comme AWS et Azure.
  • Bonne connaissance de Linux, ainsi que d'environnements Windows.
  • Capacité à analyser et résoudre des incidents dans des contextes exigeants.
  • Aisance rédactionnelle et orale pour documenter les solutions et communiquer des sujets de sécurité de manière claire.
  • Expérience avec des environnements cloud native, notamment Kubernetes.
  • Connaissance des cadres et normes de cybersécurité tels que SOC2 et ISO 27001.
  • Expérience avec EDR, outils SIEM, gestion des logs, détection d'intrusion, sécurité réseau et passerelles de messagerie.
  • Approche rigoureuse, proactive et orientée service.

Connaissances

  • Elasticsearch, Kibana, Logstash, Kafka
  • ES/QL
  • Dashboards
  • Module APM d'Elastic
  • Module SIEM d'Elastic
  • Elastic Agent (équivalents FileBeat, LogBeats, WinBeats, Syslog, ...)

NL

System Engineer Cyber Security SIEM

Je sluit aan bij het projectteam dat de integratie van een SIEM/Log Analytics-oplossing verzorgt voor het Security Operations Center (SOC) en het SecOps-team. Samen met de architect en de Project Manager ondersteun je de onboarding van logdata en voer je de nodige aanpassingen uit in de SIEM/Log Analytics-tools.

De opdracht focust op de implementatie en het beheer van de Elastic-omgeving, meer bepaald Elasticsearch, Kibana, Logstash en Kafka. Je beheert Elasticsearch- en Kibana-applicaties, voert wijzigingen uit na overleg, ontwerpt dashboards en rapportering op basis van de vooraf bepaalde noden en zorgt voor de nodige documentatie.

Deliverables

  • Log Analytics-infrastructuur en Elasticsearch-omgeving
  • Aansluiting van de voorziene lijst van systemen en applicaties
  • Rapporten en dashboards

Type verantwoordelijkheden

  • Ontwerpen, beheren, configureren en optimaliseren van het Elastic Security SIEM-platform voor het verzamelen en correleren van security-events.
  • Samen met het team beveiligingsoplossingen op basis van Elastic uitwerken en onderhouden.
  • Threat intelligence feeds integreren in het SIEM voor proactieve detectie van bedreigingen.
  • Upgrades van het SIEM-platform uitvoeren en waken over schaalbaarheid en betrouwbaarheid.
  • Securitylogs, alerts en rapporten opvolgen om anomalieën en potentiële problemen te detecteren, ook in cloudomgevingen.
  • Elasticsearch gebruiken voor indexatie, opzoekingen en analyse van securitygerelateerde data.

📝 Jouw profiel

Vaardigheden

  • Aantoonbare ervaring als Security Engineer of System Engineer met focus op cybersecurity, SIEM en de Elastic-stack, waaronder Kibana, Logstash, Kafka en Elasticsearch.
  • Grondige kennis van Elasticsearch, inclusief indexering, query's en datavisualisatie.

Retention Strategy

  • Own Releaf's retention strategy, setting clear goals across patient activation, engagement, subscription growth, and churn reduction
  • Lead the ongoing development of Releaf+ - our subscription model - ensuring it delivers genuine value to patients and performs commercially
  • Develop and manage loyalty mechanics, refer-a-friend programmes, and other retention incentives that drive long-term patient engagement
  • Work alongside the Brand Team to market and communicate Releaf's retention products - including the Releaf medical cannabis card, Releaf Protect, and free legal support for Releaf+ patients - ensuring patients understand and use what's available to them
  • Build proactive intervention programmes that identify early signs of patient drop-off and act on them before churn happens

CRM & Communications

  • Work closely with the CRM & Lifecycle Lead to develop and execute a patient communications strategy across the full lifecycle - from onboarding through to long-term retention
  • Ensure CRM activity is data-led, well-segmented, and aligned to retention goals
  • Own the feedback loop between patient communications and operational reality - medication changes, formulary updates, patient support changes - ensuring comms reflect what's actually happening across the business

CRO

  • Work in lockstep with the CRO & Experimentation Lead and the CRO and UX Designers. to ensure the pre-payment and post-login patient experiences are continuously tested, optimised, and improving
  • Connect CRO activity to retention outcomes - what happens on the dashboard should be as informed by retention data as it is by UX insight

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Build strong working relationships with Clinical, Dev, Operations, and Patient Support teams to stay close to changes that affect the patient experience
  • Act as the commercial bridge between operational change and patient-facing communications - when something changes inside the business, you make sure it's reflected in how we communicate and retain patients
  • Work closely with the Head of Performance Marketing to ensure a clean handoff from acquisition into retention, with shared visibility on patient quality and LTV
  • Collaborate with the Marketing Director and senior stakeholders to report on retention performance, surface insights, and make the case for investment

What we're looking for

  • Proven experience in a senior growth, retention, or lifecycle marketing role, ideally in a digital health, healthtech, or subscription business
  • A track record of owning and improving retention metrics - churn, LTV, activation, engagement - not just reporting on them
  • Strong understanding of CRM strategy and patient or customer lifecycle communications
  • Experience marketing subscription products or membership programmes, including auditing and rebuilding what isn't working
  • Commercially sharp - you build business cases, set goals, and hold yourself accountable to outcomes
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with clinical, operational, and commercial teams, not just marketing
  • Experience working in a regulated industry - you understand the constraints and know how to operate effectively within them
  • Strong analytical skills, able to translate data into clear strategy and communicate findings to non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience leading and developing a small team

At Releaf, we believe that diverse teams build better businesses. We're committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and able to do their best work. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences — and we're happy to make reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process if you need them. If you'd like to discuss this, please don't hesitate to get in touch.

Radiology Associates of Florida (RAF) isseekingafull-time, remote Neuroradiologistto join our academic practice supportingTampa General Hospital, a nationally recognized health system and stroke center of excellence. This role features a100% neuroradiology case mixand serves a growing healthcare system that provides a diverse and rewarding spectrum of cases. Our neuroradiologists interpret the full breadth of neuroimaging studies, including trauma, stroke (with CT perfusionutilizingRAPID software), oncology, dementia, movement disorders, and functional MRI. Through collaboration with RAF divisions across Florida, radiologistsbenefitfrom a robust and optimized study mix.

Why This Role Stands Out

✔ 100% Remote – Work anywhere in the U.S.

✔ 100% Dedicated Neuroradiology

✔ 7on/14 off with option for evening or overnight schedules

RAF is affiliated with theUniversity of South Florida Morsani College of Medicineand is deeply committed to academic excellence. We train eight radiology residents annually and one neuroradiology fellow. The ideal candidate will have an interest in teaching and mentoring trainees, particularly our neuroradiology fellow. Opportunities for facultyappointmentare available. While dedicated didactic lectures are notrequired, candidates interested in contributing to educational programs are encouraged to do so.

Our practice embraces a collaborative, team-oriented culture where subspecialists work closely together to deliver exceptional patient care. Our scale affords our practice stability and affords our radiologists flexibilityin study mix and scheduling. We also recognize that scale alone does not beget excellence. We are quality-oriented, and we practice radiology at thecutting edge, encouragingsubspecialty-level interpretations across the practice, andfacilitatingcollaboration and consultation between our radiologists.

Ourstate-of-the-artIT suite includes universal PACS acrossthe practice, AI tools, and integrated doc-to-doc communication widgets.

Our practice is locally and democratically led, with decisions vested in the hands of the group at large, rather than in a few founders or a small group of shareholders.In Sarasota, our physiciansstaffthe Florida State University College of Medicine, hosting medical students in their 3rd and 4th years. We also invite residents from the FSU Internal Medicine and Emergency Medicine Residency programs to rotate in our departments.

Our diverse group of radiologists work and socialize together in our communities around Florida. Even between our communities across the state, we are one practice. We look forward to letting you get to knowusbetter!

In Tampa, discover blue skies and sunshine, a sparkling waterfront, world-classchefsand family fun! There is beautiful weather year-round, with average highs of 82 degrees and average lows of 65 degrees. Florida has no state income tax, estate tax, or inheritance tax.

In addition to this range, Radiology Partners offers competitive total rewards packages, which include health & wellness coverage options, 401(k) benefits, and a broad range of other benefits such as family planning andtelehealth(all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements).

Financial Aid Advisor
American Public University/American Military University

The Financial Aid Advisor is responsible for providing phone-based financial aid support and counseling services to students attending American Public University or American Military University (APU/AMU). This role functions in a call center type of environment and is heavily focused on providing a high level of customer service. Financial Aid Advisors will spend the majority of their workday engaged in inbound phone-based activities.

Responsibilities:

  • Conducts inbound phone-based discussions, advising and educating students on various forms of Federal Student Aid
  • Provides a high level of customer service, ensuring that the student is packaged with funding to access courses and pursue degree completion
  • Actively engages in problem solving and regularly works with basic math skills to review financial aid package information to ensure correct processing.
  • Seeks out opportunities to enhance the student experience and promote high-quality service
  • Leverages financial aid and student databases to performs research while on phone calls to assist students and parents through the financial aid cycle in real time
  • Ensures daily duties are met within established Service Level Agreements and remains flexible to daily workflow as a result of staffing and business needs
  • Consistently meets department quality and productivity metrics
  • Collaborates with other University departments including Admissions, Advising & Student Support on an as needed basis

  • Understands and adheres to laws, regulations, policies and procedures, and compliance requirements, staying current on industry standards
  • Maintains eligibility to access the National Student Loan Data System (NSLDS),as defined by the US Department of Education. To maintain access to NSLDS, one must not have defaulted on any student loan in the past, be in default currently or have issues with access to NSLDS in the future
  • Supports and contributes to the organization’s commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging.
  • Performs other duties as directed, requested or assigned

Requirements/Education:

  • 1-2 years of demonstrated customer service experience
  • Strong interpersonal, verbal and written communications skills
  • Associate's degree required
  • Solutions oriented attitude with demonstrated critical thinking and problem solving skills
  • Excellent organization and time management skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple demands with minimal supervision

American Public University System (the System) is accredited by the Higher Learning Commission (HLC) (www.hlcommission.org), an institutional accreditation agency recognized by the U.S. Department of Education.
