MWDN is a global IT outstaffing company with 23+ years of experience that connects exceptional tech talent with leading companies across Israel, the USA, Great Britain, and Western Europe. We offer opportunities to work on international products in a stable and professional environment.

Why does MWDN rock?

Here’s what you can expect when you join MWDN:

  • Security: We carefully vet our clients to minimize risks and ensure reliability and timely payments - no fraud or unpleasant surprises.
  • Career support: If a project isn’t the right fit, we support you and actively help find new opportunities that match your skills and career goals.
  • Legal assistance: We provide guidance on legal matters, including opening and managing your independent contractor or sole proprietorship status, taxes, and related processes.
  • Professional development: We offer English courses and professional growth opportunities, as well as team-building events.

Why choose us? MWDN is ranked among the top 5 IT employers in our region according to DOU. We take pride in our transparency and strong commitment to our team. Curious to learn more? See what our employees say about working with us on DOU.

What is your new project?

Domain: Media and Entertainment

Client Location: Israel

Company size: 11-50 employees

Founded in: 2025

What makes this project exciting?

Our new client is something really innovative! This Israel-based startup is building a mobile-first app for micro dramas - a short, scripted series made for smartphones. Think of it as TikTok with short episodes lasting 1 to 1.5 minutes.

The project already has strong support from an investor who believes in its massive potential. As it is still in the early development stage, this job is your chance to be part of a unique entertainment product. Are you ready to work on something fresh and impactful? Check out the opportunity below!

We are looking for a passionate and resourceful User Support Engineer to own the entire support function

What makes you a great fit

  • 4+ years of experience in customer support or a customer-facing role, ideally supporting a mobile app or digital product.
  • Fluent English with excellent written and verbal communication and the ability to explain technical or billing issues clearly.
  • Hands-on experience handling tickets in Zendesk, Intercom or a similar support platform, including statuses, tags, macros, internal notes and escalations.
  • Experience supporting payments and subscriptions, including purchase verification, cancellation and refund procedures; familiarity with Paddle, Apple in-app purchases or Google Play.
  • Ability to investigate technical issues, follow troubleshooting guidance and prepare clear bug reports with relevant evidence.
  • Strong organization and attention to detail, with the ability to manage a busy queue, follow priorities and maintain accurate case records.
  • Customer empathy, sound judgment and a willingness to ask for clarification or escalate when a case exceeds your access or authority.
  • Comfort learning new tools and using approved AI assistance while taking responsibility for the accuracy of your work.

Nice-to-have skills

  • ﻿Experience in mobile entertainment, streaming or gaming.
  • Experience using AI-assisted support tools and contributing to macros, help articles or workflow improvements.
  • Familiarity with support reports, app-store reviews, or CRM and analytics tools such as Braze or Mixpanel.

Your day-to-day in this position

  • Customer support: Handle requests across in-app chat, email and web forms. Write clear, empathetic and accurate responses in English, adapting them to the user’s situation.
  • Technical troubleshooting: Investigate playback, login, account access and app issues. Review contact history, follow troubleshooting procedures, and collect relevant device details, screenshots and reproduction steps.
  • Payments and subscriptions: Help with coin purchases, missing paid content, cancellations, billing questions and refund requests. Verify the purchase channel and transaction status, and take actions within approved policies and access permissions.
  • Ticket ownership and escalation: Categorize and prioritize tickets using team guidelines, keep records and internal notes accurate, and escalate with complete context. Follow up with users and internal teams until the required actions are complete.
  • Support tools and AI: Use the team’s helpdesk, approved macros, workflows and AI-assisted tools. Check generated responses against the case and support guidance before sending, and flag inaccurate answers or workflow issues.
  • Documentation and feedback: Contribute updates to existing FAQs, knowledge base articles and internal instructions. Report recurring issues and suggest practical improvements to the support lead.
  • Quality and performance: Meet agreed response-time, resolution and quality targets. Apply QA feedback, follow privacy and account-verification procedures, and flag workload or case blockers promptly.

Why work with us?

  • People-first management with minimal bureaucracy
  • A friendly company culture, proven by employees who choose to return
  • Flexible working hours
  • 29 days of PTO (18 working days per year pluse all national holidays)
  • 10 paid recovery days
  • Full financial and legal support for independent contractors
  • Free English classes, with native speakers or Ukrainian teachers
  • Dedicated HR support

We are looking for an experienced Product Owner / Business Analyst to join a cross-functional team developing a next-generation ERP and Accounting platform.

In this role, you will be responsible for maximizing the value delivered by the development team and acting as the key link between finance Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) and the delivery team. You will translate complex accounting, financial, and operational workflows into clear product requirements, a prioritized backlog, and actionable development initiatives.

You will work closely with accountants, finance controllers, auditors, developers, QA, UX/UI specialists, and project stakeholders to ensure that delivered solutions meet customer needs, business objectives, and quality standards.

This role requires a combination of product ownership, business analysis, stakeholder management, and decision-making skills, as well as the ability to operate effectively in an Agile/Scrum environment.

Requirements:

  • Minimum 2 years of experience as a Product Owner, or 3–5 years of experience in a similar Business Analyst/Product Owner role within a Scrum environment.

  • Proven experience delivering complex IT/software products, preferably within the ERP, accounting, or finance domain.

  • Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum frameworks and the full software/product development lifecycle.

  • Experience working with cross-functional and distributed development teams.

  • Proven experience collaborating with multiple SMEs, such as accountants, finance controllers, and auditors.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to translate complex business requirements into clear, actionable product requirements.

  • Hands-on experience creating high-quality user stories, acceptance criteria, and product documentation.

  • Strong prioritization and decision-making skills, including the ability to make trade-offs, reduce scope when necessary, and make decisions under uncertainty.

  • Ability to work independently while maintaining a high level of transparency and stakeholder alignment.

  • Practical experience with Azure DevOps and Miro.

  • Proficiency in using AI tools in day-to-day work.

  • Familiarity with UX principles and user-centered product development.

  • Understanding of API-based systems and integrations, particularly within ERP ecosystems.

  • Data-driven approach to product development and decision-making.

Nice to have:

  • Hands-on domain experience with ERP or Accounting systems.

  • Understanding of core accounting principles, including double-entry bookkeeping, period-end close, and multi-entity reporting.

  • Familiarity with Behaviour-Driven Development (BDD) as a collaborative approach to defining and validating new domains or implementation phases.

  • Professional certification such as CBAP, PSPO, or equivalent.

Main responsibilities:

  • Work closely with finance and accounting SMEs to define and scope upcoming implementation phases.

  • Translate business needs and complex domain requirements into clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and product documentation.

  • Understand, communicate, and support the client's product vision, strategy, and roadmap.

  • Manage and prioritize the product backlog, balancing business value, customer needs, technical constraints, dependencies, and delivery risks.

  • Build alignment across diverse stakeholders and drive decisions that enable the team to move forward with the next actionable piece of work.

  • Collaborate closely with the client, development team, UX/UI, QA, and Scrum Master/Project Manager throughout the product development lifecycle.

  • Accept or reject completed work based on agreed acceptance criteria and business expectations.

  • Support the testing and validation process to ensure delivered features meet functional and quality requirements.

  • Introduce new product domains and implementation phases using Behaviour-Driven Development (BDD) and structured examples as a collaborative way of working.

  • Participate actively in sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, demos, and other Agile ceremonies.

  • Identify and manage dependencies and proactively mitigate delivery risks.

  • Report on delivered work and communicate outcomes to stakeholders, maintaining transparency and visibility of progress against the roadmap.

  • Use data, customer feedback, and KPIs to identify and drive product improvements in alignment with the client.

raw.description:
Silverback Strategies is a performance marketing agency built to help marketers grow and capitalize on change. Ad Age, Inc Magazine, The Washington Post, The Washingtonian, and The Washington Business Journal have recognized Silverback as one of the best places to work.
We hire the best and help them get better. Silverbackers are supported, challenged and inspired by their peers. Regardless of title or tenure, every Silverbacker plays a role in helping our agency get better. This is a place where you can make a difference.

Today, we're looking for a Paid Media Manager to join our growing team. Our new Paid Media Manager will serve as a subject matter expert in all things related to Paid Media. You will play both the lead role & support on a portfolio of Paid Media client strategies, build & maintain great client relationships, manage timelines and deliverables, and directly grow clients’ marketing performance through your work.

The Paid Media Manager will independently lead account strategy for a select few of their own clients, while also working closely with Senior Paid Media Managers and Associate Directors to support on account strategy & tactical execution for larger clients as needed. This role is ideal for a Paid Media pro with 3+ years of experience who is driven and hungry to bring their media strategy & client ownership chops to the next level. You’ll work on a team of top-notch digital marketing SMEs, and will collaborate with counterparts on SEO, Measurement, and Creative teams to successfully execute client delivery.

Here’s what we expect from our Paid Media Manager.

—What You'll Do—

  • Client Ownership: Responsible for the strategy development, innovation, and tactical execution + performance of small-but-impactful portfolio Paid Media client accounts. (3-5 clients)

  • Hitting Client Goals: Plan, implement and audit paid media campaigns & strategies that align with client KPIs, marketing, and business goals

  • Hands-on-keys Execution: Successfully plan & execute campaigns in both Search and Social paid media platforms (Google, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok)

  • Client-Facing / Account Management: Serve as the lead point of contact for all things Paid Media for your “owned” clients; lead biweekly and ad hoc client calls to build & maintain strong client relationships

  • Testing & Innovation: Support channel innovation efforts, ensuring clients' Paid Media strategies are following evolving best practices and using performance data to identify opportunities for new campaigns, optimizations, and testing

  • Reporting: Regularly create, analyze, and present insightful and actionable Paid Media performance reports directly to clients

  • Project Management: Accurately communicate project timelines to clients; manage client expectations and proactively update clients as things change

  • Creative Strategy: Collaborate with Silverback's Creative Director and Design team on ad creation and testing plans; assist with creative strategy and briefs as needed

  • Know Your Client's Business: Understand your clients’ industries, audience, and goals while staying on top of industry changes, trends, and best practices

  • Teamwork & Collaboration: Join in creative brainstorming sessions with other members of the Paid Media team to promote a culture of collaboration and innovation

  • Professional Growth: Accept feedback and coaching from the Associate Director of Media to ensure our clients are receiving a best-in-class experience & top-notch performance.

—What We’re Looking For—

  • Years of Experience: A minimum of 3+ years of paid media agency experience - ideal candidate has 3-5 YOE. Previous performance agency experience is a MUST-HAVE!

  • Paid Search and Social Expertise: Must-have experience managing both Paid Search and Social campaigns. (Main platforms are Google secondary platforms are LinkedIn and TikTok)

  • Client-Facing Comfortability: This role is not a good fit for someone who doesn’t want to talk directly to clients. You must be comfortable building rapport, establishing expertise / credibility, and serving as the face of the Paid Media engagement with your assigned clients.

  • Business Acumen: Being able to build & execute winning Paid Media strategies across multiple industries is crucial — but your ability to tie Media wins to a measurable impact on the clients’ business, revenue, etc is what will make you a superstar.

  • Ownership of Work: In this role, you'll fully own the success of your 3-5 clients from strategy development, to tactical execution, to reporting & client-facing communication. You MUST have prior experience taking "full ownership" of client(s) in a similar vein in order to succeed at Silverback.

  • Curiosity & “Get Sh*t Done” Mentality: You’d rather take a big swing and miss than sit around twiddling your thumbs. You’re energized by & thrive in an environment where no two days are the same, and results are king. You’re relentlessly curious, eager to learn, and willing to make mistakes in the name of progress & growth.

  • Data Analysis: You're a whiz in Excel and/or Google Sheets. Complex sets of data don't throw you, and you're comfortable analyzing & breaking down data using GA4 and other tools to produce clear, insightful, and meaningful reports for clients.

  • Adaptability & Growth: Feedback fuels you. You lean into change, sharpen your skills, and push yourself and your team to get better every day.

  • Project & Time Management: You run a clean calendar and keep priorities straight. Competing demands don't throw you.

—Why Silverback?—

    • Silverback isn’t for everybody. If you’re an A player, you will get paid more, learn more and grow faster with support from a smart and fun team. If you’re a B player, you will be miserable.

    • Make an impact: We’re a small agency. Everybody has the opportunity to drive change and impact.

    • Get paid: We hire the best and pay them generously.

    • Do cool sh*t: From media to SEO to measurement, learn the cutting edge of what works.

—Benefits & Perks—

    • Unlimited PTO

    • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision plans

    • Virtual Team Events and a fun, casual, inclusive company culture

    • Company-paid ClassPass membership

    • 12 weeks of Paid Parental Leave

    • Summer Fridays

    • 401(k) with Employer Match

—Work Environment—

    • We’re a fully remote agency with employees working across the continental United States. At Silverback, you'll be part of a remote work culture that emphasizes smooth, productive online communication.

    • We at Silverback pride ourselves on being an extremely tight-knit team. We boast an unparalleled culture of collaboration, empathy, and a truly "work hard, play hard" mentality.

    • Ad Age, Inc. Magazine and The Washington Post have named Silverback one of the best places to work in the Country and our CEO is a DIGIDAY Top Boss. Apply today & discover for yourself what makes Silverback Strategies such a special place to work. We can't wait to hear from you!

Silverback Strategies is an equal opportunity employer. If you believe you meet the qualifications for the position, then we invite you to apply. We celebrate the free flow of conversation, ideas and opinions at Silverback, but actions such as bullying, discrimination, harassment or retaliation of any kind are strictly prohibited in our workplace. We are committed to providing a safe, open and accommodating environment that allows all of our team members to thrive. Employment decisions are made without regard to age, color, disability, family, genetic information, origin, race, religion, sex. For more information, we invite you to visit eeoc.gov.

Job Title: Member of Technical Staff, Model Training (post-training research)

Job Type: Full-time

Location: Remote

The Role

In this role, you will investigate how learning algorithms, training data, and evaluation methodologies interact to produce stronger reasoning, generalization, and agent capabilities. You will explore new approaches to reinforcement learning, distillation, and data-efficient training, translating research insights into scalable methods that improve model intelligence.

This is a highly experimental role at the intersection of fundamental machine learning research and large-scale model development. You will have the opportunity to formulate research hypotheses, design ambitious experiments, and develop training methods that directly influence the capabilities of our models.

What You'll Do

  1. Research, implement, and scale advanced post-training methods, including supervised fine-tuning (SFT), reinforcement learning (RL), and on-policy distillation (OPD), across large language and multimodal models.
  2. Investigate learning objectives, optimization dynamics, exploration strategies, and credit assignment mechanisms to improve training stability, sample efficiency, and capability acquisition.
  3. Develop and refine training recipes by jointly optimizing data mixtures, sampling strategies, curricula, and evaluation methodologies.
  4. Design methods for learning from expert demonstrations, human preferences, corrections, and model-generated trajectories, identifying where human feedback delivers the greatest improvements.
  5. Research the co-evolution of generators, reward models, and graders, developing approaches that improve both model performance and the quality of the training signals they consume.
  6. Design rigorous experiments, ablation studies, and evaluation frameworks to measure generalization, reasoning, and performance on realistic downstream tasks.
  7. Own research initiatives end-to-end, from identifying promising directions and implementing new algorithms to executing large-scale experiments and validating results.

What We're Looking For

  1. Strong foundations in machine learning, deep learning, optimization, and modern model training techniques.
  2. Hands-on experience training, fine-tuning, or post-training large-scale language or multimodal models.
  3. Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as reinforcement learning, model distillation, reward modeling, data selection, or learning dynamics.
  4. Strong proficiency in Python and PyTorch, with the ability to implement, debug, and optimize complex training pipelines.
  5. Experience designing controlled experiments, interpreting model behavior, and translating empirical findings into actionable research directions.
  6. Ability to independently navigate ambiguous research problems, formulate hypotheses, and iterate quickly based on experimental evidence.
  7. Strong analytical thinking and a research-driven mindset, with an emphasis on reproducibility, scientific rigor, and measurable improvements.

Nice to Have

  1. Experience with RLHF, RLAIF, preference optimization, or reinforcement learning for reasoning and agentic tasks.
  2. Familiarity with distributed training, large-scale experimentation, and GPU-based model optimization.
  3. Experience developing reward models, verifiers, graders, or automated evaluation systems.
  4. Research contributions to post-training, reinforcement learning, or related areas through publications, open-source projects, or production systems.
  5. Experience investigating synthetic data generation, curriculum learning, or iterative self-improvement techniques.

Compensation & Benefits Notice

The national pay range for this full-time position is base salary of $200,000 –$320,000. All employees are eligible for equity compensation, and employees may also receive performance-based bonuses, dependent on role and subject to company policies. micro1 provides a comprehensive benefits package, including up to 100% reimbursement for health-insurance premiums, paid time off, a 401(K) plan with a company match, and additional benefits designed to support a high-performing, remote-first workforce.

micro1 is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation during the application process, reach out to .

Our hiring process utilizes artificial intelligence tools to assist in candidate screening and assessment. Our AI tools are designed to complement, not replace, human decision-making.

Company Overview

raw.description:
We are looking for a Senior Routing Engine Developer to design and build the next generation interaction routing platform powering enterprise-scale contact center operation. You will develop the core routing engine responsible for intelligent distribution of voice and digital interactions across agents, queues, skills, channels, and business units in real time. The role includes building highly scalable backend services capable of processing large volumes of routing decisions with strict latency, availability, and resiliency requirements. You will work primarily with Java, Spring Boot, distributed architectures, event-driven systems, and cloud-native technologies, collaborating closely with product, architecture, workforce management, telephony, and CX platform teams.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop enterprise-scale routing engines that distribute voice and digital interactions in real time.
  • Implement intelligent routing algorithms based on skills, priorities, capacity, availability, and business rules.
  • Ensure high availability, scalability, resilience, and performance across queues, routing paths, and interaction workloads.
  • Design and maintain APIs supporting routing configuration, administration, monitoring, and integration requirements.
  • Optimize systems for high concurrency, fault tolerance, resiliency, and predictable performance.
  • Integrate routing services with telephony, digital messaging, workforce management, CRM, identity, reporting, and analytics platforms.
  • Design and develop critical Java and Spring Boot services, APIs, integration components, and reference implementations.
  • Translate business journeys and operational requirements into solution components, interaction flows, deployment views, and technical roadmaps.
  • Define non-functional requirements for availability, performance, concurrency, security, privacy, observability, disaster recovery, and supportability.
  • Review designs and code, identify technical risks, challenge assumptions, and drive pragmatic decisions that balance quality, time, and cost.
  • Establish engineering standards, reusable patterns, quality gates, documentation expectations, and technology adoption guidance.
  • Collaborate with CX domain experts to translate operational requirements into routing capabilities.
  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, including substantial ownership of architecture and technical delivery for distributed applications.
  • Expert-level hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, implementing distributed systems and microservices architectures, REST APIs, persistence, security, testing, and performance engineering.
  • Experience developing routing logic for contact center, communications, or customer engagement platforms.
  • Knowledge of ACD concepts, agent states, queue management, skill-based routing, priority routing, proficiency routing, and workload balancing.
  • Experience building high-throughput, low-latency transaction processing systems.Deep understanding of API-first design, event-driven architecture, messaging, distributed systems, and cloud-native engineering.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL or comparable relational databases, data modeling, integration data flows, and transactional design.
  • Hands-on experience with contact center or CX platforms and the operational concepts behind customer routing and engagement.
  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to produce clear technical documentation and lead client-facing workshops.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with real-time communications platforms such as FreeSWITCH or Kamailio.
  • Knowledge of optimization algorithms, decision engines, or scheduling systems.
  • Experience with Genesys, NICE, Five9, Amazon Connect, Cisco, Avaya, or comparable contact center platforms.
  • Exposure to WFM processes and integrations involving forecasting, schedules, adherence, etc.
  • Familiarity with Kafka or RabbitMQ, Kubernetes, Jenkins, observability platforms, API gateways, and security architecture.
  • Practical experience with AI-assisted software development or AI-enabled solutions, including tools such as Claude or GitHub Copilot, is a plus.

We offer:

  • Culture of Relentless Performance: join an unstoppable technology development team with a 99% project success rate and more than 30% year-over-year revenue growth.
  • Competitive Pay and Benefits: enjoy a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, and a relocation program.
  • Work From Anywhere Culture: make the most of the flexibility that comes with remote work.
  • Growth Mindset: reap the benefits of a range of professional development opportunities, including certification programs, mentorship and talent investment programs, internal mobility and internship opportunities.
  • Global Impact: collaborate on impactful projects for top global clients and shape the future of industries.
  • Welcoming Multicultural Environment: be a part of a dynamic, global team and thrive in an inclusive and supportive work environment with open communication and regular team-building company social events.
  • Social Sustainability Values: join our sustainable business practices focused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality.

* Miratech is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status under applicable law.

Miratech helps visionaries change the world. We are a global IT services and consulting company that brings together enterprise and start-up innovation. Today, we support digital transformation for some of the world's largest enterprises. By partnering with both large and small players, we stay at the leading edge of technology, remain nimble even as a global leader, and create technology that helps our clients further enhance their business. We are a values-driven organization and our culture of Relentless Performance has enabled over 99% of Miratech's engagements to succeed by meeting or exceeding our scope, schedule, and/or budget objectives since our inception in 1989.
Miratech has coverage across 5 continents and operates in over 25 countries around the world. Miratech retains nearly 1000 full-time professionals, and our annual growth rate exceeds 25%.

PTC Java Engineer- Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: PTC Java Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Windchill Java Customization Engineer focused on deep, low-level Windchill customizations using Java, PTC APIs, and PTC’s customization frameworks. This role suits engineers who enjoy working close to the platform, extending its behavior through services, listeners, and processors while preserving a clean and upgrade-friendly customization layer. The ideal candidate will bring strong Java fundamentals, deep familiarity with the Windchill platform internals, and a disciplined, performance-aware engineering style. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and develop advanced Java customizations within Windchill, including custom services, listeners, processors, validators, and helpers.
  • Extend the Windchill data model with custom types, attributes, and relationships using Type and Attribute Management (TAM).
  • Build custom JSP and HTML extensions, including custom tables, actions, and wizard pages.
  • Develop custom queues and background processes for asynchronous Windchill tasks.
  • Implement complex workflow expressions and robot delegates in Java, applying disciplined engineering practices and partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure outcomes are durable, well-documented, and aligned with broader team and platform standards.
  • Optimize performance of Java customizations, including profiling, query tuning, and caching strategies.
  • Adhere strictly to PTC customization best practices, ensuring upgrade-friendly customizations.
  • Lead migration efforts to retire legacy customizations to modern PTC-supported patterns, planning phased cutovers, building backward-compatibility shims where needed, and ensuring each migration step is reversible and well-monitored.
  • Conduct code reviews and uphold internal engineering standards, applying disciplined engineering practices and partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure outcomes are durable, well-documented, and aligned with broader team and platform standards.
  • Collaborate closely with functional consultants to translate complex requirements into clean Java designs.
  • Provide hands-on post-go-live and hypercare support, working closely with operations teams to triage incidents quickly, identify root causes, and drive durable fixes that improve long-term system stability.
  • Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures — so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.
  • Mentor and coach junior and mid-level engineers through code review, design review, pair programming, and structured knowledge sharing, helping the broader team grow in technical maturity and confidence over time.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of Java development experience, with strong focus on Windchill customization.
  • Deep, hands-on experience with the Windchill Java API and customization frameworks.
  • Solid understanding of Windchill data model, lifecycle, and workflow internals.
  • Strong Java OO design and performance-engineering skills.
  • Experience with JSP, HTML, and Windchill client-side customization.
  • Hands-on experience with Type and Attribute Management (TAM).
  • Strong SQL skills and familiarity with Oracle or SQL Server.
  • Experience supporting Windchill upgrades.
  • Excellent troubleshooting and documentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications
  • PTC Windchill development certifications.
  • Experience with PTC ThingWorx development.
  • Exposure to Windchill RV&S customization.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tooling for Windchill.
  • Experience operating Windchill in the cloud.

raw.excerpt: Why we existMost people with treatment-resistant depression, PTSD, or OCD spend years cycling through medications before anyone mentions there are other options.
raw.description:
Why we exist

Most people with treatment-resistant depression, PTSD, or OCD spend years cycling through medications before anyone mentions there are other options. Treatments like accelerated TMS, SAINT, Spravato, and IV ketamine can work when nothing else has. They're also hard to find, hard to get covered, and hard to deliver well. That gap is why Radial exists.

We support the country's largest network of brain medicine clinics: 27 clinics and more than 100 clinicians across seven states, caring for patients with some of the most serious mental health conditions there are. RadialOS, our AI-native operating system, matches patients to the right treatment, coordinates their care, and takes administrative work off clinicians' plates. We're backed by General Catalyst, and in 2026 we acquired the MSO behind Mindful Health Solutions, one of the pioneers of interventional psychiatry.

Every role here supports our mission of getting patients access to the care they need as quickly as possible.

The role

When a technician can't log in at 7 a.m., the first TMS patient of the day waits. When access isn't removed on someone's last day, patient data is exposed. At Radial, IT is part of how care gets delivered.

More than 250 people across 27 clinics and our corporate team run on systems inherited from two companies. You'll own all of it: every system we run that we don't build ourselves, from identity, devices, and clinic networks to our EHR, business applications, and the security program. Our engineering team builds RadialOS. You'll own everything around it and partner closely on how it all connects.

You'll lead a strong team and will set the strategy for our security policies. You'll serve as our HIPAA Security Officer yourself until that seat is filled.

Early on, that might mean laying two companies' tool lists side by side and deciding what survives, walking a clinic to see why the network drops during treatment hours, or sitting with your team to pick the requests that should never reach a human again.

What you'll do

  • Own Radial's systems strategy: decide what we run, what we consolidate, and what we retire, and make build, buy, and kill calls with data.
  • Lead the technical integration of two organizations across identity, endpoints, collaboration, networking, telephony, and business applications, consolidating overlapping systems and vendors.
  • Own our EHR and the other clinical and business systems we buy, partnering with engineering, which owns RadialOS and its integrations.
  • Keep clinics running: hardware, connectivity, and the devices that support patient care on site.
  • Own the security program and serve as the interim HIPAA Security Officer. You will manage risk assessments, access controls, vendor risk and BAAs, incident response, and audit readiness.
  • Replace the ticket queue with automation. Stand up an AI-native service desk where employees get help in Slack, routine requests like access, onboarding, and offboarding resolve without a human touching them, and your team builds approved, auditable workflows in plain language. You'll measure success by automation rate, not ticket volume.
  • Grant access just in time and remove it automatically, with an audit trail that makes HIPAA reviews easy.
  • Set the guardrails for how the whole company uses AI safely with patient data.
  • Lead, develop, and grow a team, setting the standard for how IT operates and how it treats the people it supports.
  • Own the IT budget and vendor relationships, and make our technology cost less per person as we grow.

Backgrounds we think could thrive here

  • IT leaders at high-growth tech companies who've owned the whole stack and made it modern and automated
  • Healthcare IT leaders at multi-site provider groups who want to move faster
  • IT leaders who've run integration across acquisitions at PE-backed companies
  • Business systems or IT operations leaders ready to own the full stack

This list isn't a checklist. If you see yourself in one of these, we'd like to talk. If you don't but the role still sounds like you, we'd like to talk too.

You may be a great fit if you

  • Have owned the full IT stack, not one slice, and can tell us what you consolidated and what it saved.
  • Have retired a legacy tool and nobody missed it.
  • Think about automation before headcount when the queue grows.
  • Can explain a security tradeoff to an executive in two minutes and to an auditor in a two-hour deep dive.
  • Have led IT through an acquisition and know what to consolidate first.
  • Are current on modern IT, including cloud identity, SSO and MFA, device management, and zero-trust access, and have run a HIPAA security program hands-on, with working knowledge of frameworks like SOC 2 or HITRUST.
  • Have a team that would say you made them better.
  • Use AI in your own work, have automated real IT operations with it, and have a clear view of the risks.

Nice to have

  • Experience deploying an AI-native service management or help desk automation platform
  • Healthcare provider or health tech experience
  • Experience administering an EHR or practice management system
  • Scripting and automation skills

How we work

Work backwards from the patient. We start with what a patient experiences and build back from there. Sometimes that means launching later, or killing something that looks great on a dashboard but doesn't help anyone get treated.

Urgency with care. Many of our patients arrive after years of treatments that didn't work, and every week of delay costs them. We move fast. We also work with people at their most vulnerable, so we never trade safety or dignity for speed.

Write it down. We decide in writing. Meetings start with silent reading of a PRFAQ or short doc, so the best argument wins instead of the loudest voice. It's slower to write and faster to decide.

Conviction with an open mind. Bring a point of view and argue for it. Change your mind when someone shows you something better, not when they push harder. Once the call is made, back it as if it were yours.

Own the problem, not the lane. Go to where the work happens and learn the details until you understand them better than anyone. If a patient is waiting because of a broken handoff two teams away, it's yours until it's fixed or clearly in someone else's hands. Clinical decisions stay with our clinicians: your job is to raise the issue, not make the call.

Our commitment

Our patients come from every background, and we design for the ones the system has served worst. We build teams the same way. Radial is an equal opportunity employer. We don't discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

Plenty of great candidates rule themselves out too early. If you care about this problem but don't check every box, apply and let us make that call after we've talked.

raw.title: Senior Product Manager - Delivery/Client Solutions & AI (Remote-CDMX)
raw.excerpt: Sobre el rolEn DaCodes buscamos un/a Senior Product Manager – Delivery / Client Solutions & AI para liderar proyectos digitales desde el entendimiento inicial del problema hasta la definición y entrega de la solución.
raw.description:
Sobre el rol

En DaCodes buscamos un/a Senior Product Manager – Delivery / Client Solutions & AI para liderar proyectos digitales desde el entendimiento inicial del problema hasta la definición y entrega de la solución.

Este no es un rol de Product Management enfocado únicamente en administrar un backlog, ni un Project Manager centrado en ceremonias, seguimiento y tableros.

Buscamos a alguien capaz de entrar a una conversación con un cliente cuando la solución todavía no está completamente definida, entender cómo funciona su negocio y sus procesos, hacer las preguntas correctas, identificar el problema que realmente necesita resolverse y convertir ese entendimiento en una solución digital que diseño e ingeniería puedan construir.

La posición combina Product Management, Business Discovery, Client Consulting y Software Delivery, incorporando además Inteligencia Artificial como una herramienta práctica para analizar, explorar, prototipar y validar soluciones.

Reportará al Head of Project Managers y trabajará directamente con clientes, diseño y equipos de ingeniería en proyectos de software, procesos de Discovery y oportunidades relacionadas con IA.

Requirements

En DaCodes desarrollamos productos de software a la medida para startups, empresas medianas y grandes. Buscamos a alguien que tome los proyectos desde antes de que exista una solución definida y los lleve hasta su entrega, con autonomía y apoyándose en IA para hacer más con menos.

No buscamos un Project Manager tradicional que administre un tablero. Buscamos a una persona multifacética: que conduzca el discovery con el cliente, convierta lo que escucha en una especificación que el equipo pueda construir, negocie el alcance con criterio, y cuando haga falta, use IA para avanzar en diseño, documentación o pruebas sin esperar a que alguien más se libere.

Qué vas a hacer

Discovery con clientes

  • Conducir sesiones de discovery, desde exprés de 1 o 2 sesiones hasta procesos más profundos, para entender el negocio, la operación, los usuarios y el problema real del cliente.
  • Levantar cómo funciona hoy el proceso: quién participa, con qué volumen, qué sistemas usan y dónde vive la información.
  • Entregar documentación de negocio y técnica (diagramas, flujos, alcance) que sirva como base para estimar y construir.

Definición de producto a nivel especificación

  • Convertir requerimientos ambiguos en soluciones construibles, definiendo roles y permisos, estados, reglas de negocio, excepciones, notificaciones, trazabilidad, integraciones y el alcance mínimo de la primera entrega.
  • Definir junto con UX/UI el comportamiento esperado antes de que ingeniería empiece.
  • Escribir user stories y criterios de aceptación verificables, y priorizar el backlog según valor de negocio, riesgo, esfuerzo y viabilidad.

Gestión de alcance y relación con el cliente

  • Ser el punto de contacto principal del cliente durante todo el proyecto.
  • Cuando el cliente pida algo fuera de alcance, plantear opciones con su impacto en fecha, costo o alcance, y dejar los acuerdos por escrito.
  • Comunicar riesgos y retrasos a tiempo, antes de que el cliente los detecte.

Delivery de punta a punta

  • Tomar ownership de los proyectos desde el kickoff hasta el cierre y el handover.
  • Coordinar el trabajo entre el cliente, UX/UI, ingeniería, QA y otros stakeholders, gestionando dependencias, riesgos y desviaciones.
  • Facilitar las estimaciones con el equipo técnico.
  • Trabajar con metodologías ágiles (Scrum, Kanban o una mezcla) eligiendo la cadencia que el proyecto necesita, no la del manual.
  • Llevar varios proyectos en paralelo, con clientes e industrias distintas.
  • Conocer a fondo la plataforma que se construye: probarla, detectar problemas y poder explicarla al cliente aunque no esté el equipo técnico.

IA aplicada al trabajo

  • Usar IA en todo el ciclo: para analizar información del cliente, prototipar, documentar, generar casos de prueba y automatizar tareas.
  • Apoyar al equipo de diseño, desarrollo o QA con herramientas de IA cuando un proyecto lo requiera, sabiendo dónde sí se necesita a un especialista.

Cómo es el equipo

Cada proyecto se arma según su complejidad. La base suele ser PM, Tech Lead, AI Engineer y QA, y según el caso se suman desarrolladores front y back y diseño UX/UI. Tú lideras al equipo y eres el puente con el cliente.

Lo que buscamos

Imprescindible

  • 5+ años en Product Management, Product Ownership, Business Analysis o consultoría digital, en proyectos de software con clientes externos.
  • Casos propios en los que hayas conducido un discovery y definido qué construir y qué no.
  • Experiencia bajando requerimientos al nivel de detalle que un equipo de ingeniería necesita para construir.
  • Experiencia negociando alcance, fechas o presupuesto con clientes.
  • Uso real de IA más allá de redactar textos: prototipos, automatizaciones, agentes o validación de soluciones.
  • Conocimiento del ciclo de vida del desarrollo de software y del diseño.
  • Inglés B2 a C1 para conducir sesiones con clientes sin apoyo.

Deseable

  • Experiencia en consultoras, nearshore o agencias con varios clientes a la vez.
  • Base técnica: APIs, integraciones, bases de datos.
  • Certificaciones en IA o cloud, por ejemplo AWS o Anthropic.

Este rol probablemente no es para ti si...

  • Tu experiencia principal es administrar ceremonias, tableros o portafolios con marcos como SAFe.
  • Prefieres recibir requerimientos ya definidos en lugar de construirlos con el cliente.
  • Buscas un rol solo estratégico o de dirección, sin involucrarte en el detalle.
  • Buscas un rol de desarrollo o de AI Engineering.

Benefits

🚀 Integración a marcas globales y startups disruptivas.

🏡 Trabajo remoto/Home office.

📍 En caso de requerir modalidad híbrida o presencial, serás informado desde la primera sesión.
⏳ Horario ajustado a la célula de trabajo/proyecto asignado.
📅 Trabajo de lunes a viernes.
🎉 Día off en tu cumpleaños.
🏥 Seguro de gastos médicos mayores (aplica para México).
🛡️ Seguro de vida (aplica para México).
🌎 Equipos de trabajo multiculturales.
🎓 Acceso a cursos y certificaciones.
📢 Meetups con invitados especiales del área de IT.
📡 Eventos virtuales de integración y grupos de interés.
📢 Clases de inglés.
🏆 Oportunidades dentro de nuestras diferentes líneas de negocio.
🏅 Orgullosamente certificados como Great Place to Work.

raw.description:
Primary Function of Position:

This position will have the opportunity to make a direct impact to Intuitive US Marketing initiatives that deliver da Vinci Surgery to patients worldwide. With the direction and guidance of the US Clinical Marketing leaders, you will develop, drive, and support the US marketing efforts for General Surgery and Acute Care, including Hernia, Cholecystectomy and Appendectomy. You will have a particular focus on working with a cross-functional team of leaders to develop the market for and grow procedures with the use of the da Vinci Surgical System and its associated products.

This position will be responsible for development and coordination of various strategic and tactical clinical marketing initiatives to drive procedure growth within the US General Surgery business. The individual will be expected to establish strong relationships with the marketing and sales teams, external Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), as well as internal ISI stakeholders such as other marketing departments, training, clinical affairs, legal, regulatory, and Market Access / Health Economics.

Essential Job Duties:

The individual will be expected to establish strong relationships with marketing and sales teams, external Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), surgical society leaders, as well as internal ISI stakeholders such as other marketing departments, training, clinical affairs, legal, regulatory, and Market Access / Health Economics.

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Lead development and execution of integrated marketing strategies that accelerate da Vinci adoption in General Surgery, with a focus on da Vinci 5 and SP.
  • Build & execute high impact marketing plans and corresponding tactical plans / programs to achieve budgeted growth projections in key areas of General Surgery.
  • Develop qualitative and quantitative data and experiences to segment and deeply understand existing and new markets, the surgeon, their practice, the patient journey, and the clinical procedure steps.
  • Utilize market knowledge to design and develop strategies and value messaging (clinical, economic, operational, strategic), collateral, tactics, and programs with demonstrated ROI.
  • Assimilate market trends and their potential implications to current and future work/projects. Understand competition and develop competitive differentiation.
  • Contribute to budget, resource allocation and financial planning for projects / programs with measured ROI to justify through multiple marketing / media channels (webinars, sales collateral, etc.)
  • Work with Key Opinion Leader surgeons to better understand how the da Vinci Surgical System and instruments are being utilized and determine how to communicate that value proposition to other physicians.
  • Develop and build KOLs by market segment with the goal of making Intuitive the preferred industry collaborator.
  • Build relationships with key society members / leaders to establish a higher level of engagement to ensure Intuitive is seen as an integral collaborator when planning congresses and implementing guidelines.
  • Coordinate trade show activities, digital & website development, strategies, and tracking of marketing campaigns to evaluate results and provide recommendations for future marketing promotions.
  • Coach other Marketing colleagues in on-boarding, learning marketing standards, and growing their business acumen (clinical, hospital, or academic).
  • Lead cross-functional teams to deliver high value marketing projects and programs.
  • Deliver impactful presentations to senior and executive Intuitive leadership.
  • Be a market expert in the areas of General Surgery and Acute Care – effectively leveraging the value propositions, approved claims, surgeon feedback, and sales input to maximize Intuitive’s footprint and growth trajectory in this area.
  • Be a champion of the Intuitive culture; learning and embodying the company’s individual expectations for success.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 12 plus years of marketing experience in a therapeutic medical device company preferred.
  • Proven ability to align diverse teams and use influence marketing strategies to drive business impact.
  • Results-driven attitude & a resolve to win; must be self-directed with the ability to work with minimal supervision.
  • Proven ability to solve open-ended problems and work cross-functionally to implement initiatives.
  • Excellent verbal/written communication and presentation skills, teambuilding, and relational skills to work across multiple constituents.
  • Bachelor degree required, MBA or Masters degree preferred.
  • Must be well versed in MS Office Suite.

Working Conditions:

  • Must be available to work full-time hours.
  • Ability to travel up to 50%

We are an AA/EEO/Veterans/Disabled employer.

Due to the nature of our business and the role, please note that Intuitive and/or your customer(s) may require that you show current proof of vaccination against certain diseases including COVID-19. Details can vary by role.

Intuitive is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, without regard to race, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, genetic information or any other status protected under federal, state, or local applicable laws.

Mandatory Notices

U.S. Export Controls Disclaimer: In accordance with the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (15 CFR §743.13(b)), some roles at Intuitive Surgical may be subject to U.S. export controls for prospective employees who are nationals from countries currently on embargo or sanctions status.

Certain information you provide as part of the application will be used for purposes of determining whether Intuitive Surgical will need to (i) obtain an export license from the U.S. Government on your behalf (note: the government’s licensing process can take 3 to 6+ months) or (ii) implement a Technology Control Plan (“TCP”) (note: typically adds 2 weeks to the hiring process).

For any Intuitive role subject to export controls, final offers are contingent upon obtaining an approved export license and/or an executed TCP prior to the prospective employee’s start date, which may or may not be flexible, and within a timeframe that does not unreasonably impede the hiring need. If applicable, candidates will be notified and instructed on any requirements for these purposes.

We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with fair chance laws.

This position may be filled at a different job level than listed here depending on
business need and/or on the selected candidate’s experience, knowledge and skills.
Compensation will be based primarily on the job level at which the role is filled and the
candidate’s qualifications, consistent with applicable law.

Accommodation & Accessibility Notice:

Intuitive is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you require assistance or an accommodation during any part of the application or interview process, please contact People Services at .

We provide market-competitive compensation packages, inclusive of base pay, incentives, benefits, and equity. It would not be typical for someone to be hired at the top end of range for the role, as actual pay will be determined based on several factors, including experience, skills, and qualifications. The target base compensation ranges are listed.

It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive. As a global leader in robotic-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care, our technologies—like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.

We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.

The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.

If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare, you’ll find your purpose here.

raw.description:
Cardinal Health, Inc. (NYSE: CAH) is a global healthcare services and products company. We provide customized solutions for hospitals, healthcare systems, pharmacies, ambulatory surgery centers, clinical laboratories, physician offices and patients in the home. We are a distributor of pharmaceuticals and specialty products; a global manufacturer and distributor of medical and laboratory products; an operator of nuclear pharmacies and manufacturing facilities; and a provider of performance and data solutions. Working to be healthcare’s most trusted partner, our customer-centric focus drives continuous improvement and leads to innovative solutions that improve the lives of people every day. With approximately 50,000 employees worldwide, Cardinal Health ranks among the top fifteen in the Fortune 500.


Department Overview:

Information Security and Risk develops, implements, and enforces security controls to protect the organization's technology assets from intentional or inadvertent modification, disclosure, or destruction. The function of this job family is to ensure secure, authorized, and compliant access to the organization's data, systems, and physical resources. It focuses on defining, creating, managing, and governing digital identities and their associated access privileges to protect the enterprise from security breaches, insider threats, and regulatory non-compliance


We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Identity and Access Management (IAM) Engineer to join our Workforce Identity team. In this pivotal role, you will be instrumental in designing, implementing, and managing IAM solutions that secure our global workforce and enterprise applications and facilitate the secure, efficient, and seamless integration of identity and access systems in context of our rapid growth through Mergers and Acquisitions. You will ensure robust access controls, streamline user experiences, and maintain operational continuity across our diverse IT landscape. By automating lifecycle events, integrating HR systems, and building intuitive self-service pathways, you will directly influence workforce productivity, security posture, and overall onboarding experience. The ideal candidate will have deep technical expertise in modern IAM principles, protocols and products along with strong management and communication skills.


Responsibilities:

M&A and SSO Integration

  • Lead IAM technical workstreams for Mergers, Acquisitions, and Divestitures.
  • Consolidate disparate identity providers (IdPs) into a unified enterprise SSO platform.
  • Design and execute cross-domain authentication and federation strategies to migrate or merge user populations under tight timelines.

Automation and Workflows

raw.description:
About the Role

Optical Training Institute (OTI) is hiring an Optical Learning Experience Designer to create training that drives skill development and measurable on-the-job performance for optical practices. You’ll leverage OTI’s content library and author network to shape learning that is clear, concise, and job-realistic and you’ll convert lessons into interactive practice (decision points, branching scenarios, troubleshooting flows, “what would you do next?” moments) built for mobile and short sessions.

You’ll also write and record new multimedia content when technology changes or gaps emerge (short videos, webinars, podcasts, micro-lessons). In addition, you’ll review content from authors and SMEs to maintain accuracy, consistency, and a strong instructional voice, and you’ll support learners and practice teams by answering content and course-experience questions and troubleshooting common issues.

This is an ideal opportunity for an experienced optical professional who is also an excellent teacher, trainer, and communicator. We’re looking for someone who can translate real-world optical expertise into clear, modern, skill-focused learning so teams can perform confidently on the job.

Role Overview

Design engaging course content

  • Leverage OTI’s content library and author network to create training that drives skill development and measurable performance improvement for practices

  • Edit and refine course structure to be clear, concise, and job-realistic, using practical examples engaging elements and realistic training scenarios

  • Transform static content into interactive learning (decision points, branching scenarios, troubleshooting flows, “what would you do next?” practice)

  • Ensure learning is mobile-friendly and easy to complete in short sessions

Write and record new course material

  • Write and record new content when gaps exist in current programs or when technology changes

  • Produce multimedia learning: short videos, webinars, podcasts, and micro-lessons with scripts, run-of-show plans, and lesson outlines

  • Build roleplays, scenario banks, and quick job aids that support on-the-job execution

Review content to maintain quality and consistency

  • Review and improve content from authors and SMEs for technical accuracy, clarity, and consistent instructional voice

  • Use learner and customer feedback to clarify common confusion points and continuously raise the quality bar

  • Help strengthen OTI templates, standards, and repeatable production systems

Support learners and practice teams

  • Answer content and course-experience questions; troubleshoot common learning issues and escalate technical items when needed

  • Identify patterns from support interactions to inform course priorities and platform/product improvements

Additional Considerations

Qualifications:

  • ABO Master or Advanced certification strongly preferred

  • Experience teaching optics at the college level or leading optical training in a professional role (or equivalent adult/professional education).

  • Significant hands-on optical experience, including dispensing and practical application of optical concepts.

  • Experience building and leading training programs (in an academic, retail, or multi-location environment).

  • Strong writing skills with the ability to make complex topics clear, practical, and learner-friendly.

  • Comfort working directly with customers/learners and handling a portion of customer support responsibilities.

  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to own outcomes in a fast-paced environment.

Personal Attributes:

  • Learner-obsessed and committed to delivering value through education.

  • High standards for accuracy, clarity, and “real-world usefulness.”

  • Strong communicator and relationship builder with high EQ

  • Growth-minded and energized by improving systems and processes

  • Operates with integrity, accountability, and professionalism

  • Excited to contribute to a growing, mission-driven organization

About the Company

Optical Training Institute (OTI) is the all-in-one learning and development platform for eyecare professionals. For over 30 years, we’ve supported more than 30,000 learners across the optical industry with high-quality, affordable education that strengthens clinical skills, supports career growth, and improves the patient experience.

OTI’s platform includes tools for hiring and skill assessments, onboarding, job training, certification preparation, and continuing education. Our expert-developed curriculum helps eyecare teams stay ahead of industry trends, meet regulatory requirements, and enhance patient care.

By streamlining professional development in one convenient platform, OTI empowers both individuals and employers to build stronger, more engaged teams while simplifying training, compliance, and certification processes.

With 340+ locations and a nationwide hybrid care model, we serve over 175,000 clients annually through more than 1.7 million sessions, and we're growing. In addition to working directly with clients, we partner with health systems and primary care providers because we believe mental health is inseparable from physical health. As a clinician-led organization, we're built to support the people who do this work with the tools, community, and stability you need to build a career that lasts.

About the Role
We’re hiring licensed clinicians to provide compassionate, evidence-based care to our more than 175,000 clients across the country. You may be a good fit for this role if you’re:

  • Independently licensed and living in Wyoming — LPC, LMFT, LCSW, PhD (Licensed Psychologist)

  • Consistently available to clients for a minimum of 15 sessions with 20 hours of availability weekly

  • A behavioral health generalist who is open to treating a variety of clients, including couples and children

  • Invested in helping your clients achieve measurable progress

  • Confident working with modern clinical technology, including telehealth and EHR tools

  • A good teammate — we’re building a clinical community and value positive contributors

Compensation
Up to $54,100 based on licensure type, session volume, and bonus opportunities.

How We Support You
We handle the administrative work so you can focus on what you do best: providing exceptional care. That means credentialing, billing, scheduling, and marketing support taken care of for you, plus paid orientation and training to get you started. You'll build a full caseload within 90 days of credentialing, with flexible scheduling available seven days a week from 7 a.m. to 10 p.m. ET.

Benefits

  • As a W2 employee, you'll be eligible to receive:
  • Guaranteed bi-weekly pay for completed sessions
  • 401(k) with employer matching
  • Paid time off
  • CEU reimbursement and free in-house training
  • Opportunities for paid clinical supervisor roles in select states

Our Community
Being a clinician can feel isolating, especially in a telehealth world. We're built to make sure it doesn't. You'll have access to live clinical support, monthly case consultations, and a vibrant online and in-person community of more than 2,700 licensed providers. All clinical leadership is promoted from within, so the people supporting you have been exactly where you are.

Ready to Join Us?
Apply today to become part of a team that’s changing mental health care for clients and clinicians alike.


Interested in joining Team Thriveworks? We're thrilled to meet you!


With Job scams becoming more and more frequent, here's how to know you're speaking with a real member of our team:

About DealerOn

We are an online marketing company providing website and agency services to automotive dealerships across North and South America. We are known for our cutting-edge products that streamline the car buying process and provide an experience both shoppers and dealers love. Our business model is working: we were recognized on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest growing companies six years in a row, expanding to over 30 manufacturer relationship, and over 5,000 dealer partners. We are proud of what our company has done, and it’s all due to the talented and diverse team we’ve been lucky enough to assemble.

Job Description:

The Director, Training & Development is responsible for employee knowledge and skills development for DealerOn employees. The Director is responsible for partnering with the company leaders to develop and execute strategies that improve the organization’s knowledge, product skills, customer effectiveness, employee growth, and retention. The primary focus for this position is to drive the business forward by developing employee knowledge and skill proficiencies, improving operational efficiency, and a learning environment that attracts and retains top talent. This role leads the training team, manages, and mentors the team’s staff, including establishing, collaborating on, and measuring individual and team goals. The position reports to and collaborates with the Senior VP of Customer Success to define and formalize and implement department standards and SOP; and works closely with cross functional leaders to ensure a clear and shared understanding of processes.

Essential Functions:

  • Establish and maintain relationships and effectively communicate with peers, business unit leaders and senior management to ensure a collaborative corporate environment.
  • Work with DealerOn leaders to develop long-term knowledge and skills growth plans and to determine how we prioritize and invest training resources.
  • Ensure that effective onboarding training programs are identified, designed, and implemented that deliver effective new hire and ongoing technical and training curriculum.
  • Ensure that an effective ongoing refresher and coaching program is identified, designed, and implemented that produces high quality customer-facing soft skills and communication proficiencies.
  • Own the strategy, standards and governance for the Salesforce Knowledge base, including content ownership, review cadence and retirement of outdated articles, so employees and AI tools can rely on it as the trusted source of truth.
  • Train Success Managers (CSMs) to serve as consultants to Dealers, guiding them on DealerOn's value proposition and providing consultative support to ensure training initiatives contribute significantly to the company's investment.
  • Define and report on measures that tie training to business results, such as time for new hires to get up to speed, quality and error rates, and customer retention. Set team OKRs and individual KPIs against those measures and adjust programs based on the results.
  • Collaborate with team leadership and HR to develop certification paths that support skill development and career growth.
  • Ensure certification programs align with team goals and create clear advancement opportunities.
  • Manage overall team staffing, including recruitment, performance management, development, evaluation, and disciplinary actions.
  • Collaborate with the Support, Inventory, Product, Sales and Operations teams to ensure that all new training materials, tools, and processes are effectively delivered to their team.
  • Provide employees with coaching, feedback, and developmental opportunities to enhance their skills, motivation, and performance.
  • Develop, document, implement and enforce operational policies and procedures via our internal knowledge base and LMS.
  • Stay current on all products and processes by working with department management. Ensure that all employees are trained on the most current information.
  • Partner with Product and Marketing to build a release-readiness process that ensures training, knowledge articles and go-to-market enablement are in place before new products and features reach customers.
  • Utilize a value-driven approach to design training programs that maximize the impact and effectiveness of DealerOn's investment.
  • Apply innovative instructional design and learning technology, including AI, to create engaging, role-specific training that builds proficiency faster and scales with the business.
  • Combine industry knowledge with hands-on experience to deliver training initiatives that drive results and contribute to the overall success of DealerOn.

What Success Looks Like:

  • New hires follow a consistent onboarding path, shared by training and the departments, and the time it takes to get up to speed is measured.
  • Training builds customer and industry knowledge alongside tool skills, so employees understand why they do the work, not just how.
  • Training and knowledge articles are ready before every major product release.
  • Salesforce Knowledge has clear owners and a review cadence, so people trust it and the AI tools that rely on it.
  • Training is tied to two or three business metrics that CS, Support and Product leaders agree matter.
  • The training team has visible career paths and improving engagement scores.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Education, Computer Science, Marketing, Project Management, Business Administration, or equivalent program.
  • Demonstrated success and 7+ years of experience in leadership, ideally specific to technical training and / or technical support in the automotive industry.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to present complex technical issues clearly and concisely to a general audience.
  • Act as a change leader with demonstrated passion about customer support and employee development.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills with a service mindset that balances the needs of the company and employees.
  • Able to multi-task and work in a fast-paced, energetic, and continuously evolving environment.
  • Proactive approach to accomplishing work, high attention to detail and accuracy, has consistent follow up, and strong organizational skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills that motivate the department and safeguards OEM/customer relationships.
  • Previous experience with Learning Management Systems (LMS) such as TalentLMS and Salesforce Knowledge.
  • Extensive experience from the automotive/IT background, having responsibility for upskilling a large learner population.
  • Proven track record of running successful training programs with a deep understanding of strategic consulting within the Account Management Process.

Preferred Skills/Experience:

  • Previous experience (2+ years) working in and knowledge of the automotive industry.
  • Previous management experience in a technical support environment.
  • Previous experience developing and delivering technical and soft skill training.
  • Experience working in a high-tech, software, or SaaS company.
  • Strong management skills with attention to detail.

This position is open to US residents only.

The targeted salary range for this position is $90,000 - $150,000.

The posted salary range for this position may be adjusted based on job-related factors permitted by law, such as experience and training; internal pay equity; licensure and certifications; market factors; departmental budgets; and responsibility. Our Talent Acquisition Team will be happy to answer any questions.

Perks and Benefits:

Aside from the awesome people you will get to interact with on a daily basis, we offer a number of benefits, including:

  • Medical, dental and vision insurance
  • Company matched 401K plan
  • Flexible PTO + Sick Leave
  • 6 weeks paid Parental Leave
  • 8 Paid National Holidays
  • Company-paid basic Life Insurance
  • Voluntary supplemental Life Insurance
  • Voluntary long-term/short-term disability insurance
  • Voluntary Pet Insurance
  • Optional Healthcare/Dependent Care FSA Account

DealerOn is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We also participate in E-Verify (for more information, click here: E-Verify Participation and Right to Work). A successful candidate must pass a background check as a condition of joining the team.
