Forward Deployed Engineer (Data, ML & AI)

Location: Remote Timezone: NA/Eastern Type: Full-time Experience: 10+ Years


Role Overview

This position requires a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) specializing in Data, Machine Learning, and AI to embed directly within customer environments. You will serve as the primary technical authority transforming complex data challenges and operational bottlenecks into production-grade data pipelines, machine learning systems, and agentic AI solutions.

The role is heavily customer-facing: you will work alongside client business units and engineering teams to rapidly assess legacy data estates, build scalable modern data platforms, and deploy custom GenAI/LLM workflows that drive measurable business velocity. This is a high-ownership, hands-on role where you will leverage Spec-Driven Development (SDD) and AI-assisted workflows to build, refactor, and demonstrate immediate value directly where the customer operates.


Key Responsibilities

  • Customer Embedding & Data Delivery: Deploy directly into customer environments to understand their domain logic, underlying data pipelines, and architectural constraints. Own end-to-end delivery—from data discovery and schema design to pipeline deployment and model integration—building trust as the customer's lead technical partner.
  • Data Platform & Architectural Modernization: Partner with client business leaders to evaluate legacy technology estates (e.g., monolithic SQL databases, or unmaintained ETL jobs). Lead engineering efforts to refactor legacy data setups into modern lakehouses, event-driven streaming systems, and scalable vector/graph databases.
  • Spec-Driven Development (SDD) for Data & AI: Apply a "spec-first" engineering workflow using Generative AI tools. Write structured specifications (data models, API schemas, transformations, and evaluation metrics) that instruct AI agents to generate production data models, PySpark jobs, data pipelines, and test suites.
  • Agentic AI & LLMOps Implementation: Architect and deploy GenAI workflows, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, and autonomous AI agents using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or DSPy. Establish robust evaluation frameworks (Evals) for model accuracy, latency, and hallucination control.
  • Production MLOps & Orchestration: Build, deploy, and maintain robust ML training and inference pipelines using tools like MLflow, Kubeflow, Airflow, or Dagster. Ensure continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) for models and data workflows.
  • Polyglot Data Engineering: Design and audit production code across data-centric languages and frameworks (Python, SQL, Scala, Go, Rust, or TypeScript) based on speed, concurrency, and memory requirements.
  • Client Enablement & Knowledge Transfer: Elevate customer teams by establishing reusable agentic development patterns, modern MLOps practices, data reliability frameworks, and SDD methodologies so systems remain maintainable long after deployment.

Requirements

  • 10+ Years of Experience: Proven track record as a Principal Data Engineer, Lead ML Engineer, or Enterprise Data Architect building and scaling distributed data and ML platforms.
  • Customer-Facing Aptitude: Strong executive presence and communication skills to interface directly with technical teams and business stakeholders under pressure.
  • Data & ML Engineering Depth:
    • Data Infrastructure: Mastery of distributed computing (AWS Glue, Apache Spark, Databricks), modern data warehouses (Redshift, Snowflake, modeling tools (dbt), and data orchestration (Airflow, etc)
    • AI/ML & Vector Architecture: Hands-on experience fine-tuning, evaluating, and deploying LLMs, embedding models, and vector stores
    • Polyglot & Framework Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in Python and complex SQL, plus fluency in at least two other languages used in modern backend/data systems (e.g., Scala, Go, Rust, TypeScript).
  • Generative AI & SDD Experience: Demonstrated skill in using natural language and structured specs to guide AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) in generating data pipelines, schemas, and API adapters.
  • Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with cloud-native data services on AWS or Azure, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).
  • Willingness to Travel: Comfort with occasional travel to customer sites as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience in a Forward Deployed Engineer, Data Architect, or technical consulting/professional services role.
  • Experience migrating legacy, on-premise data warehouses or legacy Hadoop estates to modern cloud lakehouses.
  • Deep understanding of data governance, security compliance (HIPAA, SOC2, GDPR), and privacy-preserving machine learning.

Compensation & Perks

  • Competitive compensation package (160K - 180K CAD / year)
  • Retirement Savings Matching Program (RRSP)
  • Access to the latest tech
  • Partnership with Perkopolis Discounts

Flexibility & Time Off

  • Remote first work environment
  • Flexible work hours & location
  • Paid parental leave options

Health & Wellness

  • Employer paid health & dental premiums
  • GreenShield+ Counselling Mental Health
  • $500 in Health Care Spending Account annually

Growth & Development

  • Peer recognition rewards

We look for people who thrive in an environment of accountability and at times ambiguity as we adapt and grow our business.

Position Description & Requirements

Radiology Associates of Florida (RAF), a Radiology Partners practice, is seeking a Remote Neuroradiologist to join our growing team.This opportunity offers the flexibility and convenience of working from home while providing the stability, collaboration, and clinical excellence of a premier hybrid academic-private practice.

Unlike traditional nationwide teleradiology models,you'lldevelop meaningful relationships with referring physicians and colleagues while serving a focused regional client base. Our collaborative environment ensures that no radiologist works in isolation, with subspecialty support readily available and a team-oriented approach to patient care.

Flexible Scheduling Options

We offer multiple scheduling options designed to fit your lifestyle and career goals, including:

  • Monday through Friday daytime schedules
  • Evening shifts (2:00 PM to 11:00 PM)
  • 7-on / 7-off rotations
  • 12-on / 9-off rotations
  • Alternative scheduling arrangements available based on candidate preferences

Position Highlights

  • 100% remote work from anywhere in the United States
  • Approximately70% Neuroradiologywith a mix of general and emergency radiology
  • Collaboration with neurosurgeons on pre-operative, intra-operative, and post-operative imaging assessments
  • Participation in neuro-oncology imaging, including tumor detection, staging, and treatment monitoring
  • Strong subspecialty support with case distribution tailored to yourexpertise

LOCAL PRACTICE AND COMMUNITY OVERVIEW

RAF is the largest radiology practice in Florida. We serve the most prestigious,establishedhealth systems in the state, including on the east and west coasts, the Florida Panhandle, and the Keys. Our scale affords our practice stability and affords our radiologists flexibility in study mix and scheduling. We also recognize that scale alone does not beget excellence. We are quality-oriented, and we practice radiology at thecutting edge, encouraging subspecialty-level interpretations across the practice, andfacilitatingcollaboration and consultation between our radiologists.

Ourstate-of-the-artIT suite includes universal PACS across the practice, AI tools, and integrated doc-to-doc communication widgets. Mosaic Reporting™ uses ambient AI and large language models (LLMs) to structure reports as you speak naturally. You can dictate as ifyou’reteaching a fellow. Just describe what you see, and Mosaic builds the structured report automatically, even inserting normal findings for you.

Our practice is locally and democratically led, with decisions vested in the hands of the group at large, rather than in a few founders or a small group of shareholders. We are the teaching physicians for the University of South Florida Department of Radiology in Tampa. In Sarasota, our physicians’staffthe Florida State University College of Medicine, hosting medical students in their 3rd and 4th years. We also invite residents from the FSU Internal Medicine and Emergency Medicine Residency programs to rotate in our departments.

Our diverse group of radiologists work and socialize together in our communities around Florida. Even between our communities across the state, we are one practice. We look forward to letting you get to knowusbetter!

Get to know our practice!

  • Board eligible or certified by the American Board of Radiology or the American Osteopathic Board of Radiology
  • Candidates with fellowship training in Neuroradiologyispreferred.
  • Medical license or the ability to obtain a license in the state of FL

Final determinations may vary based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, certifications, geographic location etc. This role is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. In addition to this range, Radiology Partners offers competitive total rewards packages, which include health & wellness coverage options, 401k benefits, and a broad range of other benefits such as family planning and telehealth (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements).

For inquiries about this position, please contact Nicole Maclin 843-300-1623.

Radiology Partners, through its affiliated practices, is a leading radiology practice in the U.S., serving hospitals and other healthcare facilities across the nation. As a physician-led and physician-owned practice, we advance our bold mission by innovating across clinical value, technology,serviceand economics, while elevating the role of radiology and radiologists in healthcare. Using a proven healthcare services model, Radiology Partners provides consistent, high-quality care to patients, while delivering enhanced value to the hospitals, clinics, imagingcentersand referring physicians we serve.

Senior Client Representative, Commercial – Job Description

Position Summary

The Senior Client Representative (SCR) serves as a primary point of contact for clients, managing ongoing service needs, policy changes, and client communications. This role is responsible for delivering high-quality, compliant service while supporting account teams in achieving client retention, satisfaction, and growth. The role is both operational and hands-on, with increasing responsibility for complex accounts, mentorship, and leadership support.

Key Responsibilities

Functional Leadership & Ownership

  • Owns and manages client service lifecycle including renewals, changes, and ongoing service needs.
  • Acts as subject matter expert for client accounts and insurance policies.
  • Maintains accountability for accuracy, compliance, and documentation across all service activities.

Hands-On Execution & Delivery

  • Processes policy changes, endorsements, and documentation through carrier portals and EPIC system.
  • Prepares submissions, certificates, summaries, and client deliverables.
  • Reviews policies and renewals for accuracy prior to delivery.
  • Handles billing processes, cancellations, reinstatements, and audits.

Reporting, Quality & Operational Support

  • Maintains accurate client data in EPIC including coverage, limits, and endorsements.
  • Tracks activity, deadlines, and outstanding items ensuring timely completion.
  • Ensures high-quality service delivery aligned to E&O and compliance standards.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Integration

  • Collaborates with Client Managers, Executives, and internal departments.
  • Communicates client needs, risks, and opportunities to account teams.
  • Supports claims reporting and coordination with carriers and internal teams.

Growth, Change & Special Initiatives

  • Supports onboarding, training, and mentorship of junior team members.
  • Identifies cross-selling opportunities and contributes to account growth.
  • Participates in operational improvements and strategic initiatives.

Process Improvement & Best Practices

  • Continuously improves workflows and service efficiency.
  • Maintains awareness of industry regulations and best practices.

Senior-Level Expectations

  • Demonstrates leadership, professionalism, and role-model behavior.
  • Handles complex accounts independently.
  • Mentors and develops junior staff.
  • Consistently exceeds performance expectations and service metrics.

Management Responsibilities

  • Oversees Client Representatives and Administrative support staff.
  • Manages workflows, productivity, and service standards.
  • Supports hiring, onboarding, and performance management processes.
  • Coordinates with HR, Accounting, IT, and leadership teams.

Accountability

  • Deliver accurate, timely, and compliant client service.
  • Maintain strong client relationships and satisfaction.
  • Ensure data integrity and operational excellence.
  • Support team collaboration and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

Required

  • 3–5+ years of commercial insurance experience.
  • Appropriate insurance licensing.
  • Strong communication, organization, and analytical skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office.

Preferred

  • Experience with Applied EPIC.
  • Bachelor’s degree in business or related field.

Key Competencies

  • Ownership & Accountability
  • Client Focus & Service Excellence
  • Collaboration & Communication
  • Process Improvement & Efficiency
  • Problem Solving & Critical Thinking

Compensation

The base salary range for this position is $50,000 to $75,000 annually. Individual compensation will be determined based on a variety of factors including relevant experience, skills, education, and internal equity.

Team members are empowered to share ideas and experiment across teams in all aspects of the business, fostering innovation and creativity. Leading-edge technologies and inclusive practices drive both individual and collective growth as we modernize and grow our technical capabilities.

Position Overview: We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Staff Software Engineer responsible for leading technical execution within Product Engineering teams. This role requires implementation of product capabilities with a strong focus on API-driven services and event-driven architecture. Collaborating closely with Product Management and Product Engineering to deliver customer and product-centric capabilities while leveraging lean development practices. You’ll bring a proactive attitude about risk, working to identify and resolve performance and scalability issues. Staff Engineers cultivate a healthy and respectful environment with a passion for driving innovation and excellence.

  • Lead the design, development, and deployment of services, APIs, and integrations, with a focus on scalability, reliability, and performance.
  • Ensure code quality and implement strategies to safely and reliably make changes to production systems frequently.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Mentor and support the growth of junior and intermediate engineers through knowledge sharing, pairing, technical guidance, and feedback.
  • Partner with Engineering Managers to evaluate team performance, provide input for annual reviews, and participate in hiring initiatives.
  • Stay up to date on industry trends and emerging technologies, bringing innovative solutions to the team.
  • Collaborate with other Staff and Sr. Staff Engineers to create a community of practice and an overall organizational technical strategy for business success.
  • Influence and publishing within the organization and industry to effect positive changes in business value and tech strategy within RB Global, along with advancing the craft of software development worldwide.

**Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned in support of organizational priorities.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in software development with hands-on experience in backend development with Java or Go.
  • 2 Years minimum experience as a Staff engineering supporting a minimum of 4 teams across a major business domain.
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, or Go.
  • Expertise in Spring Framework (e.g., Spring Boot, Spring Data, Spring Security) and building RESTful APIs.
  • Solid understanding of distributed systems, microservices architecture, and event-driven systems.
  • Strong experience with relational databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL) as well as highly scalable no-SQL datastores.
  • Experience with Knowledge Graphs, and ML/AI Feature stores is a key differentiator.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with frontend frameworks (e.g., React, Angular) for collaboration with full-stack teams.
  • Experience with modern Lean Software development, pair programming, TDD, and Trunk Based Development.
  • Good awareness of CI and CD approaches and tools.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and a data-driven approach to decision-making.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a remote team environment.
  • A deep customer and product focus, with a passion for delivering high-quality solutions.

Why Join Us:

  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies and drive innovation in software engineering with zero friction in your value stream.
  • Collaborative and inclusive work environment that values diverse perspectives.
  • Access to continuous learning and professional development opportunities.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, retirement plans, and professional development opportunities.
  • This is your opportunity to work with an engineering-driven organization innovating and delivering on a scale well beyond other players in our industry.
  • We value innovation, consistent delivery, quality deliverables, and finding joy in our work while crushing our competition.

**Candidates located near our Headquarters (Chicago, Fort Worth, Burnaby, Mississauga) could work Hybrid to those offices.

raw.description:
Du willst nicht nur das Tagesgeschäft am Laufen halten, sondern die Vision und ziele eines Unternehmens operativ Realität werden lassen? Bei uns übernimmst du dasdie Ownership für den Bereich Operations und sorgst selbst dafür, dass Ziele, Prozesse und Automationen im Alltag ineinandergreifen, vom Zielsystem bis zur täglichen Umsetzung. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit der Geschäftsführung, und den Teamleads und Projektverantwortlichen zusammen.

Über EVOLVE

Wir sind ein ganzheitlicher Wachstumspartner für E-Commerce-Brands im DACH-Raum.AI ist der Kern unserer Dienstleistung und steckt in allem, was wir für unsere Kunden umsetzen. Damit wir für unsere Kunden das beste Ergebnis erzielen, arbeiten wir effizient, planbar und skalierbar und setzen dafür auf klare Strukturen und Prozesse.

Das wirst du tun

  • Ziele steuern : Du übersetzt Jahres- und Quartalsziele in konkrete Maßnahmen, Meilensteine und SOPs. Mit unserem OKR-System und regelmäßigen Check-ins sorgst du dafür, dass Ziele auch wirklich erreicht werden.

  • Prozesse optimieren: Du optimierst die Kernprozesse der Agentur und überträgst sie in SOPs und ClickUp-Workflows. Mit KI-Systemen automatisierst du sie und bringst so spürbar mehr Effizienz in unseren Arbeitsalltag.

  • Controlling und Reporting: Du entwickelst und pflegst KPI-Dashboards und berichtest regelmäßig an die Geschäftsführung

  • Bereiche operativ führen: Du verantwortest Finance, HR/People Operations und Administration operativ. Fachlich arbeitest du dabei eng mit der Geschäftsführung und externen Partnern zusammen.

  • Projekte vorantreiben: Du führst neue Tools wie ClickUp, Make, n8n und unser CRM ein. Außerdem bringst du Effizienz- und Sonderprojekte eigenständig bis zur Umsetzung.

Deine Rolle und deine Ressourcen: Du ownst den Bereich Operations, entscheidest über Prozesse, Tools und Standards und setzt sie selbst um, statt sie nur zu delegieren. Dabei arbeitest du mit den Teamleads auf Augenhöhe, setzt die Vorgaben der Geschäftsführung um, unterstützt sie beim Zielsetzungsprozess und berichtest ihr regelmäßig. Und für Sparring oder einfach mal eine zweite Meinung steht dir jederzeit unser gesamtes Team zur Verfügung.

  • Erfahrung in der Optimierung operativer Prozesse im Agentur- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld, idealerweise in einer Wachstumsphase

  • Praxis mit ClickUp und Automationstools, idealerweise mit Make, Zapier oder n8n

  • Praxis mit AI-Tools wie ChatGPT oder Gemini, mit Prompting zur Effizienzsteigerung

  • Praxis in der Teamführung und fließendes Deutsch

raw.title: TikTok Content Manager
raw.excerpt: About High ScaleWe’re High Scale, a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing video advertising on TV and social media.
raw.description:
About High Scale

We’re High Scale, a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing video advertising on TV and social media. Think Amazon’s obsession with customer experience meets SpaceX’s fearless ambition. That’s the DNA behind everything we do.

Our 160-person team of creatives, strategists, and innovators produces thousands of high-impact campaigns weekly for the world’s leading lifestyle, fashion, beauty, and DTC brands. With 50,000 sq. ft. of DTLA studios and a global influencer network, we're constantly pushing the boundaries of creative production.

We're looking for a TikTok Content Manager who lives and breathes social media, understands what makes content go viral, and knows how to turn creative ideas into engaging videos that drive measurable results.

Why This Role Matters

TikTok moves fast, and so do we.

As our TikTok Content Manager, you'll take ownership of TikTok content strategy, planning, publishing, and performance. You'll work closely with Content Creators, Video Editors, and Creative Strategists to develop content that captures attention, builds audiences, and drives engagement.

We're looking for someone who understands TikTok beyond trends and viral sounds. You know how to identify content opportunities, develop repeatable formats, analyze performance, and turn insights into better creative decisions.

If you're constantly discovering new creators, experimenting with content formats, and finding ways to make every video perform better than the last, you'll thrive in this role.

What You'll Do

Develop & Execute TikTok Content Strategies

  • Develop and manage TikTok content strategies aligned with brand objectives, target audiences, and growth goals.

  • Create and maintain content calendars, publishing schedules, and campaign plans.

  • Research trending formats, sounds, hashtags, creators, and emerging content opportunities.

  • Develop creative concepts, content series, and video ideas tailored to each brand's identity.

  • Identify opportunities to improve organic reach, audience engagement, and follower growth.

Manage Content Production

  • Work closely with Content Creators, Video Editors, Copywriters, and Creative Strategists to produce engaging TikTok videos.

  • Prepare creative briefs, scripts, references, and production guidelines.

  • Coordinate content production to ensure videos are delivered on schedule.

  • Review videos before publishing to ensure quality, accuracy, and alignment with brand guidelines.

  • Provide clear, actionable feedback to improve content quality and performance.

Oversee Publishing & Account Management

  • Manage daily TikTok publishing activities across assigned brand accounts.

  • Write engaging captions, select relevant hashtags, and optimize posts for discoverability.

  • Ensure content is published consistently and according to the content calendar.

  • Monitor comments, audience interactions, and emerging conversations to identify engagement opportunities.

  • Maintain a consistent brand voice across all published content.

Analyze Content Performance

  • Monitor key performance metrics, including views, watch time, retention, engagement rate, follower growth, and conversions.

  • Identify top-performing content and develop strategies to replicate successful formats.

  • Analyze underperforming videos and recommend improvements to hooks, pacing, storytelling, and creative execution.

  • Prepare regular performance reports highlighting key insights, trends, and opportunities.

  • Use performance data to continuously refine content strategies and improve results.

Stay Ahead of TikTok Trends

  • Monitor TikTok trends, algorithm updates, platform features, and changes in audience behavior.

  • Research competitors and successful creators to identify emerging content strategies.

  • Experiment with new formats, storytelling techniques, and creative approaches.

  • Identify trends early and translate them into relevant content opportunities for our brands.

Who You Are

Experienced TikTok Content Professional

  • 1-3 years of experience in TikTok content management, social media management, content strategy, or digital marketing.

  • Proven experience managing TikTok accounts and developing content that generates meaningful engagement and audience growth.

  • Experience working with DTC, eCommerce, beauty, fashion, lifestyle, or consumer brands is highly preferred.

  • A portfolio or examples of TikTok accounts you've managed and their performance results are required.

Strong Creative Instincts

  • Deep understanding of TikTok culture, trends, algorithms, and content formats.

  • Strong ability to identify engaging hooks, compelling storytelling techniques, and creative concepts.

  • Comfortable developing ideas for both organic content and performance-driven advertising.

  • Familiarity with TikTok Shop, creator collaborations, and influencer marketing is a plus.

Data-Driven & Results-Oriented

  • Experience using TikTok Analytics and social media management platforms.

  • Strong understanding of content performance metrics and how to translate insights into actionable strategies.

  • Comfortable testing different creative approaches and making decisions based on performance data.

Organized & Collaborative

  • Excellent project management skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts, content calendars, and production deadlines.

  • Strong communication skills and experience collaborating with creators, editors, and cross-functional teams.

  • Comfortable providing creative feedback and managing multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.

Creative, Resourceful & Adaptable

  • You're constantly exploring new ideas and finding opportunities to improve content performance.

  • You enjoy experimenting with new formats and aren't afraid to challenge conventional creative approaches.

  • You anticipate production needs, take ownership of projects, and find solutions when priorities change.

  • You bring fresh ideas and energy to every project and enjoy working with a team that's always looking to raise the bar.

Perks & Benefits

Work with Leading Brands: Develop TikTok strategies and content for exciting lifestyle, beauty, fashion, wellness, and DTC brands.

Creative Ownership: Take an active role in shaping content strategies, developing original concepts, and experimenting with new creative formats.

Career Growth: Expand your expertise in social media strategy, creative production, influencer marketing, and performance advertising, with opportunities to advance into senior content and creative leadership roles.

Collaborative Creative Environment: Work alongside talented Content Creators, Video Editors, Creative Strategists, and marketing professionals.

A Culture of Innovation: Join a team that moves quickly, embraces experimentation, and values people who bring fresh ideas and turn them into results.

High Scale is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and believe exceptional creative work comes from different perspectives, experiences, and ideas. If you're passionate about TikTok, excited by creative experimentation, and motivated by building content that delivers measurable results, we'd love to hear from you.

Not all radiology practices are the same.

While RP Palm Beach benefits from the strength, stability, and resources of Radiology Partners, our local practice maintains a highly physician-led culture with meaningful local autonomy. Our physicians have a direct voice in scheduling, workflow, compensation planning, operational decisions, and the strategic direction of the practice.

We are a collaborative group of fellowship-trained radiologists who genuinely enjoy working together and are committed to creating an environment where physicians can build long-term careers while practicing high-quality medicine.

If you are seeking a practice where your expertise is valued, your voice matters, and you can make a meaningful impact on both patient care and group decision-making, RP Palm Beach offers a unique opportunity.

THE PRACTICE

RP Palm Beach is a well-established, collegial radiology group serving one of Florida’s most desirable communities. Our practice provides coverage for:

·Five hospitals, including two Level I Trauma Centers

·Multiple outpatient imaging centers

·A busy breast imaging program

·Excellent pathology and multidisciplinary clinical support

·Fellowship-trained radiologists across multiple subspecialties

·A collaborative group that values local input, shared problem-solving, and collegiality

Our physicians enjoy a broad and diverse case mix with access to advanced imaging technology and a team-oriented environment that encourages consultation and collaboration.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are seeking a Board-Certified/Board-Eligible Diagnostic Radiologist with fellowship training or strong experience in Musculoskeletal Imaging or Body Imaging.

This position offers the opportunity to practice substantial MSK and Body Imaging while also participating in a diverse diagnostic radiology environment. Candidates who enjoy subspecialty reading while maintaining a broad diagnostic skillset will thrive in our practice.

·Flexible work schedule. 7 days on and 14 days off. Multiple shifts available.

·Collaborative team of approximately 30 fellowship-trained radiologists

·Coverage across hospitals and outpatient imaging centers

·Access to advanced technology and complex pathology

·Local physician leadership and meaningful practice autonomy

Radiology Partners, through its affiliated practices, is a leading radiology practice in the U.S., serving hospitals and other healthcare facilities across the nation. As a physician-led and physician-owned practice, we advance our bold mission by innovating across clinical value, technology, service, and economics, while elevating the role of radiology and radiologists in healthcare. Using a proven healthcare services model, Radiology Partners provides consistent, high-quality care to patients, while delivering enhanced value to the hospitals, clinics, imaging centers and referring physicians we serve.

raw.title: Solutions Support Engineer
raw.excerpt: About VGSVGS is building the trust infrastructure for a new era of commerce.
raw.description:
About VGS

VGS is building the trust infrastructure for a new era of commerce. As commerce becomes agentic, payments are increasing dramatically in volume, speed, and complexity, and the companies driving that shift need a foundation they can fully trust.

That's where VGS comes in. We're the world's leader in payment tokenization, trusted by the most innovative AI and Fortune 500 companies, merchants, banks, and fintechs to power modern payments and agentic commerce. We store more than 9 billion tokens and process more than 10 billion monthly interactions, touching a third of all e-commerce. That scale isn't incidental. It's why leading companies embed our universal token vault and credential management platform directly into their stack, taming the complexity of payment data so they can move faster.

Come build the platform that enables modern payments for the world's largest companies. We're helping businesses unlock new possibilities in an industry that never stops moving. And that takes exceptional people.

About the Role

VGS is hiring a Solutions Support Engineer in Europe to be the technical front door for our European prospects and customers. As part of our European and Support organization, you will bring your expertise to the earliest stage of the relationship: scoping use cases, mapping payment flows, and designing the solution with EU Sales. Once the client is onboarded, you will continue to provide ongoing technical support. Roughly three-quarters of your time will be spent on solution work, and the remainder will be spent on technical support.

This is a growth role for a senior support, integration, or solutions engineer who wants to move upstream, and you will help shape how Solutions and Support work together in Europe.

You will operate largely in the region alongside the EU team, while the US Solutions team is offline, with a few hours of overlap with the US team towards the end of your day. We are looking for a payments nerd who, in a single day, can earn a prospect CTO's trust, map a complex payment flow with an existing customer's payments leader, help a colleague in Sales through a technical conversation, and trace a failing integration with the customer's engineers. You will partner with payment companies and enterprise merchants on global payment infrastructure, processor connectivity, credential portability, tokenization, and sensitive payment data.

You will work with the European team through the deal lifecycle, hand over approved designs to the Implementation team, and oversee them through go-live, provide support on solution questions, and stay aligned with the US Solutions team. What you learn in the field goes to Product and Engineering to shape the roadmap and our go-to-market strategy.

What You’ll Do

Solutions work for EU clients and teams (about 75% of the role)

  • Conduct technical discovery with EU prospects and customers, Sales, and Account Management to clarify business goals, requirements, risks, and product gaps.

  • Partner with EU Sales on technical strategy for strategic opportunities, from discovery through architecture approval, and support other EU opportunities.

  • Map payment flows across merchants, PSPs, processors, acquirers, card networks, wallets, and third parties.

  • Architect solutions using VGS capabilities, including vaulting, card management, Network and Agentic Tokens, Account Updater, 3DS, wallet payments, account validation, and data security.

  • Guide customers on payment security best practices, PCI scope reduction, credential portability, multi-processor setups, resiliency, and scaling.

  • Create and deliver architecture diagrams, proposals, demos, and proofs of concept, and support EU responses to RFIs, security reviews, and architecture assessments.

  • Back up EU Sales, Implementation, and Support colleagues in client conversations that need solutions depth, and coach them on solutioning with VGS.

  • Produce detailed handoffs to the Implementation team covering solution architecture, assumptions, responsibilities, testing, success metrics, and out-of-scope items, then coordinate with Support to provide technical oversight through go-live to ensure the implementation matches the approved architecture.

  • Serve as the solution-level escalation point for Support, helping diagnose and redesign where a customer's setup is the root cause.

  • Turn customer and market feedback into input for the product roadmap, and build reusable reference architectures, integration patterns, and enablement for the EU teams.

  • Coordinate with the US-based Solutions team so EU work stays consistent with VGS standards: reuse existing payment flow maps, solution designs, and reference architectures, bring new EU use cases and capability gaps back to them, and share the patterns and enablement you build.

Overflow technical support (about 25% of the role)

  • When there are no active implementations, take overflow tickets during EU business hours.

  • Reproduce issues with cURL and Postman, read logs, and trace requests across VGS infrastructure, customer systems, and downstream gateways.

  • Diagnose network problems independently, including DNS, TCP/IP, routing, timeouts, connection resets, and TLS/SSL handshake failures.

  • Resolve the issue, find a workaround, or escalate with a bug report that Engineering can act on immediately.

  • Write up nontrivial investigations as internal runbooks or public documentation, and build and deliver customer training where none exists.

  • When an incident or maintenance event affects EU customers, flag the impact to the on-call lead and help draft status page updates and customer notices.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years in technical support, integration or implementation engineering, solutions engineering, technical account management, or solutions architecture, with some of it in a senior or lead capacity.

  • Proven ability to work independently as the technical expert in a customer-facing role, deciding and then reporting rather than checking first.

  • Background at a merchant, PSP, processor, acquirer, issuer, card network, or payment infrastructure company.

  • Experience with large-scale card or credential migrations, and with multi-PSP, payment orchestration, processor-routing, or payment portability strategies.

  • Knowledge of PCI DSS, data security, privacy, and compliance architecture.

  • Strong communication skills: comfortable explaining complex concepts to technical and non-technical audiences, creating clear solution diagrams, supporting customer executive briefings, and coaching colleagues in Sales, Implementation, and Support.

  • Strong command of HTTP, REST APIs, and proxies, and independent network debugging (DNS, TCP/IP, routing, TLS/SSL handshakes). Be ready to describe a specific problem you diagnosed and how you narrowed it down.

  • Ability to read and debug code and to write working code examples in at least one of Python, JavaScript, Java, or Ruby.

  • A knack for out-of-the-box thinking that thrives in a fast-paced startup environment.

  • English at C1 or above, written and spoken.

  • Strong collaboration, negotiation, and prioritization skills.

  • Willingness to work EU business hours on a sustained basis.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with tokenization, payment processing, cryptology, or security products.

  • Direct experience with card network programs (Visa, Mastercard), such as network tokenization or account updater services.

  • Familiarity with the EU payments and data context, such as PSD2/SCA and GDPR.

  • Industry certifications such as PCI QSA, CPP (Certified Payments Professional), CISSP, or AWS Solutions Architect.

  • BA/BS degree.

We're looking for passionate professionals who take pride in their craft and want to help grow a team tackling some of the most critical problems in payments. People who thrive here are curious by nature, unafraid of hard problems, and motivated by the chance to build something that matters at scale.

If you're driven to make a meaningful impact, work at the leading edge of payment technology, and grow your career alongside a team that values ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning, you'll feel right at home at VGS.

Our Benefits

Financial and retirement

  • Competitive salary

  • 401 (k) with a 4% match and immediate vesting (applies to US only)

  • Early equity

  • Internet Stipend

  • Learning Stipend

  • Office set-up stipend (applies to US only)

Health and Wellness

  • Insurance (medical, dental, and vision)

  • HSA/FSA Options

  • Life and disability insurance

  • Pet insurance

Vacation and time off

  • Flexible PTO

  • Paid national holidays

  • Global parental leave program

Professional Development

  • Promote from within

  • Lunch and learns

  • Team events and summits

Office life and perks

  • Remote and hybrid opportunities

  • Flexible working hours

  • Weekly office lunches

  • Employee discount platform

Equal Opportunity

We consider all applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, sex, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, marital status, physical or mental disability, or other protected classes under all applicable local, state, and federal laws and ordinances (AA/EOE/W/M/Vet/Disabled).

Qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records will be considered for this position in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

A Note on Our Hiring Process

raw.description:
Remote option is available for this position.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. No sponsorship is available for this position.

Are you eager to develop your excellence in an inclusive, collaborative, and empowering community? Are you excited about joining a company that strives to make a difference – for its employees, clients, and society? Are you motivated by creating sustainable change that benefits society and nature?

If this sounds like you, or you’re curious to learn more, then this role could be the perfect opportunity. Join our Workplace Management team and work with us to close the gap to a sustainable future.

Your new role

This role provides senior HSEQ leadership across Ramboll’s EPC/EPCM project portfolio in Ramboll Americas, supporting the safe delivery of complex engineering, procurement, construction management, commissioning, and turnover activities. The role is responsible for establishing consistent HSEQ governance, aligning contractors and project teams, supporting high-risk work planning, and enabling effective execution across multiple concurrent projects. The successful candidate will bring significant hands-on experience from large-scale EPC/EPCM construction environments and will be able to operate confidently at both strategic and field execution levels.

The ideal candidate will be a credible HSEQ leader with significant field experience on large-scale construction or EPC/EPCM projects, strong contractor management capability, and the confidence to influence senior project, client, and contractor stakeholders. They will be comfortable working across multiple projects, balancing strategic governance with practical field-based support, and helping project teams create consistent, risk-based HSEQ execution.

Your key responsibilities will be:

Strategic HSEQ Leadership

  • Lead the development of a portfolio-wide HSEQ approach that enables consistent standards, scalable processes, and project-specific execution across all EPC/EPCM projects.
  • Serve as primary HSEQ advisor to Project Directors and EPC/EPCM leadership teams.
  • Drive adoption of Ramboll’s HSEQ program and translate its expectations into practical project-level behaviours, controls, and leadership routines.
  • Provide strategic HSEQ guidance during proposals and contract negotiations to align client expectations and establish the conditions needed for effective safety management.
  • Provide HSEQ leadership within an EPC/EPCM delivery model, ensuring clear boundaries, responsibilities, and interfaces between Ramboll, clients, construction contractors, subcontractors, and suppliers.
  • Safety Program Organization & Implementation
  • Define HSEQ organization structures that are scalable with the ability to support multi-project EPC/EPCM delivery on a nationwide basis.
  • Clarify roles, responsibilities, interfaces, and governance models required for integrated EPC/EPCM/ safety programs.
  • Establish standardized HSEQ execution plans across engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and turnover.
  • Establish construction readiness expectations, including contractor mobilisation, competency assurance, risk review, and field execution controls.

  • Contractor & Multi-Party Coordination

  • Align HSEQ expectations, execution standards, and performance requirements across contractors, subcontractors, vendors, and third-party stakeholders.
  • Lead contractor onboarding, alignment sessions, audits, and recurring performance reviews.
  • Ensure HSEQ requirements are embedded into contracting strategies, procurement packages, bid documents, mobilisation plans, and contractor management processes.
  • Support project teams in translating Ramboll and client HSEQ requirements into practical field execution requirements for contractors and subcontractors.

  • Risk Management, Governance and Assurance

  • Provide governance and assurance over EPC/EPCM risk management processes, including hazard identification, construction risk assessments, high-risk work reviews, and site controls.
  • Support project HSEQ resources and project leadership in establishing consistent risk management expectations, while ensuring accountability remains clear within the project delivery structure.
  • Review and challenge the effectiveness of controls for high-risk activities, including lifting, electrical work, confined space entry, work at height, ground disturbance, energisation, commissioning, and simultaneous operations.
  • Provide oversight, escalation support, and subject matter input for high-potential or higher-severity incidents, ensuring investigations are completed and lessons learned are embedded across relevant projects.
  • Conduct site visits, leadership engagements, and assurance reviews to verify that project HSEQ controls are effective, understood, and consistently applied by the relevant project teams and contractors.

  • Safety Culture & Engagement

  • Demonstrate visible HSEQ leadership that builds trust, accountability, and proactive safety behaviours across project teams and contractors.
  • Coach project and contractor leadership teams to strengthen leading indicators, reinforce expectations, and promote consistent safety leadership.
  • Promote open communication, psychological safety, learning, and continuous improvement across the EPC/EPCM project portfolio.

  • Regulatory & Compliance Oversight

  • Provide oversight of compliance with applicable health, safety, and environmental regulations, client requirements, and Ramboll HSEQ standards across EPC/EPCM projects.
  • Support project teams in translating regulatory and contractual HSEQ requirements into practical controls and assurance activities.
  • Represent Ramboll in client audits, regulatory inspections, and EPC/EPCM governance meetings, ensuring actions are effectively tracked, communicated, and closed.

  • Performance Management & Reporting

  • Establish consistent HSEQ performance reporting across EPC/EPCM projects, using leading and lagging indicators to identify trends, drive accountability, and improve performance.
  • Translate performance data into clear insights, actions, and recommendations for project leadership, clients, contractors, and internal stakeholders.

About you

  • Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Health & Safety, Engineering, or related field.
  • 10+ years of progressive on-site HSEQ leadership experience with substantial large-scale EPC/EPCM project exposure.
  • Strong background supporting multi-contractor, high-risk industrial construction environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence without direct authority.
  • Proven experience supporting construction management delivery models where HSEQ performance is delivered through contractor execution and strong client/contractor interface management.
  • Working knowledge of construction-phase HSEQ controls, contractor management, incident investigation, assurance, and regulatory compliance.
  • Ability to travel regularly to project locations and engage effectively with field teams, project leadership, clients, and contractors.
  • Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred:

  • Professional certifications (CSP, CMIOSH, NEBOSH, CRSP, or equivalent).
  • Experience with energy transition, power, renewables, industrial de-carbonisation, chemicals, manufacturing, mining, or major infrastructure projects.
  • Experience supporting owner’s EPC/EPCM models across multiple concurrent projects.
  • International or remote project experience.

What we can offer you

  • Investment in your development
  • Being valued for the unique person you are
  • Never being short of inspiration from colleagues, clients, and projects
  • The long-term thinking of a foundation-owned company

Salary Transparency Statement

At Ramboll, we are committed to fair and transparent compensation practices that support our people and our purpose of creating sustainable societies. The anticipated base salary range for this position is $136,497 - $197,515 per year. This range reflects the compensation we reasonably expect to offer at the time of posting. Actual compensation will vary based on factors such as location, skills, experience, education, and internal equity. Because we operate across multiple U.S. markets, pay may differ depending on the cost of labor in specific locations. In addition to base salary, this position may be eligible for bonus, overtime or other forms of compensation and we offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports well-being, professional development, and work-life balance. Our recruiters are happy to share more about the specific salary range and total rewards package applicable to your location during the hiring process.

Ready to join us?

Please submit your application with your up-to-date CV. We invite diversity in all its forms and encourage applicants from all groups to apply.

Thank you for taking the time to apply! We look forward to receiving your application.

Work at the heart of sustainable change with Ramboll in the Americas

Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. As a foundation-owned people company, founded in Denmark, we believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. Our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act and being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. Ramboll in the Americas has thousands of experts working across more than 70 offices. Ramboll experts deliver innovative solutions across Environment & Health, Water, Energy, and Planning & Urban Design.

Where People Flourish

Our mission is to create sustainable societies where people and nature flourish. This means that a culture of inclusion is embedded in everything we do. Our people bring diverse backgrounds and experiences to the company, enabling us to deliver innovative and forward-thinking solutions to our clients. We also know how important it is to achieve the right balance of where, when, and how much you work. At Ramboll, we offer flexibility as part of our positive and inclusive approach to work. We are committed to equal employment opportunity, regardless of age, disability or medical condition, gender identity, marriage and domestic partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, ancestry, or national origin, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation, military service and veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Ramboll wants to ensure opportunities are accessible to candidates with disabilities. So, please let us know if there are any changes we could make to the application process to make it more comfortable for you. You can contact us at with such requests.

raw.description:
About QC Servion

QC Servion is the centralized hub for human resources, change management, program management, sales & marketing, safety, administration, legal, and accounting services across the QC Ecosystem.

We provide comprehensive operational support that empowers our companies to focus on growth, innovation, and excellence, while ensuring employees thrive in safe, engaging, and well-managed environments.

The entities in our ecosystem include DLB Associates, Galtra Solutions, AI2IO, Fluid2Chip, CEQEL Critical Commissioning, and 2AI-DC Integrators. Collectively, we deliver services across the data center industry.

Position: Recruiting Specialist

Position Location: Remote - work virtually from anywhere in the United States

Salary

QC Servion recognizes salary ranges from job boards do not necessarily reflect our pay ranges. In many instances we out-compete those ranges for well-qualified candidates.

Job Summary

The Recruiting Specialist plays a critical role in driving full-cycle recruiting and proactive talent sourcing across a diverse portfolio of technical, project-based, field, operational, and corporate roles. This may include mechanical and electrical engineers, designers, commissioning professionals, field technicians, project and program professionals, and corporate/shared-services functions.

As a key member of the HR team, the Recruiting Specialist partners closely with hiring managers and cross-functional stakeholders to understand role requirements, business priorities, and talent market dynamics. This position is responsible for developing strong candidate pipelines, advising hiring teams, delivering a high-quality candidate experience, and driving efficient, data-informed hiring decisions.

The ideal candidate is an experienced recruiting professional who thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and can move comfortably between highly technical searches and broader corporate hiring needs. This person should be proactive, resourceful, organized, and capable of independently managing a high-volume workload while maintaining strong relationships with candidates and hiring teams.

Essential Functions

Talent Acquisition & Recruiting (95%)

  • Own and manage full-cycle recruitment for approximately 15–30 active requisitions, ensuring consistent pipeline activity and timely movement of candidates through each stage.
  • Lead requisition intake and calibration discussions with hiring managers to understand position requirements, candidate profiles, business priorities, and interview expectations.
  • Proactively source and engage qualified talent using LinkedIn, job boards, referrals, internal databases, specialized sourcing channels, and targeted outreach strategies.
  • Recruit across technical, field-based, project, operational, and corporate functions, adapting sourcing and screening approaches based on the needs of each search.
  • Screen and evaluate candidates for technical qualifications, experience, career alignment, communication skills, and overall position fit.
  • Build strong partnerships with hiring managers through regular communication and recurring hiring syncs focused on priorities, pipeline health, market feedback, and interview outcomes.
  • Manage high-volume candidate and stakeholder communication with a focus on responsiveness, professionalism, and engagement.
  • Coordinate interviews and help maintain process momentum by minimizing scheduling delays and communication gaps.
  • Own interviewer feedback collection and follow-up, driving accountability and timely hiring decisions.
  • Lead the offer process from verbal offer through formal documentation and acceptance, ensuring clear communication and a positive candidate experience.
  • Maintain accurate and current information within the ATS to provide visibility into pipeline health, recruiting activity, and hiring progress.
  • Use recruiting data and market insights to identify pipeline challenges, recommend adjustments, and improve hiring outcomes.
  • Maintain consistent candidate engagement throughout the hiring lifecycle, including searches that require longer decision timelines.
  • Leverage AI, automation, and emerging technologies to improve sourcing, screening, communication, and administrative workflows.

Human Resources Support (5%)

  • Provide general HR, research, and administrative support based on team and business priorities.
  • Assist with employee engagement initiatives and HR projects as needed.
  • Support documentation and improvement of HR procedures and workflows, identifying opportunities to streamline and automate processes.
  • Collaborate with the broader HR team on initiatives that support employee experience and organizational growth.

Position Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Communications, or a related field with 5+ years of progressive full-cycle recruiting and sourcing experience; equivalent professional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • Demonstrated experience recruiting for engineering, commissioning, and other highly technical roles, with the versatility to shift between technical hiring and corporate/shared-services functions as business needs evolve.
  • Proven ability to independently manage a high-volume requisition load from intake and sourcing through interviewing, offer, and close.
  • Strong proactive sourcing capabilities using LinkedIn, job boards, referrals, internal databases, and specialized talent channels.
  • Experience partnering directly with hiring managers to understand business needs, calibrate candidate profiles, provide market insight, and drive hiring decisions forward.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage, advise, and influence candidates and hiring stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of recruiting best practices, candidate experience, and broader HR processes.
  • Experience managing pipelines and maintaining accurate recruiting data within an applicant tracking system; Rippling ATS experience preferred.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, and Teams.
  • High attention to detail with the ability to manage competing priorities, deadlines, and a high volume of candidate activity.
  • Experience leveraging AI, automation, and emerging technologies to improve sourcing, screening, recruiting workflows, and overall efficiency.

Physical Demands

The following physical demands must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is:

  • Frequently required to remain in a stationary position.
  • Frequently moving through home office.
  • May occasionally lift up to 20 pounds.

Travel Requirements

  • Up to 5%, this may include travel to any or all 50 US states.
  • Travel is defined as physically leaving home on behalf of business activities including but not limited to client sites, meetings with other employees, meeting for business development purposes, running errands on behalf of the business, attending industry conferences, etc.

Benefits

  • Choice of comprehensive medical plans (including two PPO-style plans and a HDHP w/ HSA option).
  • Flex spending accounts (FSA).
  • Dental and vision plans.
  • Comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits extended to spouse / domestic partner and dependent children up to age 26.
  • 401k with company match and self-directed brokerage account option.
  • PTO including additional paid time off during the last week of the year.
  • Company paid life insurance coverage for employees and their eligible dependents.
  • Short and long-term disability, AD&D coverage.
  • Professional development opportunities, tuition reimbursement, and professional licensing assistance.
  • Paid parental leave after one year of employment.

CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC residents only: In accordance with CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC law, the range provided is QC Servion's reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount may differ based on non-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location.

EEO

QC Servion provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Notice To Third Party Agencies
QC Servion does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters, employment agencies, or other staffing services. Unsolicited resumes include any resume or hiring document sent to QC Servion in the absence of a signed Service Agreement where QC Servion has expressly requested recruitment/staffing services specific to the position at hand. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers or other business leaders, will become the property of QC Servion and QC Servion will have the right to hire that candidate without reservation – no fee or other compensation will be owed or paid to the recruiter, employment agency, or other staffing service.

raw.title: Pursuit Strategist
raw.excerpt: If you think your skills, experience and aspirations make you a good match for this position, we encourage you to apply.
raw.description:
If you think your skills, experience and aspirations make you a good match for this position, we encourage you to apply. This position may be filled anywhere in the United States. Preference may be given to candidates that can work in one of the CannonDesign locations.
As part of the application process, candidates should show us their creativity and ability to influence and bring strategy to life through visual and verbal storytelling. Please redact proprietary/confidential information as needed. Note: We acknowledge that developing these items is highly collaborative. That said, we’re looking for examples where you had a primary role in their creation. You’ll be given time to present your work during the interview — we’re interested in “how” you present your work, too.
ABOUT THE ROLE
Step into a role where ambition meets impact and innovation drives opportunity. We’re seeking a creative problem solver to work alongside firm leaders to influence strategy and drive success. This role is ideal for those who play to win, are excited by a challenge and excel at drawing insights that others might overlook.
We work in high-pressure environments, but we’ve cultivated a close-knit community built on shared knowledge, best practices and mutual support. Your drive, diligence and inquisitive nature will be key to challenging pursuit teams to deliver transformative results.
As a Pursuit Strategist, you’ll be part of our Brand, Marketing and Business Development (BMBD) team, reporting to our National Marketing Pursuits Leader and collaborating closely with the entire marketing team, as well as business developers, graphic designers, and market and client leaders throughout the firm.

Success in this role will require the ability to transform raw information into meaningful narratives that inform decision-making and inspire action. You’ll need creativity, strong writing skills and a collaborative spirit to bring ideas to life alongside our talented team. And you’ll be called upon to translate your strategic marketing instincts and talents to serve multiple areas of expertise housed within the firm.
HERE'S WHAT YOU'LL DO
Strategic Proposal Marketing
  • Lead strategy development for our firm’s most significant and complex project pursuits.
  • During early phases of the Strategic Pursuit Process, you’ll develop an overall action plan that includes profiles of decision-makers and influencers, a competitor analysis, a SWOT analysis and comprehensive market research, all of which you’ll use to develop insights that inform our strategy.
  • Partner closely with the Opportunity Leader to develop a project-specific win plan (client issues, features, benefits and proof statements), strategic teaming plan and spearhead the preliminary go/no go and strategy review.
  • Lead the effective facilitation of strategy sessions/workshops to develop a pursuit strategy targeted to the client’s needs. Drive an established agenda, guide the creative brainstorming process, challenge and tests ideas, develop action items and assignments, and synthesize the intelligence, outcomes and next steps of these sessions.
  • Ensure the greatest possibility of success by supporting compliance, readability and messaging of pursuit-related materials.
  • Collaborate with opportunity leaders and marketing leads to organize and determine the objectives of strategy sessions/workshops according to our strategic pursuit process. Identify and engage local, regional and firm resources to support the win-planning process.
  • Partner with pursuit teams to develop and implement differentiators, value propositions, key messages, project approaches and successful interview presentations.
  • Partner with the proposal content team, subject matter experts and our BMBD team to ensure messaging is translated into a compelling narrative with graphics that provide visual storytelling that reinforces and amplifies our pursuit theme throughout the proposal.
  • Serve as a presentation rehearsal coach and facilitator to organize and prepare teams for client presentations and interviews.
  • Participate in win/loss debriefs and identify and leverage lessons learned to inform future pursuits.
  • Coach and mentor Marketing Specialists and Senior Marketing Specialists across the region in proposal strategy and strategic storytelling.

Firm Knowledge & Subject Matter Expertise

  • Develop strong, in-depth knowledge of the firm’s portfolio and personnel and brand (how we express ourselves visually and verbally) to connect with clients and differentiate ourselves in the marketplace.
  • Develop subject matter expertise (across markets, typologies, services, technology or other) that adds value to our marketing initiatives and pursuit activities.

Management & Operations

  • Work with our National Marketing Pursuits Leader and Regional Marketing Team Leaders to train and develop our Senior/Marketing Specialists.
  • Provide peer review and oversight for accuracy and quality of content.
  • Self-review all work for accuracy and quality of content.

Other

  • Up to 25% travel expected.
  • May participate in external marketing activities.
HERE'S WHAT YOU'LL NEED
  • Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, communications or a related field required.
  • Minimum of 8 years of related work experience required. 10+ years of related work experience preferred.
  • Related experience working in a proposal management role influencing strategy and content for a professional services firm required.
  • Related experience working in the Architecture, Engineering and/or Construction industry preferred.
  • Strong proficiency with InDesign, Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Familiarity with Deltek CRM Vision, Salesforce and Miro is a plus.
Core Competencies
  • Strategic thinker able to translate ideas into plans, goals and role assignments with measures to ensure implementation.
  • Enthusiasm for working as part of a driven and disciplined team, with a motivation to overcome hurdles and obstacles to find solutions.
  • Ability to command a room, gain consensus and navigate team and organizational dynamics effectively.
  • Strong time and project management skills, along with the ability to manage up as you work with large teams in a deadline-driven environment.
  • Solid skills and confidence in driving a process.
  • Able to inspire and collaborate with a creative team to bring ideas to life.
  • Effective communicator — able to share ideas with confidence and clarity, and shape creative and compelling narratives.
The salary range for this position is $ 83,200 to $104,000 annually. This salary range is the range we believe is the anticipated range of possible base compensation at the timing of the posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the anticipated salary range for the position. Employees may be eligible for discretionary bonuses. We offer a full benefit package including medical, dental and vision coverage and flexible spending account options and voluntary insurances. We have paid time off, flex-time schedules, remote work options and a 401k plan and employee perk programs. For a general overview of our benefits, please visit our careers page at . Actual compensation may vary from posting based on geographic location, work experience, education and/or skill level.
ABOUT OUR FIRM
CannonDesign is a design practice where strategy, experience, architecture, engineering, and social impact converge. We don’t just dream up solutions — we create and bring them to life in ways to solve some of the biggest challenges facing our clients and the society. At the heart of everything we do is Living-Centered Design, a bold commitment to using our talents to not just improve the world but to truly reshape it for the better. It’s more than a philosophy — it’s who we are, and it drives us to make a meaningful, lasting difference every day.
ABOUT WORKING HERE
  • We are relentless in our pursuit of client adoration (not simply satisfaction). Consistent delivery of the best service is what we are about.
  • We are committed to ensuring our practice provides equal opportunities for all employees, as we strive to connect with communities around us and focus on the future of design. We support equity, diversity, and inclusion efforts that benefit all employees through the leadership of our DEI Council, our Employee Resource Groups which are open to everyone, and other community initiatives.
  • We’re about communication and transparency here. If you want to talk to someone about an idea you have, or a challenge that needs addressing, we’re ready for you.
Please note that candidates can only apply to our positions on our company Careers site. It's not uncommon for scammers to create positions that look legitimate on other sites; never enter your information or apply for CannonDesign positions on any platform. Should an issue arise that you feel we should be aware of, please contact us. Please provide your resume and portfolio when applying.
As a condition of employment, all employees are expected to complete mandatory training, including compliance training, within required timeframes and adhere to our internal policies and our Code of Conduct.
CannonDesign is an Equal Opportunity Employer. CannonDesign is committed to maintaining a work environment that is free from any and all forms of unlawful discrimination and harassment. It is therefore the firm’s policy to prohibit discrimination and harassment against any applicant, CannonDesign employee, vendor, contractor, or client on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, genetic information, citizenship status, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law. It is also CannonDesign’s policy to prohibit any and all forms of retaliation against any individual who has complained of harassing or discriminatory conduct, or participated in a firm or agency investigation into such complaints.

raw.description:
SimpleTiger is hiring a part-time contract web developer to build, improve, and troubleshoot client websites in WordPress and HubSpot, with the potential to grow into a larger role.

We’re a B2B SaaS marketing agency helping software companies grow through SEO, content marketing, paid media, and answer engine optimization (AEO). Our clients’ websites are where much of that work comes to life, and we’re looking for a developer who can turn ideas into clean, functional pages quickly.

As part of our delivery team, you’ll work primarily on client websites, translating designs, campaign concepts, and SEO recommendations into effective web experiences. From building new pages to fixing issues on existing sites, you’ll help turn our marketing strategy into work that’s ready to launch.

Key responsibilities

  • Build, update, or troubleshoot client websites in WordPress and HubSpot CMS

  • Make technical fixes and improvements to live client sites, with clear details on what was tested, implemented, and performance comparisons using tools like Screaming Frog, pagespeed insights, and Lighthouse

  • Build and connect forms, lead routing, and simple automations between a site and the client’s marketing tools

  • Set up and check tracking, like GA4, Google Tag Manager, and HubSpot tracking in Tandem with the SEO Manager

  • Keep sites fast, accessible, and friendly to SEO (page speed, Core Web Vitals, clean markup, image optimizations, cache lifetime improvements, and so on)

  • Write clear and timely notes on what you are actively working on, and any updates pushed live so our team and the client can follow along

Qualifications and skills

  • You’re a hands-on developer who can build from scratch, troubleshoot existing sites, and make improvements without disrupting what’s already working.

Required skills

  • WordPress development: Strong experience with custom themes, child themes, blocks, page builders, and Advanced Custom Fields (ACF). You can build a page from the ground up—not just edit an existing one.

  • HubSpot CMS development: Strong experience with HubL templates, modules, and themes, including building and troubleshooting pages, forms, and email templates.

  • Front-end development: Solid HTML, CSS, and JavaScript skills, with the ability to navigate existing code and understand how changes affect the live site.

  • APIs and integrations: Experience working with the HubSpot or WordPress REST APIs, plus CRMs and marketing tools such as Salesforce, Zapier, n8n, Airtable, and Slack.

  • Technical audits and fixes: Experience using Screaming Frog to audit WordPress and HubSpot sites, interpret findings, and resolve technical issues.

  • Code review and cleanup: Comfort working within WordPress and HubSpot codebases to identify legacy or unused JavaScript and CSS, determine what’s still needed, and safely remove what isn’t.

  • Async communication: Clear, timely written communication, especially through Slack.

  • Independent work: Strong time management and the ability to meet deadlines, flag blockers early, and keep projects moving without close supervision.

Nice-to-have skills

  • Webflow development and auditing experience, including building a clean CMS structure.

  • PHP development experience.

  • Previous work at a marketing agency or with B2B SaaS clients.

  • Familiarity with SEO and conversion best practices.

  • Experience with Git and version control.

What success looks like

Success means delivering clean, reliable development work that helps our team turn marketing plans into live client experiences.

  • Designs, campaign concepts, and SEO requests become functional pages in WordPress and HubSpot.

  • Technical audit findings lead to practical fixes, with changes tested to avoid breaking existing functionality.

  • Legacy and unused code is cleaned up thoughtfully, while essential code and front-end behavior remain intact.

  • Forms, templates, and integrations work as intended and support the client’s marketing workflows.

  • Projects stay on track because you manage your workload, meet agreed deadlines, and raise questions or blockers early.

  • Teammates have clear visibility into progress through timely updates and straightforward communication in Slack.
