raw.description:
First Media is a leading social media publishing and marketing company at the intersection of content and commerce, driving the shoppable content revolution, with more than 250 million fans and 1.5 billion monthly views. First Media’s Performance Marketing division is one of the fastest-growing full-service Direct Response agencies. We provide our clients with customized digital storytelling production in a packaged approach that is narrative, data-driven, and beautifully executed, leveraged with the most innovative AI-driven algorithms and tools. With our triple-threat experts in digital publishing, adtech, and performance, we’re uniquely positioned in today’s marketplace.

The Opportunity

First Media is seeking an experienced Performance Marketing Producer / Editor who can bring creative ideas to life from concept through finished video, and occasionally appear on camera as well. You'll develop concepts, write scripts, produce, and edit compelling short-form ads across multiple brands and products, working both independently and collaboratively depending on project needs. You can look at a product, a messaging brief, or existing footage and see the potential for an engaging ad, then bring that vision to life, learn from its performance, and make the next version even better.

What You’ll Do

Concept and Script

  • Turn footage, products, and messaging into ad concepts, scripts, and finished content
  • Ideate and script video concepts in a clear voice that tells a specific story about a product to a specific audience
  • Write hooks, headlines, on-screen text, and other short-form ad copy that works hand in hand with the visuals
  • Translate what makes content strong and watchable on each platform into ads that perform
  • Work across brands alongside directors, editors, and strategists

Produce and Edit

  • Concept, produce, and edit short-form ads that drive performance, appearing on camera when the idea calls for it
  • Self-produce ads from concept to scripting through shoots, post-production, and delivery
  • Craft ads from existing footage and assets across multiple iterations, with a sharp sense of what makes an effective ad

Optimize and Scale

  • Make data-informed creative decisions that capture attention, improve campaign performance, and drive conversion
  • Use performance data to sharpen hooks, formats, and iterations, scaling what works and cutting what doesn’t
  • Bring a sense of strategy to every brief: what makes good creative, and why an ad wins
  • Innovate and execute new formats and trends that can scale across teams
  • Explore and leverage AI-assisted creative and production tools to streamline workflows, experiment with new approaches, and improve creative output

What We’re Looking For

Experience

  • Experience creating short-form video content for digital advertising, social media, branded content, or related creative productions. Paid social or direct-response experience is a plus.
  • Demonstrated experience developing creative concepts, writing scripts and hooks, producing video content, and editing for digital and social platforms.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, particularly with short-form and vertical video. Working knowledge of Photoshop is a plus.
  • Familiarity with performance metrics such as hook rate, retention, and click-through rate (CTR), and how they can inform creative decisions.
  • Experience with AI-assisted creative, production, or editing tools is a plus.

Skills & Working Style

  • Strong conceptual thinking, copywriting, and visual storytelling skills, with the ability to tailor creative to different products, audiences, and objectives.
  • A strong understanding of social platforms, native content trends, and what captures and sustains audience attention.
  • Ability to take creative projects from concept through execution, working independently or collaboratively depending on project needs.
  • Comfortable with hands-on production, including filming products and capturing compelling footage using an iPhone or other lightweight equipment.
  • Comfortable appearing on camera when the creative concept calls for it.
  • Strong creative judgment, adaptability, and openness to feedback, with the ability to work efficiently across multiple brands and priorities.

Portfolio Required: Please include a link to a portfolio or work samples showcasing short-form video content you've helped concept, script, produce, and/or edit. Paid social, direct-response, or other advertising examples are especially welcome. Please indicate your specific contributions to the work submitted.

Full Time

Philippines: $10 to $14 ($1600 to $2300 per month)

TARGET START DATE

ASAP

ROLE OVERVIEW

About the Client:

The client is a creative personal brand going through a transition phase focused on storytelling, activism, and design driven content. The business combines art, creative direction, and social impact, with a strong emphasis on authentic messaging rather than purely promotional content. They are looking for someone who can help translate evolving ideas into clear marketing strategies while maintaining a flexible and collaborative approach. This role requires working closely with leadership, adapting to spontaneous content opportunities, and helping redefine the brand voice while supporting healthy business growth.








About the Role:

We are seeking a highly organized, proactive Executive Assistant to support a busy Owner/Creative leading a fast-moving mix of fine art, commercial design, and nonprofit/civic projects. This role is equal parts inbox triage, relationship stewardship, light scheduling/logistics, and—most importantly—business development support.

You will act as a primary point of contact for the owner, keeping communications flowing, protecting her time, nurturing critical relationships, and ensuring strategic follow-ups never slip through the cracks. The ideal candidate is an independent thinker and a true "go-getter"—not a checklist follower, but a high-level partner who anticipates needs and drives conversations to completion.

Key Responsibilities

1. Business Development & Relationship Stewardship (Primary Focus)

  • Relationship Lifecycle Management: Maintain a deep understanding of the owners entire ecosystem of collectors, commercial clients, donors, patrons, vendors, and collaborators.
  • Onboarding & Touchpoints: Ensure new contacts receive a high-touch initial experience (sending intro decks, thank-you notes, tagging and system entry, and setting up structured follow-up cadences).
  • Network & Prospecting: Identify new business opportunities within existing networks, research prospective partners, and re-engage cold contacts using automated workflows in monday.com.
  • Collateral & Pitch Support: Assist with updating graphics, presentations, pitch decks, and promotional materials in Canva/Adobe. Coordinate, format, draft, and submit proposals.

  • Documentation and feedback: Contribute updates to existing FAQs, knowledge base articles and internal instructions. Report recurring issues and suggest practical improvements to the support lead.

  • Familiarity with industry standards and protocols such as IEC 61850, IEC 61968/61970 (CIM), DNP3 or Modbus.

About RSI Security

RSI Security is a leading cybersecurity and compliance consulting firm helping organizations navigate complex regulatory and security requirements. Our consultants partner with clients across healthcare, life sciences, financial services, technology, manufacturing, and other regulated industries to build practical, scalable compliance programs that reduce risk while enabling business growth.

Position Summary

The GDPR Compliance Consultant serves as a trusted advisor responsible for helping organizations achieve and maintain compliance with the European Union General Data Protection Regulation (EU GDPR) and UK GDPR.

Working directly with executive leadership, legal counsel, privacy teams, IT, security, HR, and business stakeholders, this consultant conducts privacy assessments, develops compliance programs, prepares required documentation, and implements practical privacy governance processes.

The ideal candidate possesses deep knowledge of international privacy regulations, strong consulting experience, and the ability to translate complex legal requirements into actionable business controls.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Conduct GDPR and UK GDPR readiness assessments and gap analyses. ● Develop and implement GDPR compliance programs and remediation roadmaps. ● Prepare and maintain Records of Processing Activities (ROPA).
  • Perform Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs), Legitimate Interest Assessments (LIAs), and Transfer Impact Assessments (TIAs).
  • Draft, review, and negotiate Data Processing Agreements (DPAs). ● Review privacy notices, consent mechanisms, cookie disclosures, and privacy documentation.
  • Design and implement Data Subject Rights (DSAR) processes.
  • Advise clients on international data transfer requirements including EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs), UK IDTA/Addendum, and the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework.
  • Assess third-party privacy risks and support vendor due diligence activities. ● Develop privacy policies, governance documentation, and operational procedures. ● Support organizations processing special category data, including healthcare and clinical research information.
  • Provide guidance regarding Article 27 representative requirements and supervisory authority interactions.
  • Deliver client workshops, executive presentations, and privacy awareness training. ● Collaborate with cybersecurity consultants to align privacy and security controls. ● Remain current on GDPR guidance, enforcement actions, and evolving privacy regulations.

Required Qualifications

Education

Bachelor's degree in Information Security, Privacy, Law, Business, Computer Science, Healthcare Administration, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).

Professional Experience

  • Five (5) or more years of GDPR consulting or privacy compliance experience. ● Demonstrated experience implementing GDPR compliance programs. ● Experience conducting GDPR readiness assessments and gap analyses. ● Experience preparing and maintaining ROPA documentation.
  • Experience performing DPIAs, LIAs, and TIAs.
  • Experience drafting and reviewing Data Processing Agreements. ● Experience developing privacy governance programs.
  • Experience advising executive leadership and client stakeholders. ● Experience supporting multinational organizations is preferred.
  • Previous consulting experience strongly preferred.

Technical Knowledge

Strong working knowledge of:

● EU GDPR

● UK GDPR

  • Records of Processing Activities (ROPA)
  • Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs)
  • Legitimate Interest Assessments (LIAs)

● Transfer Impact Assessments (TIAs)

● Data Subject Rights (DSAR)

● Data Processing Agreements (DPAs)

● International Data Transfers

  • EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs)

● UK IDTA/Addendum

● EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework

● Vendor Risk Management

● Privacy by Design

● Privacy Governance Frameworks

  • Article 27 Representative Requirements

● Consent Management

● Privacy Notices

● Data Mapping

● Data Retention

● Special Category Data Processing

Preferred Industry Experience

Experience supporting organizations within one or more of the following industries is highly desirable:

● Healthcare

● Life Sciences

● Biotechnology

● Clinical Research

● Pharmaceutical

● Medical Device

● SaaS

● Technology

Knowledge of the following is preferred:

● ICH-GCP

● Clinical Trial Regulations

● Informed Consent Requirements

● HIPAA

  • Processing of Special Category Health Data

Preferred Certifications

One or more of the following certifications is preferred:

● CIPP/E

● CIPM

● CIPT

● ISO/IEC 27701 Lead Implementer

● ISO/IEC 27701 Lead Auditor

● ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer

● ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Auditor

● Equivalent IAPP Privacy Certification

Core Competencies

● Privacy Consulting

● Regulatory Interpretation

● Risk Assessment

● Executive Communication

● Client Relationship Management

● Documentation Development

● Problem Solving

● Project Management

● Cross-functional Collaboration

● Presentation Skills

● Critical Thinking

● Attention to Detail

Success Measures

Success in this role will be measured by the consultant's ability to:

  • Deliver GDPR consulting engagements on time and within scope. ● Produce high-quality compliance documentation requiring minimal revisions. ● Successfully guide clients toward GDPR compliance.
  • Maintain high client satisfaction ratings.
  • Identify privacy risks and recommend practical remediation strategies. ● Build trusted advisor relationships with executive stakeholders.
  • Stay current with evolving privacy regulations and enforcement guidance.

Top Roles & Responsibilities

  • Conduct GDPR and UK GDPR gap assessments and compliance reviews. ● Develop client privacy compliance programs and remediation roadmaps. ● Create and maintain GDPR documentation including ROPA, DPIAs, LIAs, TIAs, and DPAs.
  • Advise clients on international data transfers and cross-border privacy requirements. ● Design processes supporting Data Subject Rights Requests (DSARs) and privacy governance.
  • Review privacy notices, consent mechanisms, vendor agreements, and third-party privacy risks.
  • Deliver consulting, training, and executive guidance while translating regulatory requirements into practical business controls.

Non-Negotiables

  • Demonstrated GDPR consulting experience.
  • Strong working knowledge of EU GDPR and UK GDPR.
  • Experience conducting DPIAs, LIAs, TIAs, and preparing ROPA.
  • Experience drafting and reviewing Data Processing Agreements.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work directly with executive-level clients.

Together with your team, you will design and implement system architecture, apply SRE and DevOps best practices, perform infrastructure migration, capacity planning and security audits, and enhance automation, resource scaling, cost optimization, monitoring, and troubleshooting.

You will also drive AI-powered automation and introduce AI-assisted workflows and practices across the team. Most importantly, you will ensure continuous availability and reliability.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Observability administration knowledge (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki)

  • Strong interest in AI methodology and automation

Leap is revolutionizing the event technology industry by empowering organizers to create experiences that are more engaging, more thrilling, and more impactful than ever before. Administrative & Systems

Leap Event Technology is a remote-friendly company. However, we do offer the option of working in the office for employees located in Montréal (CAN), Pittsburgh (U.S.), Dallas (U.S.), Sydney (AUS). All of our offices are stocked with snacks and drinks and we provide a free lunch every week. We offer a monthly travel stipend, and even host the occasional themed party and happy hour!

If you don’t live near an office but happen to be visiting nearby, you can work from the office for as long as you need.

raw.description:
Position Overview

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will architect and build the foundational data pipeline infrastructure that powers our decentralized Data Mesh strategy. In this role, you will support the transition of our data ecosystem from legacy on-prem architecture to a modern cloud data platform leveraging Snowflake.

You will design reference architectures and reusable pipeline patterns that support batch, event-based, and streaming data movement. Crucially, you will ensure our data platform is "AI-ready" by building the high-quality pipelines and robust semantic layers needed to drive our next-generation "Self-Service 2.0" natural language data capabilities. Beyond technical execution, you will lead a small data engineering team and serve as a technical mentor to decentralized analysts across the business, empowering them to build high-quality, self-service data products. 

Key Responsibilities

  • Pipeline Architecture: Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines supporting batch, real-time streaming, and event-driven data movement from on-prem and cloud sources. 
  • Snowflake Platform Ownership: Serve as the core developer for our Snowflake data platform, ensuring optimal performance, modeling, and storage structures. 
  • AI Readiness & Semantic Modeling: Architect and build transform pipelines that deliver high-quality data inputs to Snowflake and dbt AI features. Design and maintain the robust semantic layers and metadata models required to power "Self-Service 2.0" natural language user interfaces. 
  • Data Mesh Enablement: Establish robust reference architectures, standard templates, and CI/CD best practices to enable decentralized line-of-business teams to build safely. 
  • Leadership & Mentorship: Provide direct management and career mentorship to one data engineer (with room to grow). Act as a guide for self-taught domain data analysts to mature their engineering practices. 
  • Modernization & Tooling: Drive the adoption of dbt for data transformation and explore the integration of AWS and Azure cloud data tools (ADF, Azure Functions, Stream Analytics) to optimize data flow. 

Qualifications & Experience

  • Experience: 5–7 years of dedicated data engineering experience, with a proven track record of building production-grade data pipelines. 
  • Snowflake Expertise: Advanced, hands-on experience with Snowflake architecture, performance tuning, and data sharing is a strict requirement. 
  • Data Integration: Proven experience moving data across hybrid environments (on-prem to cloud) utilizing batch, streaming (e.g., Stream Analytics), and event-driven patterns. 
  • Semantic & AI Context: Experience building or maintaining semantic layers (e.g., dbt Semantic Layer, Snowflake Cortex/Semantic definitions) and structuring data specifically for consumption by downstream AI, LLM, or natural language search features. 
  • Software Skills: Strong Python skills, particularly in cloud environments (e.g., writing Azure Functions for data workloads) and strong SQL capabilities. 
  • Frameworks & Clouds: Exposure to dbt is highly preferred. Experience with Azure data tools (Azure Data Factory) is a strong plus; familiarity with AWS data ecosystems is nice to have. 
  • Leadership Style: A collaborative, coaching mindset with a passion for teaching, establishing governance, and raising the technical bar for cross-functional teams. 

Why Join Nimble Gravity?
You'll help leading financial institutions and other clients adopt AI in meaningful ways. You'll work directly with clients, engineers, and AI specialists to turn emerging technology into measurable business outcomes. If you enjoy teaching, facilitating, influencing, and helping people embrace new ways of working, we'd love to talk.

Nimble Gravity is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

We do not sponsor H1B visas

Founded in 1988 and headquartered in Greensboro, NC, apexanalytix is a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Supplier Risk Management Solutions. More than 320 of the world's largest companies use our AI-native platform to protect over $9.5 trillion in annual spend.

apexanalytix is seeking a product executive to serve as VP of Product, reporting to the Chief Product & Technology Officer (CPTO) and sitting on the CPTO's leadership team. The role has two linked mandates. First, lead product discovery across the company, so that what we build is valuable, usable, feasible and viable before engineering commits to it. Second, own how investment requests reach engineering: one transparent process that weighs every ask against outcomes and funds standing teams rather than projects.

We are moving to the product operating model. Product, engineering and design are organized into four persistent trios: Supplier Journey, Buyer Journey, Data & Intelligence, and Platform. Each is funded against outcome goals. The VP of Product leads the product leaders of all four trios, including the Platform product leader in Noida, India, and the product operations function.

The VP of Product works as a peer and partner to the Head of Design, VP Engineering, Head of AI & Data, SVP Engineering & Head of India GCC, and Head of GRC. Outside the CPTO organization, the role works closely with Go-to-Market, Professional Services, Assurance & Recovery services, finance and the executive team. Deep fluency in the product operating model described by Marty Cagan is required. Practical experience running Teresa Torres's continuous discovery habits is highly valued, as is a background in governance, risk and compliance (GRC), especially third-party risk management.

Trusted Advisor

  • Advises the CPTO and the executive team on product strategy, market and customer insight, and where to invest next across supplier onboarding, risk, payment controls, recovery, and data and agentic products.
  • Is the voice of the customer and of product discovery on the CPTO leadership team, bringing evidence rather than opinion to investment debates.
  • Coaches executives and stakeholders on the product operating model: why we fund outcomes instead of features, and how discovery reduces the risk of what we build.

Roles and Requirements

Product discovery

  • Discovery leadership. Owns how discovery is done across all four trios. Ensures every team tackles value, usability, feasibility and business viability risk before engineering commits to build.
  • Continuous discovery habits. Establishes weekly customer touchpoints by each product trio, with suppliers, procurement, AP, finance and compliance users. Introduces opportunity solution trees, interview snapshots and rapid assumption testing as everyday practice, not special projects.
  • Insight engine. Builds a shared source of customer, market, usage and win/loss insight. Draws on implementation and recovery services teams, who see client problems first, as core discovery partners.
  • Discovery standards. Sets clear expectations for what evidence a team needs before moving an idea into delivery, and makes that evidence visible in reviews.

Investment coordination

  • Single intake for engineering demand. Owns the process by which requests from Go-to-Market, Professional Services, clients, partners, compliance and the executive team reach engineering. Every request is framed as a problem and an outcome, not a solution.
  • Portfolio allocation. Leads, with the VP Engineering, SVP Engineering & Head of India GCC and Head of AI & Data, the allocation of capacity across the four trios. Balances new value, client commitments, platform health, security and compliance work, and technical debt, and makes the trade-offs explicit.
  • Outcome-based funding. Turns the shift from project funding to standing, outcome-funded teams into a working practice. Defines outcome goals per trio with finance and the CPTO, and reports progress against them.
  • Transparent decisions. Runs a regular investment review where requests are prioritized against outcomes and evidence. Makes sure stakeholders understand what was funded, what was not, and why.

Product strategy and leadership

  • Product vision and strategy. Sets a compelling product vision and a focused product strategy that connects company objectives to the problems each trio is asked to solve.
  • Product organization. Leads the Supplier Journey, Buyer Journey, Data & Intelligence and Platform product leaders, and the product managers beneath them. Hires, coaches and develops product managers who are empowered to own outcomes, not manage backlogs.
  • India product presence. Builds Product Management in Noida, starting with the Platform product leader, so India-owned domains have product partners close to the engineers.
  • Product operations. Leads product operations: product analytics and instrumentation, research operations, the investment intake process, and the product operating cadence.
  • Trio partnership. Works as one team with design and engineering leaders at every level. Product, design and engineering share goals, plan together and review together.

Customer and market

  • Market leadership. Keeps apexanalytix ahead in supplier risk management and procure-to-pay controls, including AI-native and agentic capabilities.
  • Go-to-market alignment. Partners with Go-to-Market leadership on packaging, pricing input and launches, so customers see one connected platform aligned to the journey structure.
  • Compliance as a product requirement. Works with the Head of GRC so that regulatory, security and third-party risk requirements shape product decisions early, both for our own controls and for the compliance outcomes our clients buy from us.

First-Year Priorities

  • Publish a product vision and product strategy, approved by the CPTO, that sets the problems each of the four trios is asked to solve.
  • Agree first-year outcome goals for each trio with the CPTO, engineering leaders and finance, including a revenue goal for standalone data products.
  • Launch a single investment intake and review process for all engineering demand, with every request tied to an outcome and every decision visible to stakeholders.
  • Get every product trio running weekly customer touchpoints, with opportunity solution trees and assumption tests visible in quarterly reviews.
  • Set a baseline for discovery and delivery health (for example, share of shipped work validated in discovery, time from idea to validated learning, and adoption of what ships), and show measurable improvement against it.
  • Name or hire the product leaders for all four trios, including the Platform product leader in Noida, and close gaps in the product manager bench.
  • Stand up product operations with reliable product analytics across the platform.
  • Work with the Head of Design and engineering leaders so that every team operates as a trio with shared goals, joint planning and joint reviews.

Required Skills

  • 15+ years in product management, including 5+ years leading product organizations through product leaders and managers in B2B enterprise SaaS.
  • Deep, practical fluency in the product operating model as described by Marty Cagan (Inspired, Empowered, Transformed): empowered product teams, outcomes over output, product strategy, and the distinction between discovery and delivery.
  • A proven record of leading a transformation from a project- or feature-driven model to empowered, outcome-funded product teams, including winning over executives and stakeholders outside product.
  • Hands-on experience leading product discovery at scale, including addressing value, usability, feasibility and viability risk before committing engineering investment.
  • Experience owning portfolio-level investment decisions across multiple teams: setting capacity allocation, saying no with evidence, and making trade-offs transparent to executives and Go-to-Market leaders.
  • A track record of hiring, coaching and developing strong product managers and product leaders.
  • Strong analytical skills, with experience using product analytics, experimentation and qualitative research to make decisions.
  • Experience working in close partnership with design and engineering as a trio, and with distributed teams across US and India time zones.
  • Experience with AI-native or data products, and sound judgment about where AI and agents create real customer value.
  • Strong executive presence, able to represent product strategy credibly to the CPTO, the executive team, clients and, as needed, the Board.

Preferred Skills

  • Practical experience running Teresa Torres's continuous discovery habits (Continuous Discovery Habits): weekly customer interviews by the product trio, opportunity solution trees, and rapid assumption testing, ideally introduced across several teams.
  • Background in governance, risk and compliance (GRC) software or practice, especially third-party risk management (TPRM), supplier risk or vendor due diligence.
  • Domain experience in procure-to-pay, accounts payable, supplier management, payment fraud prevention or fintech.
  • Experience building product management in an India-based Global Capability Center.
  • Experience in a PE-backed or high-growth SaaS company, connecting product investment to revenue, retention and EBITDA.
  • Experience building and selling data products or APIs as standalone revenue lines.

Education Levels/Credentials (Degree types and Emphasis)

  • An undergraduate degree in business, computer science, engineering or a related field is required. A graduate degree or an MBA is a plus but not required.

Physical/Remote/Travel Work Environment

  • United States, with remote or hybrid arrangements considered. Regular overlap with India business hours for work with the Noida team.
  • Travel required: regular, including client visits for discovery, and periodic travel to apexanalytix HQ in Greensboro, NC, and the Noida GCC.

Scope Boundaries

This role owns product discovery, product vision and strategy, the product organization across all four trios, product operations, and the process by which investment requests reach engineering. Engineering delivery, quality and technical standards sit with the VP Engineering, the SVP Engineering & Head of India GCC and the Chief Architect. Design leadership, the design system and research practice sit with the Head of Design; the VP of Product partners closely on discovery. The Data & Intelligence trio is led by the Head of AI & Data, with its product leader reporting to this role. Security policy, compliance and third-party risk for apexanalytix itself sit with the Head of GRC. Client commercial relationships, pricing and packaging decisions sit with Go-to-Market leadership, with input from this role.

Over the years, we’ve discovered that the most effective and successful associates at apexanalytix are people who have a specific combination of values, skills, and behaviors that we call “The apex Way”. Read more about The apex Way - apexanalytix.com/careers/

Benefits

At apexanalytix we know that our associates are the reason behind our successes. We truly value you as an associate and part of our professional family. Our goal is to offer the very best benefits possible to you and your loved ones. When it comes to benefits, whether for yourself or your family the most important aspect is choice. And we get that. apexanalytix offers competitive benefits for the countries that we serve, in addition to our BeWell@apex initiative that encourages employees’ growth in six key wellness areas: Emotional, Physical, Community, Financial, Social, and Intelligence.

With resources such as a strong Mentor Program, Internal Training Portal, plus Education, Tuition, and Certification Assistance, we provide tools for our associates to grow and develop.

raw.title: Senior Engineer, Workforce IAM
raw.excerpt: Cardinal Health, Inc.  (NYSE: CAH) is a global healthcare services and products company.
raw.description:
Cardinal Health, Inc. (NYSE: CAH) is a global healthcare services and products company. We provide customized solutions for hospitals, healthcare systems, pharmacies, ambulatory surgery centers, clinical laboratories, physician offices and patients in the home. We are a distributor of pharmaceuticals and specialty products; a global manufacturer and distributor of medical and laboratory products; an operator of nuclear pharmacies and manufacturing facilities; and a provider of performance and data solutions. Working to be healthcare’s most trusted partner, our customer-centric focus drives continuous improvement and leads to innovative solutions that improve the lives of people every day. With approximately 50,000 employees worldwide, Cardinal Health ranks among the top fifteen in the Fortune 500.


Department Overview:

Information Security and Risk develops, implements, and enforces security controls to protect the organization's technology assets from intentional or inadvertent modification, disclosure, or destruction. The function of this job family is to ensure secure, authorized, and compliant access to the organization's data, systems, and physical resources. It focuses on defining, creating, managing, and governing digital identities and their associated access privileges to protect the enterprise from security breaches, insider threats, and regulatory non-compliance

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Identity and Access Management (IAM) Senior Engineer to join our Workforce Identity team. In this role, you will architect, scale, and modernize the systems that secure over 50,000 global employees, contractors, and critical distribution operations. You will drive identity strategy across a hyper-scale, hybrid multi-cloud environment, spearhead rapid M&A integrations, champion Zero Standing Privilege (ZSP), and architect next-generation non-human and frontline identity solutions.

Responsibilities:

M&A Architecture & Federation Strategy

  • Architect repeatable, high-velocity identity blueprints for Mergers, Acquisitions, and Divestitures, reducing subsidiary integration timeframes from months to weeks.
  • Lead cross-domain identity consolidation across disparate identity providers (Okta, Entra ID, Ping) and divergent enterprise directories.
  • Design robust cross-cloud federation, B2B collaboration frameworks, and tenant boundary governance.
  • Lead IAM technical workstreams for Mergers, Acquisitions, and Divestitures. Consolidate disparate identity providers (IdPs) into a unified enterprise SSO platform. Design and execute cross-domain authentication and federation strategies.
  • Lead IAM discovery, identity migration, and system consolidation for newly acquired business entities.
  • Direct experience migrating users, mapping attributes, and consolidating divergent directories.

Architecture influence and decision-making

  • Define enterprise IAM architecture standards: Formulate technical standards, architectural patterns, and reference blueprints for enterprise SSO, Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), and directory services.
  • Technical authority and vendor SoW evaluation: Act as a critical architectural authority to evaluate third-party integration patterns, challenge vendor Statements of Work (SoWs) for high-complexity migrations (e.g., ADFS to Okta) and establish technical decommissioning strategies for legacy identity platforms.

Hybrid and multi-cloud IAM

  • Architect hybrid and multi-cloud IAM bridges: Design, govern, and scale secure identity bridges linking legacy on-premises infrastructure (Active Directory, ADFS) with hyper-scale multi-cloud environments (GCP, AWS, Azure/Entra ID) and SaaS ecosystems (Okta, SailPoint).
  • Privileged Access and JIT governance: Define and architect robust Zero Standing Privilege (ZSP) and Just-In-Time (JIT) access control patterns using Privileged Access Management (PAM - CyberArk, HashiCorp Vault) and Cloud Infrastructure Entitlement Management (CIEM) to reduce the on-premises and cloud attack surface.

Emerging tech trends and business growth

  • Modern Identity roadmaps (NHIM and ISPM): Research, evaluate, and integrate emerging industry trends—such as Non-Human Identity Management (NHIM), Identity Security Posture Management (ISPM), and agentic/AI security controls—into the long-term IAM roadmap.
  • Agile Identity for business scale: Ensure identity systems are agile and scalable enough to support Cardinal Health's rapid business expansion, M&A pipeline, and digital healthcare operations without introducing friction

IGA Integrations

  • Design repeatable, high-velocity identity blueprints for Mergers, Acquisitions, and Divestitures, reducing subsidiary integration timeframes from months to weeks.
  • Lead cross-domain identity consolidation across disparate identity providers (Okta, Entra ID, Ping) and divergent enterprise directories.
  • Design robust cross-cloud federation, B2B collaboration frameworks, and tenant boundary governance
  • Authoritative Source Integration: Design and implement seamless integrations with HRMS platforms (e.g., Workday, SuccessFactors, PeopleSoft) to drive the identity lifecycle.
  • Formulate policy-driven access models (RBAC/PBAC) and automated Segregation of Duties (SoD) frameworks meeting strict SOX ITGC, HIPAA, and GDPR requirements.
  • Architect specialized authentication solutions (contactless RFID badge tap-and-go, biometric FIDO2 smart cards, shared kiosk sessions) supporting nuclear pharmacies, manufacturing plants, and distribution centers.
  • Design "Single Pane of Glass" self-service capabilities for people leaders to proactively monitor and right-size direct report access.
  • Partner with IAM Engineering to establish self-healing provisioning patterns achieving 99.999% core availability
  • Application Onboarding: Design, develop, and configure SailPoint connectors for Active Directory (AD), JDBC, and Web Services (REST/SOAP).
  • Automated Provisioning: Configure and maintain Birthright provisioning to ensure immediate, policy-driven access for joiners on day one.
  • Process Automation: Automate lifecycle events (Joiner, Mover, Leaver) and request-based provisioning workflows.
  • Expand Cloud Infrastructure Entitlement Management (CIEM) to continuously discover and eliminate over-privileged assignments

Automation and Workflows

  • Develop automated workflows to streamline user onboarding, transitions, and offboarding.
  • Build API-driven automations to reduce manual provisioning overhead.
  • Implement infrastructure-as-code (IaC) principles for IAM configurations.

Security Policy and Compliance

  • Ensure IAM systems and processes comply with regulatory requirements (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, SOX) and internal security policies, providing auditable records of access activities. Protect against data breaches by ensuring only authorized personnel can access sensitive information.
  • Solution Design & Implementation: Design, implement, and maintain IAM solutions including Single Sign-On (SSO), Identity life cycle management, IGA and PAM.
  • Collaboration & Communication: Coordinate cross-functional teams, including Information Security, IT Operations, HR, and Application Development, to ensure effective IAM implementation and seamless integration with business processes. Communicate complex security concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Documentation & Best Practices: Develop, review, and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, configuration guides, and operational procedures. Stay up-to-date with IAM best practices, regulatory requirements, and security trends.

Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience: 10+ years in Information Security and Identity Management, with at least 5+ years operating as a Lead or Principal Enterprise IAM Architect within a Fortune 500 or hyper-scale enterprise preferred.
  • Technical Expertise:
    • Deep theoretical and practical command of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SAML 2.0, SCIM 2.0, FIDO2/WebAuthn, and Kerberos.
    • Proven architectural authority across enterprise IdPs (Microsoft Entra ID, Okta), IGA platforms (SailPoint IdentityIQ / Identity Security Cloud), and PAM solutions (CyberArk, HashiCorp Vault).
    • Demonstrated success leading identity discovery, tenant consolidation, and domain migration workstreams across complex, multi-entity corporate structures.
    • Comprehensive familiarity with SOX 404 ITGC controls, HIPAA Security Rule, and international data sovereignty frameworks.
    • Exceptional executive communication, stakeholder diplomacy, and ability to translate cryptographic/identity concepts into clear business risk decisions .
    • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines in a fast-paced M&A environment.
    • Adaptability to stay ahead of evolving IAM technologies and security threats.

What is expected of you and others at this level

  • Applies advanced knowledge and understanding of concepts, principles, and technical capabilities to manage a wide variety of projects
  • Participates in the development of policies and procedures to achieve specific goals
  • Recommends new practices, processes, metrics, or models
  • Works on or may lead complex projects of large scope
  • Projects may have significant and long-term impact
  • Provides solutions which may set precedent
  • Independently determines method for completion of new projects
  • Receives guidance on overall project objectives
  • Acts as a mentor to less experienced colleagues

Anticipated salary range: $125,300 - $178,900

Bonus eligible: Yes

Benefits: Cardinal Health offers a wide variety of benefits and programs to support health and well-being.

  • Medical, dental and vision coverage
  • Paid time off plan
  • Health savings account (HSA)
  • 401k savings plan
  • Access to wages before pay day with myFlexPay
  • Flexible spending accounts (FSAs)
  • Short- and long-term disability coverage
  • Work-Life resources
  • Paid parental leave
  • Healthy lifestyle programs

Application window anticipated to close: 11/23/2026 *if interested in opportunity, please submit application as soon as possible.

The salary range listed is an estimate. Pay at Cardinal Health is determined by multiple factors including, but not limited to, a candidate’s geographical location, relevant education, experience and skills and an evaluation of internal pay equity.

We celebrate the power of our differences to create better solutions for our customers by ensuring employees can be their authentic selves each day. Cardinal Health is an Equal Opportunity employer. Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.

We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

Job Title

Manager Client Support I

About this role:

The Client Support Manager leads Community Financial Institutions (CFI) merchant services support operations for merchants, financial institution partners, and internal teams. You will manage service delivery, associate performance, escalation handling, operational controls, and process improvements. Your work helps improve inquiry resolution, support consistency, regulatory adherence, and partner communication across CFI merchant services.


What you'll do:

  • Lead daily CFI merchant services support operations, including assigned associates, team leads, or supervisors within the reporting structure.
  • Align staffing, schedules, backup coverage, and workload distribution with call volumes, inquiry demand, partner needs, and service commitments.
  • Interview, onboard, coach, cross-train, and develop associates to improve product knowledge, issue resolution, documentation, and service delivery.
  • Conduct team and individual check-ins, complete performance reviews, address training needs, and coordinate people-management matters with HR.
  • Own CFI support workflows from intake and triage through assignment, resolution, follow-up, and closure.
  • Oversee escalations, assign primary and backup ownership, coordinate timely resolution, and provide accurate status updates to stakeholders.
  • Monitor service levels, inquiry aging, backlog, quality, productivity, repeat contacts, and resolution trends to identify risks and corrective actions.
  • Responsibilities listed are not intended to be all-inclusive and may be modified as necessary.

Experience you'll need to have:

  • 6+ years of experience in operations, client support, merchant services, financial services, or financial institution support environments.
  • 2+ years of experience managing and developing teams in a customer support, operations, or service delivery environment.
  • 3+ years of experience managing service levels, inquiry queues, escalation processes, staffing plans, or operational reporting.
  • 3+ years of experience developing procedures, maintaining knowledge resources, or implementing process improvements with leadership or compliance approval.
  • 2+ years of experience using Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft PowerPoint, Microsoft Access, internet-based tools, and email for reporting, documentation, and communication.
  • 2+ years of experience preparing written updates, presenting operational results, analyzing service trends, and documenting issue resolution actions.
  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Business Administration, Finance, Operations Management, or a related field or equivalent combination of education, related experience and/or military experience.

Experience that would be great to have:

  • Experience supporting Community Financial Institutions merchant services, financial institution partners, or a comparable merchant support operational function.
  • Experience leading cross-functional projects, root-cause analysis, or process-improvement initiatives across operations, training, compliance, and relationship management teams.
  • Experience participating in financial institution partner visits, account reviews, service reviews, or merchant issue resolution discussions.
  • Experience developing merchant services procedures, partner education content, or associate development programs.

How you'll work:

  • This role requires use of a computer and audio equipment.

Sponsorship:

You must currently possess valid and unrestricted U.S. work authorization to be considered for this role. Individuals with temporary visas including, but not limited to, F-1 (OPT, CPT, STEM), H-1B, H-2, or TN, or any candidate requiring sponsorship, now or in the future, will not be considered for this role.


Benefits at Fiserv:

  • Fuel Your Life program to support your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being.
  • Paid holidays and generous time away policies.
  • No-cost mental health support through Employee Assistance Programs.

About Nerdio

At Nerdio, our mission is to simplify the lives of IT professionals and maximize their Microsoft cloud and end user computing investments.

We support organizations of all sizes looking to deploy, manage, and cost-optimize native Microsoft technologies. We partner with Enterprises and Managed Service Providers all over the world to add value on top of their existing native Microsoft investments like Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), Windows 365, and Microsoft Intune.

Created in 2016, Nerdio has always taken a market-leading and collaborative approach to cloud deployment and management. In fact, our product roadmap is greatly influenced by the regular feedback we receive from having seen companies deploy AVD into production environments several thousand times using Nerdio technology.

Today, Nerdio is used in over 50 countries by more than 15,000 organizations of every size and vertical. We’re committed to delivering exceptional service and support, which starts with identifying and supporting the best staff possible.

We are a fast-moving, nimble company looking for individuals who are collaborative, empathetic, driven and who love to move at the speed of light. If you want to be part of the AVD transformation that Microsoft and Nerdio are leading, then we want to speak with you.

About the role

You will be responsible for leading a team of motivated and skilled Support Engineers for our AMER-based Support Team. This role balances hands-on technical support with team leadership, operational oversight, and quality control. You will be leading a team of highly functioning individuals comprised of Level 1 and 2 engineers. This is a working team lead role. You will oversee tickets, coach engineers, and drive operational discipline across the team to achieve a world class support experience for Nerdio customers.

What you'll do

Operational Ownership

  • Monitor metrics such as; ticket flow, backlog, and team performance

  • Partner with the Escalation team to ensure clean, well-documented handoffs

Nerdio Customer Support

Technical Expertise

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Escalation teams to ensure clean handoffs and efficient resolution

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of technical support, cloud infrastructure, or enterprise systems experience
  • Strong experience with Azure Virtual Desktop and Intune environments
  • Comfortable leading peers; setting technical and operational standards
  • Clear communication with both customers and internal stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience leading or mentoring others is advantageous
  • Microsoft AZ-104 (Azure Administrator) and/or AZ-140 (Azure Virtual Desktop Specialty) certifications are advantageous
  • Prior hands-on experience with Nerdio Manager for either Enterprise or MSP, is advantageous

Position Summary:

The Operations Director is responsible for leading complex, multi-account automotive dealership operations, ensuring consistent service delivery, operational excellence, and achievement of business objectives across multi-rooftop dealer groups. This role requires extensive experience in automotive retail and dealership operations, with a strong understanding of dealership workflows, Sales and Service Business Development Center (BDC) functions, and US and global automotive retail environments. The ideal candidate combines operational discipline, strategic account management, commercial acumen, and strong people leadership to optimize performance, strengthen client partnerships, and develop high-performing teams.

As a key leader at Pinnacle Intelligence, the Operations Director will help advance our position as an AI-powered automotive intelligence partner, leveraging technology, automation, analytics, and AI-enabled solutions to improve dealership performance, enhance customer engagement, and deliver scalable operational value.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Multi-Account Dealership Operations Management: Lead complex, multi-account dealership portfolios, including multi-rooftop dealer groups, ensuring consistent operational performance, service quality, productivity, and achievement of client and business targets across accounts.
  • Automotive Retail & Dealership Operations: Apply deep knowledge of automotive dealership operations, including sales and service workflows, customer lifecycle management, customer engagement, lead conversion, appointment setting, and retention programs. Translate dealership business requirements into effective, scalable service delivery strategies.
  • Sales & Service BDC Operations: Oversee Sales and Service Business Development Center (BDC) operations across multiple dealership accounts. Drive Sales BDC performance through inbound lead management, timely follow-ups, CRM cadence adherence, lead nurturing, and appointment conversion. Optimize Service BDC performance through service appointment scheduling, maintenance outreach, recall campaigns, customer retention, and service lane utilization.
  • Operational Excellence & Governance: Establish and maintain standardized operating procedures, performance standards, governance frameworks, and accountability measures across accounts while allowing for individual dealership requirements and business priorities.
  • Performance & Financial Management: Monitor operational KPIs, service-level agreements, productivity, quality, and budget performance. Identify opportunities to improve cost efficiency, workforce utilization, and overall account profitability while maintaining service delivery standards.
  • Client Relationship & Account Management: Build strong relationships with dealership clients and key stakeholders, aligning operational priorities with business objectives. Lead performance discussions, communicate insights and improvement plans, address operational challenges, and identify opportunities to strengthen client partnerships and expand services.
  • Technology, Automation & AI Transformation: Champion technology-enabled transformation across dealership delivery operations. Drive the adoption of automation, AI-powered tools, analytics, and digital solutions to improve lead management, customer engagement, appointment conversion, service retention, productivity, and operational scalability.
  • Leadership & Management Development: Coach, mentor, and develop operations managers and account leaders across the portfolio. Establish clear performance expectations, strengthen accountability, build leadership capability, and maintain a strong management bench capable of delivering consistent results across multiple accounts.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify operational gaps, analyze performance trends, and implement data-driven improvements that enhance efficiency, quality, customer experience, and scalability. Promote continuous improvement and the adoption of best practices across accounts.
  • Risk & Compliance Management: Ensure adherence to operational policies, client requirements, quality standards, data-handling practices, and applicable regulatory requirements across assigned accounts.
  • Business Growth & Scalability: Partner with executive leadership and cross-functional teams to support account expansion, new client implementations, operational transitions, and the deployment of scalable solutions that reinforce Pinnacle's position as an automotive intelligence partner.

Skills & Qualifications:

Required:

  • Proven track record managing complex, multi-account operations, with responsibility for operational performance, client delivery, and business results across multiple accounts or business units.
  • Deep experience in automotive retail and dealership operations, including dealership workflows, customer lifecycle management, and sales and service support.
  • Strong operational expertise in US and global automotive retail environments, with the ability to translate dealership requirements into effective service delivery processes.
  • Demonstrated experience managing Sales and Service BDC operations, including inbound lead management, CRM follow-up cadence, appointment setting, service scheduling, recall campaigns, and customer retention.
  • Proven ability to manage operational KPIs, service-level agreements, productivity, quality, and cost efficiency across complex account portfolios.
  • Strong leadership experience coaching and developing operations managers, establishing accountability, and building high-performing teams across multiple accounts.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive process improvements, operational standardization, and performance optimization across multi-site or multi-rooftop dealership portfolios.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, client management, and stakeholder communication skills.

Preferred:

  • Experience supporting US automotive dealerships through outsourced operations, particularly multi-rooftop dealer groups and multi-account portfolios.
  • Familiarity with automotive Dealer Management Systems (DMS) and CRM platforms, such as VinSolutions, Elead, CDK, and Reynolds & Reynolds.
  • Experience implementing AI-enabled solutions, workflow automation, analytics, or technology-driven transformation in dealership support operations.
  • Experience managing geographically distributed teams or multiple dealership accounts with varying operational requirements.
  • Familiarity with Lean Six Sigma, continuous improvement methodologies, and operational transformation.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, or a related field.

raw.excerpt: Serverfarm is a leading developer and operator of data centers with over 750+ locations and key customer relationships in 45 countries.
raw.description:
Serverfarm is a leading developer and operator of data centers with over 750+ locations and key customer relationships in 45 countries. We're revolutionizing how data centers operate across North America, Western Europe, and Israel, serving the world's leading technology and hyperscale companies. With Manulife Investment Management's acquisition in 2023 and our award-winning InCommand platform we're positioned for explosive growth as AI adoption and cloud migration drive unprecedented demand for data center capacity.
A career at Serverfarm means being at the forefront of digital infrastructure innovation, where your work directly impacts how the world's data is managed and secured. As we target 4x growth over the next four years, you'll have unprecedented opportunities to take on new challenges, develop cutting-edge skills, and grow your career across our expanding global operations.
Join our team of innovators and help shape the future of sustainable data centers while building a career without boundaries.

The next InCommand is a new solution, built on a new technology stack, designed from the ground up for the way modern data centers, including high-density and AI infrastructure, are operated. It will be delivered as a cloud service and be deployable in customers' own environments, built API-first, and developed with an agent-assisted engineering practice in which coding agents work from specifications under human review. Our own facilities are the first customer, so everything we build is proven in real, live operations before anyone else sees it.

At the heart of that product is its platform: one model of how a data center works, and the architecture that serves it fast to a live operations center and to AI working over years of history. We are looking for a hands-on Platform Architect who designs that foundation and writes the first code with AI-assisted tooling: the kind of architect whose decisions are in the repository, not only in the decision record. It is a rare chance to define a platform from a clean sheet, for an industry evolving faster than ever under exponentially growing demand for compute and AI, while standing on a decade of operational knowledge about what it has to do. You partner closely with Product Management, Integrations and Developer Platform.

Key Accountabilities

    • Build the foundation of the new platform yourself: the control plane and tenancy that everything else sits on, written with coding agents and the engineers who join you, and own the first code merged on the new platform.

    • Design and own the unified data model and its evolution, publish it with the public API as a specification others build against, and define the platform architecture around it (data stores, identity and multi-tenancy, API layer).

    • Own retrieval and query performance at telemetry scale: storage choices, query patterns for live consoles and for analytical and AI workloads, latency targets, tenant isolation at the data layer.

    • Choose the technology stack and platform standards, and recommend the cloud the platform starts on and how it stays portable.

    • Design how the platform integrates large language models and other AI services to deliver operational intelligence: insights, recommendations and natural-language access to operational data.

    • Define, in partnership with Integrations, the contract by which site data enters the platform.

    • Give technical direction to the engineers who join the new platform in its first months, and set the patterns the team builds on.

Required Skills

    • 10+ years building back-end and platform systems, and in the last three years you have personally shipped a multi-tenant SaaS platform or control plane on Kubernetes, writing production code, as the technical decision-maker.

    • You have designed the domain data model for a complex operational system (assets, hierarchies, time series, events) and owned its evolution across releases, with the compatibility, versioning and migration decisions that came with it.

    • You have delivered retrieval performance at telemetry scale: chosen time-series and relational storage (PostgreSQL with TimescaleDB or equivalent, with a columnar engine such as ClickHouse for analytical and AI workloads), designed queries for live and analytical workloads over long histories, and met API latency targets.

    • You have built hands-on on a major public cloud (GCP, AWS or Azure) with Kubernetes and Helm, with judgment about when a managed service is the right call and when portability matters more.

    • You have built identity, tenancy and security by design into enterprise SaaS.

    • You have designed and published an API or data-model specification that other teams, and ideally external organisations, built against, and written architecture decisions that engineers worked from.

    • You have been a senior individual contributor on a platform's foundational production code.

Preferred Skills

    • Used agentic coding tools and directed and reviewed agent-written code at volume.

    • Knowledge of or experience with DCIM products: the data they manage and how data-center operators use them.

    • Designed platform ingress with Kafka-compatible streaming (Kafka, Redpanda or equivalent) and MQTT brokers (EMQX, HiveMQ or equivalent).

    • Instrumented a platform with OpenTelemetry for its own observability.

    • Integrated large language models into a platform: a model gateway, retrieval over operational data, tool interfaces an assistant can call.

    • Run a platform across public clouds, or shipped software both as a cloud service and in customer-hosted or air-gapped environments.

Position Summary

Amerit Fleet Solutions, one of the leading fleet maintenance companies in the U.S., is seeking an experienced, inspired and mission-driven Senior Operations Manager to join our growing team!

The Senior Operations Manager is responsible for overseeing service operations. This is a remote position that may require up to 40-50% travel. This role involves a multi-faceted approach to maintenance, customer service and account management.

The SOM will have a strong background in operations as well as maintenance/fleet management. The scope of responsibilities will be the management and oversight for fleet managers and local administrators, across multiple regional sites, that will encompass teams of mechanics.

The SOM will oversee the day-to-day operations for the entire region and serve as the account manager. As the account manager the SOM will ensure and coordinate items like billing inquiries, monthly close out, reporting monthly metrics such as PM/DOT and other KPI data, to include SLA’s, EHS and safety for the region. The SOM will be a direct conduit for all customer inquiries and feedback, to include monthly surveys, as well as host weekly and monthly meetings.

Candidates should have a strong and diverse background in diesel repairs; servicing a large fleet of heavy-duty trucks, trailers and equipment.

We are looking for an experienced self-starter with excellent leadership and communication skills. Success will be based in uptime and readiness of the customers assets, an outstanding safety and quality record, EHS compliance, data management, communication, problem solving as well as staffing and overall business performance.

Position Summary

The Manager, Finance Integration & M&A will play a critical role in supporting the company's acquisition strategy by leading financial integration activities across acquired businesses. This position serves as the bridge between deal diligence, financial planning, integration execution, and post-acquisition performance management. The role will partner across Finance, Accounting, IT, Data, Operations, and external advisors to ensure newly acquired businesses are successfully integrated into the organization's financial and reporting environment. The successful candidate will combine strong analytical capabilities, M&A integration experience, FP&A expertise, and the ability to drive projects in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Strategic Projects

  • Develop repeatable integration methodologies and best practices as acquisition activity grows.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

raw.description:
Position Title: Vice President, Product

Reports to: Chief Product & Technology Officer

Location: United States

POSITION DESCRIPTION

apexanalytix is the world's leading provider of supplier onboarding, risk management and recovery solutions. Founded in 1988 and headquartered in Greensboro, NC, apexanalytix is a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Supplier Risk Management Solutions. More than 320 of the world's largest companies use our AI-native platform to protect over $9.5 trillion in annual spend.

apexanalytix is seeking a product executive to serve as VP of Product, reporting to the Chief Product & Technology Officer (CPTO) and sitting on the CPTO's leadership team. The role has two linked mandates. First, lead product discovery across the company, so that what we build is valuable, usable, feasible and viable before engineering commits to it. Second, own how investment requests reach engineering: one transparent process that weighs every ask against outcomes and funds standing teams rather than projects.

We are moving to the product operating model. Product, engineering and design are organized into four persistent trios: Supplier Journey, Buyer Journey, Data & Intelligence, and Platform. Each is funded against outcome goals. The VP of Product leads the product leaders of all four trios, including the Platform product leader in Noida, India, and the product operations function.

The VP of Product works as a peer and partner to the Head of Design, VP Engineering, Head of AI & Data, SVP Engineering & Head of India GCC, and Head of GRC. Outside the CPTO organization, the role works closely with Go-to-Market, Professional Services, Assurance & Recovery services, finance and the executive team. Deep fluency in the product operating model described by Marty Cagan is required. Practical experience running Teresa Torres's continuous discovery habits is highly valued, as is a background in governance, risk and compliance (GRC), especially third-party risk management.

Trusted Advisor

  • Advises the CPTO and the executive team on product strategy, market and customer insight, and where to invest next across supplier onboarding, risk, payment controls, recovery, and data and agentic products.
  • Is the voice of the customer and of product discovery on the CPTO leadership team, bringing evidence rather than opinion to investment debates.
  • Coaches executives and stakeholders on the product operating model: why we fund outcomes instead of features, and how discovery reduces the risk of what we build.

Roles and Requirements

Product discovery

  • Discovery leadership. Owns how discovery is done across all four trios. Ensures every team tackles value, usability, feasibility and business viability risk before engineering commits to build.
  • Continuous discovery habits. Establishes weekly customer touchpoints by each product trio, with suppliers, procurement, AP, finance and compliance users. Introduces opportunity solution trees, interview snapshots and rapid assumption testing as everyday practice, not special projects.
  • Insight engine. Builds a shared source of customer, market, usage and win/loss insight. Draws on implementation and recovery services teams, who see client problems first, as core discovery partners.
  • Discovery standards. Sets clear expectations for what evidence a team needs before moving an idea into delivery, and makes that evidence visible in reviews.

Investment coordination

  • Single intake for engineering demand. Owns the process by which requests from Go-to-Market, Professional Services, clients, partners, compliance and the executive team reach engineering. Every request is framed as a problem and an outcome, not a solution.
  • Portfolio allocation. Leads, with the VP Engineering, SVP Engineering & Head of India GCC and Head of AI & Data, the allocation of capacity across the four trios. Balances new value, client commitments, platform health, security and compliance work, and technical debt, and makes the trade-offs explicit.
  • Outcome-based funding. Turns the shift from project funding to standing, outcome-funded teams into a working practice. Defines outcome goals per trio with finance and the CPTO, and reports progress against them.
  • Transparent decisions. Runs a regular investment review where requests are prioritized against outcomes and evidence. Makes sure stakeholders understand what was funded, what was not, and why.

Product strategy and leadership

  • Product vision and strategy. Sets a compelling product vision and a focused product strategy that connects company objectives to the problems each trio is asked to solve.
  • Product organization. Leads the Supplier Journey, Buyer Journey, Data & Intelligence and Platform product leaders, and the product managers beneath them. Hires, coaches and develops product managers who are empowered to own outcomes, not manage backlogs.
  • India product presence. Builds Product Management in Noida, starting with the Platform product leader, so India-owned domains have product partners close to the engineers.
  • Product operations. Leads product operations: product analytics and instrumentation, research operations, the investment intake process, and the product operating cadence.
  • Trio partnership. Works as one team with design and engineering leaders at every level. Product, design and engineering share goals, plan together and review together.

Customer and market

  • Market leadership. Keeps apexanalytix ahead in supplier risk management and procure-to-pay controls, including AI-native and agentic capabilities.
  • Go-to-market alignment. Partners with Go-to-Market leadership on packaging, pricing input and launches, so customers see one connected platform aligned to the journey structure.
  • Compliance as a product requirement. Works with the Head of GRC so that regulatory, security and third-party risk requirements shape product decisions early, both for our own controls and for the compliance outcomes our clients buy from us.

First-Year Priorities

  • Publish a product vision and product strategy, approved by the CPTO, that sets the problems each of the four trios is asked to solve.
  • Agree first-year outcome goals for each trio with the CPTO, engineering leaders and finance, including a revenue goal for standalone data products.
  • Launch a single investment intake and review process for all engineering demand, with every request tied to an outcome and every decision visible to stakeholders.
  • Get every product trio running weekly customer touchpoints, with opportunity solution trees and assumption tests visible in quarterly reviews.
  • Set a baseline for discovery and delivery health (for example, share of shipped work validated in discovery, time from idea to validated learning, and adoption of what ships), and show measurable improvement against it.
  • Name or hire the product leaders for all four trios, including the Platform product leader in Noida, and close gaps in the product manager bench.
  • Stand up product operations with reliable product analytics across the platform.
  • Work with the Head of Design and engineering leaders so that every team operates as a trio with shared goals, joint planning and joint reviews.

Required Skills

  • 15+ years in product management, including 5+ years leading product organizations through product leaders and managers in B2B enterprise SaaS.
  • Deep, practical fluency in the product operating model as described by Marty Cagan (Inspired, Empowered, Transformed): empowered product teams, outcomes over output, product strategy, and the distinction between discovery and delivery.
  • A proven record of leading a transformation from a project- or feature-driven model to empowered, outcome-funded product teams, including winning over executives and stakeholders outside product.
  • Hands-on experience leading product discovery at scale, including addressing value, usability, feasibility and viability risk before committing engineering investment.
  • Experience owning portfolio-level investment decisions across multiple teams: setting capacity allocation, saying no with evidence, and making trade-offs transparent to executives and Go-to-Market leaders.
  • A track record of hiring, coaching and developing strong product managers and product leaders.
  • Strong analytical skills, with experience using product analytics, experimentation and qualitative research to make decisions.
  • Experience working in close partnership with design and engineering as a trio, and with distributed teams across US and India time zones.
  • Experience with AI-native or data products, and sound judgment about where AI and agents create real customer value.
  • Strong executive presence, able to represent product strategy credibly to the CPTO, the executive team, clients and, as needed, the Board.

Preferred Skills

  • Practical experience running Teresa Torres's continuous discovery habits (Continuous Discovery Habits): weekly customer interviews by the product trio, opportunity solution trees, and rapid assumption testing, ideally introduced across several teams.
  • Background in governance, risk and compliance (GRC) software or practice, especially third-party risk management (TPRM), supplier risk or vendor due diligence.
  • Domain experience in procure-to-pay, accounts payable, supplier management, payment fraud prevention or fintech.
  • Experience building product management in an India-based Global Capability Center.
  • Experience in a PE-backed or high-growth SaaS company, connecting product investment to revenue, retention and EBITDA.
  • Experience building and selling data products or APIs as standalone revenue lines.

Education Levels/Credentials (Degree types and Emphasis)

  • An undergraduate degree in business, computer science, engineering or a related field is required. A graduate degree or an MBA is a plus but not required.

Physical/Remote/Travel Work Environment

  • United States, with remote or hybrid arrangements considered. Regular overlap with India business hours for work with the Noida team.
  • Travel required: regular, including client visits for discovery, and periodic travel to apexanalytix HQ in Greensboro, NC, and the Noida GCC.

Scope Boundaries

This role owns product discovery, product vision and strategy, the product organization across all four trios, product operations, and the process by which investment requests reach engineering. Engineering delivery, quality and technical standards sit with the VP Engineering, the SVP Engineering & Head of India GCC and the Chief Architect. Design leadership, the design system and research practice sit with the Head of Design; the VP of Product partners closely on discovery. The Data & Intelligence trio is led by the Head of AI & Data, with its product leader reporting to this role. Security policy, compliance and third-party risk for apexanalytix itself sit with the Head of GRC. Client commercial relationships, pricing and packaging decisions sit with Go-to-Market leadership, with input from this role.

Over the years, we’ve discovered that the most effective and successful associates at apexanalytix are people who have a specific combination of values, skills, and behaviors that we call “The apex Way”. Read more about The apex Way - apexanalytix.com/careers/

Benefits

At apexanalytix we know that our associates are the reason behind our successes. We truly value you as an associate and part of our professional family. Our goal is to offer the very best benefits possible to you and your loved ones. When it comes to benefits, whether for yourself or your family the most important aspect is choice. And we get that. apexanalytix offers competitive benefits for the countries that we serve, in addition to our BeWell@apex initiative that encourages employees’ growth in six key wellness areas: Emotional, Physical, Community, Financial, Social, and Intelligence.

With resources such as a strong Mentor Program, Internal Training Portal, plus Education, Tuition, and Certification Assistance, we provide tools for our associates to grow and develop.
