Working to be healthcare’s most trusted partner, our customer-centric focus drives continuous improvement and leads to innovative solutions that improve the lives of people every day. With approximately 50,000 employees worldwide, Cardinal Health ranks among the top fifteen in the Fortune 500.


Department Overview:

Information Security and Risk develops, implements, and enforces security controls to protect the organization's technology assets from intentional or inadvertent modification, disclosure, or destruction. The function of this job family is to ensure secure, authorized, and compliant access to the organization's data, systems, and physical resources. It focuses on defining, creating, managing, and governing digital identities and their associated access privileges to protect the enterprise from security breaches, insider threats, and regulatory non-compliance

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Identity and Access Management (IAM) Senior Engineer to join our Workforce Identity team. In this role, you will architect, scale, and modernize the systems that secure over 50,000 global employees, contractors, and critical distribution operations. You will drive identity strategy across a hyper-scale, hybrid multi-cloud environment, spearhead rapid M&A integrations, champion Zero Standing Privilege (ZSP), and architect next-generation non-human and frontline identity solutions.

Responsibilities:

M&A Architecture & Federation Strategy

  • Architect repeatable, high-velocity identity blueprints for Mergers, Acquisitions, and Divestitures, reducing subsidiary integration timeframes from months to weeks.
  • Lead cross-domain identity consolidation across disparate identity providers (Okta, Entra ID, Ping) and divergent enterprise directories.
  • Design robust cross-cloud federation, B2B collaboration frameworks, and tenant boundary governance.
  • Lead IAM technical workstreams for Mergers, Acquisitions, and Divestitures. Consolidate disparate identity providers (IdPs) into a unified enterprise SSO platform. Design and execute cross-domain authentication and federation strategies.
  • Lead IAM discovery, identity migration, and system consolidation for newly acquired business entities.
  • Direct experience migrating users, mapping attributes, and consolidating divergent directories.

Architecture influence and decision-making

  • Define enterprise IAM architecture standards: Formulate technical standards, architectural patterns, and reference blueprints for enterprise SSO, Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), and directory services.
  • Technical authority and vendor SoW evaluation: Act as a critical architectural authority to evaluate third-party integration patterns, challenge vendor Statements of Work (SoWs) for high-complexity migrations (e.g., ADFS to Okta) and establish technical decommissioning strategies for legacy identity platforms.

Hybrid and multi-cloud IAM

  • Architect hybrid and multi-cloud IAM bridges: Design, govern, and scale secure identity bridges linking legacy on-premises infrastructure (Active Directory, ADFS) with hyper-scale multi-cloud environments (GCP, AWS, Azure/Entra ID) and SaaS ecosystems (Okta, SailPoint).
  • Privileged Access and JIT governance: Define and architect robust Zero Standing Privilege (ZSP) and Just-In-Time (JIT) access control patterns using Privileged Access Management (PAM - CyberArk, HashiCorp Vault) and Cloud Infrastructure Entitlement Management (CIEM) to reduce the on-premises and cloud attack surface.

Emerging tech trends and business growth

  • Modern Identity roadmaps (NHIM and ISPM): Research, evaluate, and integrate emerging industry trends—such as Non-Human Identity Management (NHIM), Identity Security Posture Management (ISPM), and agentic/AI security controls—into the long-term IAM roadmap.
  • Agile Identity for business scale: Ensure identity systems are agile and scalable enough to support Cardinal Health's rapid business expansion, M&A pipeline, and digital healthcare operations without introducing friction

IGA Integrations

  • Design repeatable, high-velocity identity blueprints for Mergers, Acquisitions, and Divestitures, reducing subsidiary integration timeframes from months to weeks.
  • Lead cross-domain identity consolidation across disparate identity providers (Okta, Entra ID, Ping) and divergent enterprise directories.
  • Design robust cross-cloud federation, B2B collaboration frameworks, and tenant boundary governance
  • Authoritative Source Integration: Design and implement seamless integrations with HRMS platforms (e.g., Workday, SuccessFactors, PeopleSoft) to drive the identity lifecycle.
  • Formulate policy-driven access models (RBAC/PBAC) and automated Segregation of Duties (SoD) frameworks meeting strict SOX ITGC, HIPAA, and GDPR requirements.
  • Architect specialized authentication solutions (contactless RFID badge tap-and-go, biometric FIDO2 smart cards, shared kiosk sessions) supporting nuclear pharmacies, manufacturing plants, and distribution centers.
  • Design "Single Pane of Glass" self-service capabilities for people leaders to proactively monitor and right-size direct report access.
  • Partner with IAM Engineering to establish self-healing provisioning patterns achieving 99.999% core availability
  • Application Onboarding: Design, develop, and configure SailPoint connectors for Active Directory (AD), JDBC, and Web Services (REST/SOAP).
  • Automated Provisioning: Configure and maintain Birthright provisioning to ensure immediate, policy-driven access for joiners on day one.
  • Process Automation: Automate lifecycle events (Joiner, Mover, Leaver) and request-based provisioning workflows.
  • Expand Cloud Infrastructure Entitlement Management (CIEM) to continuously discover and eliminate over-privileged assignments

Automation and Workflows

  • Develop automated workflows to streamline user onboarding, transitions, and offboarding.
  • Build API-driven automations to reduce manual provisioning overhead.
  • Implement infrastructure-as-code (IaC) principles for IAM configurations.

Security Policy and Compliance

  • Ensure IAM systems and processes comply with regulatory requirements (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, SOX) and internal security policies, providing auditable records of access activities. Protect against data breaches by ensuring only authorized personnel can access sensitive information.
  • Solution Design & Implementation: Design, implement, and maintain IAM solutions including Single Sign-On (SSO), Identity life cycle management, IGA and PAM.
  • Collaboration & Communication: Coordinate cross-functional teams, including Information Security, IT Operations, HR, and Application Development, to ensure effective IAM implementation and seamless integration with business processes. Communicate complex security concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Documentation & Best Practices: Develop, review, and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, configuration guides, and operational procedures. Stay up-to-date with IAM best practices, regulatory requirements, and security trends.

Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience: 10+ years in Information Security and Identity Management, with at least 5+ years operating as a Lead or Principal Enterprise IAM Architect within a Fortune 500 or hyper-scale enterprise preferred.
  • Technical Expertise:
    • Deep theoretical and practical command of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), SAML 2.0, SCIM 2.0, FIDO2/WebAuthn, and Kerberos.
    • Proven architectural authority across enterprise IdPs (Microsoft Entra ID, Okta), IGA platforms (SailPoint IdentityIQ / Identity Security Cloud), and PAM solutions (CyberArk, HashiCorp Vault).
    • Demonstrated success leading identity discovery, tenant consolidation, and domain migration workstreams across complex, multi-entity corporate structures.
    • Comprehensive familiarity with SOX 404 ITGC controls, HIPAA Security Rule, and international data sovereignty frameworks.
    • Exceptional executive communication, stakeholder diplomacy, and ability to translate cryptographic/identity concepts into clear business risk decisions .
    • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines in a fast-paced M&A environment.
    • Adaptability to stay ahead of evolving IAM technologies and security threats.

What is expected of you and others at this level

  • Applies advanced knowledge and understanding of concepts, principles, and technical capabilities to manage a wide variety of projects
  • Participates in the development of policies and procedures to achieve specific goals
  • Recommends new practices, processes, metrics, or models
  • Works on or may lead complex projects of large scope
  • Projects may have significant and long-term impact
  • Provides solutions which may set precedent
  • Independently determines method for completion of new projects
  • Receives guidance on overall project objectives
  • Acts as a mentor to less experienced colleagues

Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.

We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

Job Title

Manager Client Support I

About this role:

The Client Support Manager leads Community Financial Institutions (CFI) merchant services support operations for merchants, financial institution partners, and internal teams. You will manage service delivery, associate performance, escalation handling, operational controls, and process improvements. Your work helps improve inquiry resolution, support consistency, regulatory adherence, and partner communication across CFI merchant services.


What you'll do:

  • Lead daily CFI merchant services support operations, including assigned associates, team leads, or supervisors within the reporting structure.
  • Align staffing, schedules, backup coverage, and workload distribution with call volumes, inquiry demand, partner needs, and service commitments.
  • Interview, onboard, coach, cross-train, and develop associates to improve product knowledge, issue resolution, documentation, and service delivery.
  • Conduct team and individual check-ins, complete performance reviews, address training needs, and coordinate people-management matters with HR.
  • Own CFI support workflows from intake and triage through assignment, resolution, follow-up, and closure.
  • Oversee escalations, assign primary and backup ownership, coordinate timely resolution, and provide accurate status updates to stakeholders.
  • Monitor service levels, inquiry aging, backlog, quality, productivity, repeat contacts, and resolution trends to identify risks and corrective actions.
  • Responsibilities listed are not intended to be all-inclusive and may be modified as necessary.

Experience you'll need to have:

  • 6+ years of experience in operations, client support, merchant services, financial services, or financial institution support environments.
  • 2+ years of experience managing and developing teams in a customer support, operations, or service delivery environment.
  • 3+ years of experience managing service levels, inquiry queues, escalation processes, staffing plans, or operational reporting.
  • 3+ years of experience developing procedures, maintaining knowledge resources, or implementing process improvements with leadership or compliance approval.
  • 2+ years of experience using Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft PowerPoint, Microsoft Access, internet-based tools, and email for reporting, documentation, and communication.
  • 2+ years of experience preparing written updates, presenting operational results, analyzing service trends, and documenting issue resolution actions.
  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Business Administration, Finance, Operations Management, or a related field or equivalent combination of education, related experience and/or military experience.

Experience that would be great to have:

  • Experience supporting Community Financial Institutions merchant services, financial institution partners, or a comparable merchant support operational function.
  • Experience leading cross-functional projects, root-cause analysis, or process-improvement initiatives across operations, training, compliance, and relationship management teams.
  • Experience participating in financial institution partner visits, account reviews, service reviews, or merchant issue resolution discussions.
  • Experience developing merchant services procedures, partner education content, or associate development programs.

How you'll work:

  • This role requires use of a computer and audio equipment.

Individuals with temporary visas including, but not limited to, F-1 (OPT, CPT, STEM), H-1B, H-2, or TN, or any candidate requiring sponsorship, now or in the future, will not be considered for this role.

raw.description:
About Nerdio

At Nerdio, our mission is to simplify the lives of IT professionals and maximize their Microsoft cloud and end user computing investments.

We support organizations of all sizes looking to deploy, manage, and cost-optimize native Microsoft technologies. We partner with Enterprises and Managed Service Providers all over the world to add value on top of their existing native Microsoft investments like Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), Windows 365, and Microsoft Intune.

Created in 2016, Nerdio has always taken a market-leading and collaborative approach to cloud deployment and management. In fact, our product roadmap is greatly influenced by the regular feedback we receive from having seen companies deploy AVD into production environments several thousand times using Nerdio technology.

Today, Nerdio is used in over 50 countries by more than 15,000 organizations of every size and vertical. We’re committed to delivering exceptional service and support, which starts with identifying and supporting the best staff possible.

We are a fast-moving, nimble company looking for individuals who are collaborative, empathetic, driven and who love to move at the speed of light. If you want to be part of the AVD transformation that Microsoft and Nerdio are leading, then we want to speak with you.

About the role

You will be responsible for leading a team of motivated and skilled Support Engineers for our AMER-based Support Team. This role balances hands-on technical support with team leadership, operational oversight, and quality control. You will be leading a team of highly functioning individuals comprised of Level 1 and 2 engineers. This is a working team lead role. You will oversee tickets, coach engineers, and drive operational discipline across the team to achieve a world class support experience for Nerdio customers.

What you'll do

  • Provide daily guidance and direction to Nerdio Support Engineers
  • Review cases for troubleshooting depth, documentation quality, and communication clarity
  • Set expectations for case ownership, follow-through, and customer updates
  • Act as the first point of escalation for engineers on complex, high-priority, or sensitive cases
  • Support onboarding and ramping of new engineers
  • Deliver direct coaching and performance feedback aligned with Technical Support expectations
  • Reinforce consistent ways of working across regions

Operational Ownership

  • Own day-to-day performance and operation of the Nerdio Support queue
  • Identify trends and recurring issues and partner with leadership on process improvements
  • Ensure escalated cases meet set standards and include proper documentation and diagnostics
  • Monitor metrics such as; ticket flow, backlog, and team performance
  • Ensure SLA adherence and proactive communication in priority cases
  • Partner with the Escalation team to ensure clean, well-documented handoffs
  • Step in on high-impact cases when needed to stabilize customer situations
  • Assist navigating customers to the correct Nerdio resource, should Support not be the correct department for their queries.

Nerdio Customer Support

  • Provide advanced troubleshooting support for complex Nerdio product issues across Nerdio Manager for Enterprise (NME) and Nerdio Manager for MSP (NMM).
  • Engage directly with customers via webform emails or live troubleshooting sessions

Technical Expertise

Demonstrate strong working knowledge of:

  • Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD)
  • Windows 365 Cloud PC
  • Microsoft Intune
  • Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD)
  • Active Directory (AD DS / Entra DS)
  • FSLogix
  • Azure networking fundamentals
  • Promote structured troubleshooting methods and consistent ways of working

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Escalation teams to ensure clean handoffs and efficient resolution
  • Collaborate with the Engineering and Product teams on reproducible issues and feedback
  • Support Sales Engineering and Customer Success during customer engagements
  • Drive alignment across regions to maintain global standards

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of technical support, cloud infrastructure, or enterprise systems experience
  • Strong experience with Azure Virtual Desktop and Intune environments
  • Comfortable leading peers; setting technical and operational standards
  • Clear communication with both customers and internal stakeholders
  • Strong diagnostic and troubleshooting mindset

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience leading or mentoring others is advantageous
  • Microsoft AZ-104 (Azure Administrator) and/or AZ-140 (Azure Virtual Desktop Specialty) certifications are advantageous
  • Prior hands-on experience with Nerdio Manager for either Enterprise or MSP, is advantageous
  • Previous experience in providing support for cloud-based services or SaaS products
  • Experience with ITSM systems, such as Zendesk
  • ITIL v4 framework

  • Stock Options
  • Health and Welfare Plans*

  • Collaborative Team Culture

* Benefits for international employees, outside the US, vary by country.

Position Summary:

The Operations Director is responsible for leading complex, multi-account automotive dealership operations, ensuring consistent service delivery, operational excellence, and achievement of business objectives across multi-rooftop dealer groups. This role requires extensive experience in automotive retail and dealership operations, with a strong understanding of dealership workflows, Sales and Service Business Development Center (BDC) functions, and US and global automotive retail environments. The ideal candidate combines operational discipline, strategic account management, commercial acumen, and strong people leadership to optimize performance, strengthen client partnerships, and develop high-performing teams.

As a key leader at Pinnacle Intelligence, the Operations Director will help advance our position as an AI-powered automotive intelligence partner, leveraging technology, automation, analytics, and AI-enabled solutions to improve dealership performance, enhance customer engagement, and deliver scalable operational value.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Multi-Account Dealership Operations Management: Lead complex, multi-account dealership portfolios, including multi-rooftop dealer groups, ensuring consistent operational performance, service quality, productivity, and achievement of client and business targets across accounts.
  • Automotive Retail & Dealership Operations: Apply deep knowledge of automotive dealership operations, including sales and service workflows, customer lifecycle management, customer engagement, lead conversion, appointment setting, and retention programs. Translate dealership business requirements into effective, scalable service delivery strategies.
  • Sales & Service BDC Operations: Oversee Sales and Service Business Development Center (BDC) operations across multiple dealership accounts. Drive Sales BDC performance through inbound lead management, timely follow-ups, CRM cadence adherence, lead nurturing, and appointment conversion. Optimize Service BDC performance through service appointment scheduling, maintenance outreach, recall campaigns, customer retention, and service lane utilization.
  • Operational Excellence & Governance: Establish and maintain standardized operating procedures, performance standards, governance frameworks, and accountability measures across accounts while allowing for individual dealership requirements and business priorities.
  • Performance & Financial Management: Monitor operational KPIs, service-level agreements, productivity, quality, and budget performance. Identify opportunities to improve cost efficiency, workforce utilization, and overall account profitability while maintaining service delivery standards.
  • Client Relationship & Account Management: Build strong relationships with dealership clients and key stakeholders, aligning operational priorities with business objectives. Lead performance discussions, communicate insights and improvement plans, address operational challenges, and identify opportunities to strengthen client partnerships and expand services.
  • Technology, Automation & AI Transformation: Champion technology-enabled transformation across dealership delivery operations. Drive the adoption of automation, AI-powered tools, analytics, and digital solutions to improve lead management, customer engagement, appointment conversion, service retention, productivity, and operational scalability.
  • Leadership & Management Development: Coach, mentor, and develop operations managers and account leaders across the portfolio. Establish clear performance expectations, strengthen accountability, build leadership capability, and maintain a strong management bench capable of delivering consistent results across multiple accounts.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify operational gaps, analyze performance trends, and implement data-driven improvements that enhance efficiency, quality, customer experience, and scalability. Promote continuous improvement and the adoption of best practices across accounts.
  • Risk & Compliance Management: Ensure adherence to operational policies, client requirements, quality standards, data-handling practices, and applicable regulatory requirements across assigned accounts.
  • Business Growth & Scalability: Partner with executive leadership and cross-functional teams to support account expansion, new client implementations, operational transitions, and the deployment of scalable solutions that reinforce Pinnacle's position as an automotive intelligence partner.

Skills & Qualifications:

Required:

  • Proven track record managing complex, multi-account operations, with responsibility for operational performance, client delivery, and business results across multiple accounts or business units.
  • Deep experience in automotive retail and dealership operations, including dealership workflows, customer lifecycle management, and sales and service support.
  • Strong operational expertise in US and global automotive retail environments, with the ability to translate dealership requirements into effective service delivery processes.
  • Demonstrated experience managing Sales and Service BDC operations, including inbound lead management, CRM follow-up cadence, appointment setting, service scheduling, recall campaigns, and customer retention.
  • Proven ability to manage operational KPIs, service-level agreements, productivity, quality, and cost efficiency across complex account portfolios.
  • Strong leadership experience coaching and developing operations managers, establishing accountability, and building high-performing teams across multiple accounts.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive process improvements, operational standardization, and performance optimization across multi-site or multi-rooftop dealership portfolios.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, client management, and stakeholder communication skills.

Preferred:

  • Experience supporting US automotive dealerships through outsourced operations, particularly multi-rooftop dealer groups and multi-account portfolios.
  • Familiarity with automotive Dealer Management Systems (DMS) and CRM platforms, such as VinSolutions, Elead, CDK, and Reynolds & Reynolds.
  • Experience implementing AI-enabled solutions, workflow automation, analytics, or technology-driven transformation in dealership support operations.
  • Experience managing geographically distributed teams or multiple dealership accounts with varying operational requirements.
  • Familiarity with Lean Six Sigma, continuous improvement methodologies, and operational transformation.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, or a related field.

raw.excerpt: Serverfarm is a leading developer and operator of data centers with over 750+ locations and key customer relationships in 45 countries.
raw.description:
Serverfarm is a leading developer and operator of data centers with over 750+ locations and key customer relationships in 45 countries. We're revolutionizing how data centers operate across North America, Western Europe, and Israel, serving the world's leading technology and hyperscale companies. With Manulife Investment Management's acquisition in 2023 and our award-winning InCommand platform we're positioned for explosive growth as AI adoption and cloud migration drive unprecedented demand for data center capacity.
A career at Serverfarm means being at the forefront of digital infrastructure innovation, where your work directly impacts how the world's data is managed and secured. As we target 4x growth over the next four years, you'll have unprecedented opportunities to take on new challenges, develop cutting-edge skills, and grow your career across our expanding global operations.
Join our team of innovators and help shape the future of sustainable data centers while building a career without boundaries.

The next InCommand is a new solution, built on a new technology stack, designed from the ground up for the way modern data centers, including high-density and AI infrastructure, are operated. It will be delivered as a cloud service and be deployable in customers' own environments, built API-first, and developed with an agent-assisted engineering practice in which coding agents work from specifications under human review. Our own facilities are the first customer, so everything we build is proven in real, live operations before anyone else sees it.

At the heart of that product is its platform: one model of how a data center works, and the architecture that serves it fast to a live operations center and to AI working over years of history. We are looking for a hands-on Platform Architect who designs that foundation and writes the first code with AI-assisted tooling: the kind of architect whose decisions are in the repository, not only in the decision record. It is a rare chance to define a platform from a clean sheet, for an industry evolving faster than ever under exponentially growing demand for compute and AI, while standing on a decade of operational knowledge about what it has to do. You partner closely with Product Management, Integrations and Developer Platform.

Key Accountabilities

    • Build the foundation of the new platform yourself: the control plane and tenancy that everything else sits on, written with coding agents and the engineers who join you, and own the first code merged on the new platform.

    • Design and own the unified data model and its evolution, publish it with the public API as a specification others build against, and define the platform architecture around it (data stores, identity and multi-tenancy, API layer).

    • Own retrieval and query performance at telemetry scale: storage choices, query patterns for live consoles and for analytical and AI workloads, latency targets, tenant isolation at the data layer.

    • Choose the technology stack and platform standards, and recommend the cloud the platform starts on and how it stays portable.

    • Design how the platform integrates large language models and other AI services to deliver operational intelligence: insights, recommendations and natural-language access to operational data.

    • Define, in partnership with Integrations, the contract by which site data enters the platform.

    • Give technical direction to the engineers who join the new platform in its first months, and set the patterns the team builds on.

Required Skills

    • 10+ years building back-end and platform systems, and in the last three years you have personally shipped a multi-tenant SaaS platform or control plane on Kubernetes, writing production code, as the technical decision-maker.

    • You have designed the domain data model for a complex operational system (assets, hierarchies, time series, events) and owned its evolution across releases, with the compatibility, versioning and migration decisions that came with it.

    • You have delivered retrieval performance at telemetry scale: chosen time-series and relational storage (PostgreSQL with TimescaleDB or equivalent, with a columnar engine such as ClickHouse for analytical and AI workloads), designed queries for live and analytical workloads over long histories, and met API latency targets.

    • You have built hands-on on a major public cloud (GCP, AWS or Azure) with Kubernetes and Helm, with judgment about when a managed service is the right call and when portability matters more.

    • You have built identity, tenancy and security by design into enterprise SaaS.

    • You have designed and published an API or data-model specification that other teams, and ideally external organisations, built against, and written architecture decisions that engineers worked from.

    • You have been a senior individual contributor on a platform's foundational production code.

Preferred Skills

    • Used agentic coding tools and directed and reviewed agent-written code at volume.

    • Knowledge of or experience with DCIM products: the data they manage and how data-center operators use them.

    • Designed platform ingress with Kafka-compatible streaming (Kafka, Redpanda or equivalent) and MQTT brokers (EMQX, HiveMQ or equivalent).

    • Instrumented a platform with OpenTelemetry for its own observability.

    • Integrated large language models into a platform: a model gateway, retrieval over operational data, tool interfaces an assistant can call.

    • Run a platform across public clouds, or shipped software both as a cloud service and in customer-hosted or air-gapped environments.

Amerit Fleet Solutions, one of the leading fleet maintenance companies in the U.S., is seeking an experienced, inspired and mission-driven Senior Operations Manager to join our growing team!

The Senior Operations Manager is responsible for overseeing service operations. This is a remote position that may require up to 40-50% travel. This role involves a multi-faceted approach to maintenance, customer service and account management.

The SOM will have a strong background in operations as well as maintenance/fleet management. The scope of responsibilities will be the management and oversight for fleet managers and local administrators, across multiple regional sites, that will encompass teams of mechanics.

The SOM will oversee the day-to-day operations for the entire region and serve as the account manager. As the account manager the SOM will ensure and coordinate items like billing inquiries, monthly close out, reporting monthly metrics such as PM/DOT and other KPI data, to include SLA’s, EHS and safety for the region. The SOM will be a direct conduit for all customer inquiries and feedback, to include monthly surveys, as well as host weekly and monthly meetings.

We are looking for an experienced self-starter with excellent leadership and communication skills. Why Work Here?

“Mission driven, great benefits and room for growth!”

Why consider AORN, Association of periOperative Registered Nurses, as the next place for your career as our Salesforce Application Developer? Because we’re innovative and all about quality and collaboration – we’re continually seeking to enhance our offerings to allow us to better tailor to the needs of our nurse members while expanding our market position and growing revenue across our business and sales divisions.

Our mission is to define, support, and advocate for patient and staff safety through exemplary practice for each phase of perioperative nursing care using evidence-based guidelines, continuing education, and clinical practice resources. We collaborate with professional and regulatory organizations, industry leaders, and other health care partners who support our mission. Our culture is one of openness, teamwork, risk taking and being at the cutting edge of our field and we only look for employees who hold these same traits.

Values mean more to AORN than just bullets on a page. They drive our daily decisions and impact how we work as an organization:

  • Innovation:Taking courageous and bold actions for growth and sustainability.
  • Communication:Exemplifying respect, collaboration, transparency and honesty.
  • Quality:Ensuring accountability and excellence.
  • Diversity, Equity, Inclusiveness:Promoting fairness, valuing differences, considering all perspectives.
  • Achievement:Achieving our mission, realizing the vision.

Our Salesforce Application Developer role is to define, develop, test, analyze, and maintain enhancements or modifications to AORN’s Salesforce ecosystem in support of the achievement of business requirements. This includes writing, coding, testing, and analyzing software programs and applications in an Agile (SCRUM) environment. The Salesforce Application Developer will also research, design, document, and modify software specifications throughout the production life cycle.

The Salesforce Application Developer builds and enhances the Salesforce platform in support of a scalable business model and to improve efficiencies and effectiveness of the organization. This role requires someone who can quickly understand existing implementations, collaborate with business stakeholders, and deliver scalable, maintainable solutions while continuously identifying opportunities for improvement.

AORN is based in Denver, CO. Our Salesforce Application Developerwill work remotely.

More about what you’ll get to do as our Salesforce Application Developer :

  • Collaborate with business analysts and stakeholders to understand requirements, ask insightful questions, and translate business needs into effective technical solutions.
  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flows, SOQL, and other platform capabilities.
  • Maintains internal Salesforce instances, and long-term improvement operations to ensure compatibility with evolving requirements.
  • Leverage strong Salesforce administration skills, including data modeling, security, permissions, configuration, and automation.
  • Quickly understand existing implementations, troubleshoot issues, and enhance solutions for performance, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Take ownership of the complete development lifecycle, ensuring high-quality code, thorough testing, documentation, and successful deployments.
  • Apply Salesforce best practices, including governor limit management, bulkification, integration design, and efficient automation.
  • Proactively identify technical debt, recommend improvements, and contribute to architectural and design decisions.
  • Stay current with Salesforce releases, emerging technologies, and development best practices.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Must Have’s to be our Salesforce Application Developer :

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5–8 years of hands-on Salesforce development and administration experience.
  • Salesforce Platform Developer I certification (required).
  • Strong proficiency in Apex, LWC, SOQL, Salesforce Flows, and Salesforce APIs.
  • Solid understanding of Salesforce architecture, security, data models, integrations, and platform limitations.
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot complex issues and work effectively with existing custom implementations.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Salesforce Platform Developer II or additional Salesforce certifications.
  • Experience with Experience Cloud, Data Cloud, and managed packages.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD, DevOps, Agile methodologies, SQL, or .NET technologies.
  • Experience with REST/SOAP integrations, Git, deployment processes, and unit testing.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

  • Excellent understanding of coding methods, version control and change management best practices.
  • Hands-on experience developing test cases and test plans.
  • Able to communicate effectively with non-technical staff and with members of interdisciplinary teams.
  • Flexible and adaptable; willing to learn and understand new technologies.
  • Ability to conduct research into software-related issues and products.
  • Highly self-motivated and directed.
  • Proven analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks to meet project deadlines.
  • Strong written, oral, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Experience working both independently and in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.
  • Ability to demonstrate and hold others accountable for organizational values of Innovation, Communication, Quality, Diversity, Equity and Inclusion, and Achievement.

Here are some of the excellent benefits we offer and why it’s so great to work here!

  • Health insurance package options that include a HDHP plan and a PPO plan.
  • Dental and vision coverage.
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Healthcare Savings Account (HSA) options.
  • Employer paid short- and long-term disability, accidental death and dismemberment, and life insurance coverage.
  • Voluntary Life Insurance options including critical illness and accident insurance.
  • 401(k) plan with immediate vesting.
  • Pet insurance.
  • Udemy Learning.
  • Paid time off and 10 paid holidays per year.
  • Paid sick time.
  • Paid parental leave.
  • Free subscription to Calm.
  • Up to 8 hours of paid volunteer time.
  • Employee Assistance Programs.
  • Staff Incentive Bonus.

Working Conditions
Non-smoking office environment, using a computer and other office equipment daily. Attendance at scheduled meetings as required. Ability to travel as needed to support departmental and association functions.

FLSA Status:Exempt

Application Deadline:Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis and reviewed until the position is filled or a sufficient number of qualified applications has been received.

raw.description:
About High Scale

We’re High Scale — a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing video advertising on TV and social media. Think Amazon’s obsession with customer experience meets SpaceX’s fearless ambition—that’s the DNA behind everything we do.

Our 120-person team of creatives, strategists, and innovators produces thousands of high-impact campaigns weekly for the world’s leading lifestyle, fashion, beauty, and DTC brands. With 50,000 sq. ft. of DTLA studios and a global influencer network, we’re ready to 10x our output in 2026—and we need an AI Content Creator who lives on the bleeding edge of generative technology to build visuals that were previously impossible, expensive, or slow to produce.

Why This Role Matters

The barrier between imagination and reality has dissolved. As our AI Content Creator, you are the pioneer of our "Synthetic Production" arm. You aren't just writing prompts; you are integrating generative video, image, and audio tools into professional commercial workflows.

You will help us scale content production by generating hyper-realistic B-roll, impossible environments, and rapid-fire concepts that speed up our entire creative engine. If you spend your nights on Discord testing new models and your days dreaming of ComfyUI workflows, this is your launchpad.

What You’ll Do

  1. Generate High-Fidelity Assets

    • Create stunning, photo-real images and video clips using Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, Runway (Gen-2/Gen-3), Pika, and Sora (as available).

    • Generate specific creative assets: product backgrounds, atmospheric B-roll, and surreal visual effects that blend seamlessly with live-action footage.

    • Utilize AI audio tools (ElevenLabs, Suno) to generate realistic voice-overs and custom background tracks for testing and final delivery.

  2. Hybrid Editing & Compositing

    • Take AI-generated assets and integrate them into video timelines.

    • Use After Effects and Photoshop to "fix" AI artifacts (glitchy hands, text errors) and composite products into AI-generated environments.

    • Upscale and interpolate footage (Topaz Video AI) to ensure all AI output meets broadcast 4K standards.

  3. Rapid Concepting & Storyboarding

    • Replace traditional stick-figure storyboards with fully rendered AI animatics, allowing clients to visualize the final commercial before we even turn on a camera.

    • Speed up the pre-production process by visualizing lighting setups and set designs virtually.

  4. Stay on the Bleeding Edge

    • Constantly test new models, LoRAs, and control nets. You are the agency's R&D department for creativity.

    • Build efficient workflows (e.g., ComfyUI pipelines) that allow other editors to utilize AI tools easily.

Who You Are

  1. A "Prompt Engineer" & Artist

    • You have a deep understanding of prompt syntax, negative prompting, seeds, and weights. You know how to get exactly what you want from the AI.

    • You have a strong foundation in traditional art/photography principles (composition, lighting, color theory)—AI is just your brush.

  2. Technically Versatile

    • Proficiency in Midjourney, Runway, and ElevenLabs is required.

    • Strong working knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects. You need to be able to use what you generate.

    • Experience with Stable Diffusion (Automatic1111 or ComfyUI) is a massive plus.

  3. Problem Solver

    • AI is unpredictable. You have the patience to iterate 50 times to get the perfect 3-second clip.

    • You know how to troubleshoot consistency issues (keeping a character's face the same across multiple shots).

  4. Ethically Aware

    • You understand the legal landscape of AI. You know how to create commercially safe content (avoiding copyright infringement or deepfaking real celebrities without permission).

Perks & Benefits

  • Tool Access: We provide enterprise access to the top AI tools and unlimited compute credits.

  • Growth Opportunities: Define the AI strategy for a major agency and lead the shift toward hybrid production.

  • Relentless Innovation Culture: Move fast, test constantly, and collaborate with some of the most creative minds in social media and video production.

High Scale is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and believe it’s key to building teams that change the world—one generation at a time.

Telehealth Therapist | Remote | Licensed in California | Part-Time

Banyan Treatment Centers is seeking a part-time Telehealth Therapist to join a clinical team built for growth, delivering IOP-level care to individuals overcoming substance use and mental health disorders.

This role calls for a clinician who brings strong therapeutic skill and genuine care to every session, while thriving in a fast-paced, collaborative telehealth environment. You'll report to the Telehealth Clinical Director, with additional support from the Head of Telehealth — giving you clinical guidance and operational backing at every level.

Position Details

  • Schedule: 12 hours per week, minimum. Banyan runs both AM and PM program tracks, and scheduling varies depending on current business and caseload needs — candidates should expect this to be discussed and confirmed during the interview process. Current need typically leans toward PM coverage, though this is subject to change.
  • Compensation: $40 - $60 Hourly (Dependent on licensure, education and previous clinical experience).

About the Company

Banyan Treatment Centers is a leading national provider of intensive treatment for individuals facing substance use and mental health disorders. Backed by TPG's The Rise Funds, one of the nation's largest private equity investors, Banyan is rapidly expanding access to high-quality, compassionate care.

Why Join Banyan Treatment Centers?

As a Telehealth Therapist, you will:

  • Join a mission-driven, nationally recognized organization backed by the resources and infrastructure to deliver best-in-class care at scale.
  • Work within a leadership structure built for support — a Clinical Director and Head of Telehealth both invested in your success and the program's growth.
  • Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team to provide integrated, patient-centered care.
  • Make a direct, lasting impact on patients during one of the most critical phases of their recovery.
  • Grow professionally within an organization that invests in continuous learning, mentorship, and career development.
  • Be supported in expanding your practice across state lines — we cover the cost of obtaining additional state licensure where there's a business need.

Benefits

Eligible full-time team members receive comprehensive benefits including:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Life insurance and disability coverage
  • 401(k) with employer match
  • Paid time off and holidays
  • Wellness incentives and employee assistance programs
  • Licensure reimbursement for additional state credentials, where applicable

Key Responsibilities

  • Facilitate group therapy sessions within an Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP), managing a caseload of patients across multiple weekly groups.
  • Provide individual therapy to support each patient's progress through treatment.
  • Lead family engagement sessions to build support systems and strengthen continuity of care.
  • Complete comprehensive biopsychosocial assessments to guide level-of-care decisions and treatment planning.
  • Develop and complete master treatment plans, continuously updating individualized, measurable goals in collaboration with patients and the care team.
  • Apply sound clinical judgment in crisis situations — risk assessment, de-escalation, and suicide risk evaluation — within an outpatient setting.
  • Maintain consistent communication with referral sources and families to support progress and continuity of care.
  • Coordinate step-down and discharge planning, connecting patients with resources for legal, financial, and vocational needs.
  • Follow and provide consistent clinical care throughout the full patient enrollment in the program, from intake through discharge.
  • Maintain thorough, timely clinical documentation across all phases of care — this role involves a significant documentation load.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Active, unrestricted clinical license — LPC, LCSW, or LMFT strongly preferred (or applicable state equivalent). Associate/Intern-level, pre-licensed credentials accepted for Professional Counseling, Social Work, and Marriage & Family Therapy tracks.
  • Licensure in the state of California required at time of hire.
  • Master's degree in social work, counseling, marriage & family therapy, or a related human services field.

Strongly Preferred:

  • Active clinical licensure in 3 or more states.
  • Willingness to obtain licensure in additional states as business needs arise.
  • 2+ years of clinical experience serving SUD and/or MH populations.

Preferred:

  • Direct experience at an IOP level of care.
  • Experience with Kipu EMR systems.
  • Experience carrying a full caseload virtually.

Competencies

  • Working knowledge of clinical standards of care for patients with substance use and co-occurring mental health disorders.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build rapport and trust with diverse patient populations.
  • Sound clinical judgment and crisis intervention skills, including risk assessment and de-escalation.
  • Strong documentation and communication skills, with high attention to regulatory and confidentiality standards.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote setting while staying closely connected to a collaborative care team.

Apply Now

If you're a skilled clinician who's passionate about making a lasting difference and ready to grow with a mission-driven team, apply today and help us transform lives at Banyan Treatment Centers.

Banyan Treatment Centers is an equal opportunity employer.

ABOUT ALIAS INTELLIGENCE

Alias Intelligence is an investigative and due diligence firm that helps organizations make informed decisions about the people and entities they do business with. Our work supports investment, transactional, and risk decisions across industries and jurisdictions worldwide. We combine rigorous research with sharp, decision-ready reporting, and we're looking for investigative minds around the world who want to do meaningful work with a collaborative, fully remote team.

TECHNOLOGY-DRIVEN INVESTIGATIONS

Alias Intelligence is a technology-forward investigative firm that combines experienced analysts with modern research tools, automation, and artificial intelligence. Investigations are completed within our proprietary case management and research platform, which centralizes case workflows, reporting, quality review, communication, and investigative resources in a single environment. Our platform incorporates AI-assisted tools that help streamline data organization, document review, workflow management, and quality assurance, allowing analysts to spend more time focusing on investigative analysis and less time on administrative tasks. While technology enhances efficiency and helps surface relevant information, successful investigations still depend on analyst judgment, critical thinking, source verification, and attention to detail. We believe the strongest due diligence outcomes come from experienced investigators empowered by exceptional technology.

About the role

  • This is an independent contractor opportunity, open to qualified candidates globally. Approved analysts join the Alias analyst marketplace, where they can view and accept assignments that match their expertise, language skills, and availability. Compensation is paid on a per-assignment basis. As a due diligence firm, we hold ourselves to the same standards we deliver. Approved analysts are subject to background verification before joining the marketplace.

What you'll do

  • Researching subjects in public records databases, court systems, corporate registries, and open-source resources across multiple jurisdictions
  • Identifying risk indicators, discrepancies, patterns, and investigative leads
  • Meeting quality standards and turnaround times on each assignment
  • Communicating with the Alias team over chat, video, and shared documents

Qualifications

  • Prior experience in due diligence, enhanced due diligence (EDD), AML/KYC investigations, or corporate intelligence
  • Excellent written communication skills
  • Strong analytical skills and sound investigative judgment
  • Hands-on experience with public records and open source research
  • Ability to handle several assignments at once in a deadline-driven environment while staying accurate
  • Comfort working remotely and collaborating virtually
  • Strong attention to detail, critical thinking, and investigative curiosity

  • Bachelor's degree (Criminal Justice, International Relations, Political Science, Journalism, Business, or a related field preferred)

This role is offered on a six-month temporary contract to provide maternity cover. There may be an opportunity to extend the contract should the period of maternity leave be extended.

ABOUT US

The Building Engineering Services Association is the UK's leading trade organisation for building engineering services contractors – representing the interests of firms active in the design, installation, commissioning, maintenance, control and management of engineering systems and services in buildings.

The Legal & Commercial Department is one of BESA’s key service departments and is a highly valued and visible benefit of membership - it is held in high regard and is noted for its professionalism. The team provides advice to members and represents members’ interests to a broad range of stakeholders in the HVAC industry. The team also delivers internal advice across the BESA corporate group and together with supporting the BESA governance regime.

Key activities of the department are to:

  • Advise members on a wide range of legal, commercial, corporate and contractual matters

  • Prepare and deliver in innovative ways, general guidance to members on a wide range of legal, commercial and contractual issues

  • Represent members’ interests to improve the commercial environment in which they operate

  • Advise on and enable management of legal matters to assist other internal service departments or group subsidiaries manage their legal risk profile.

We welcome applications from both full-time and part-time candidates. Full-time hours are 35 per week, while part-time applicants must be available to work a minimum of 21 hours per week across three days. This role can be undertaken on a hybrid basis from our Penrith or London office, or remotely.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Key Duties

  • Undertake, research and provide practical commercial and legal advice to BESA members so that they can make informed commercial judgements about the risks involved in their contracting activities and resolve disputes without the need for formal court proceedings

  • Represent the needs and interests of BESA members to external stakeholders

  • Provide other departments and parts of the BESA Group with commercial advice, guidance and assistance

  • Attend and make presentations at national and regional meetings including lecturing or making presentations on commercial, legal or contractual issues

  • Prepare agendas, minutes and supporting documents for, and attending, BESA committees formed of BESA member representatives

  • Undertake project work of a legal or commercial nature for the BESA Group

  • Manage multiple tasks and projects with competing priorities, both internal and member priorities

  • Where required, assisting in responding to external consultations on matters that affect members.

ABOUT YOU

Qualification, Experience & Knowledge

Essential

  • Legal professional with a minimum of 1-year post-qualification experience.

  • Experience of advising on standard and non-standard construction contracts

  • Sound knowledge of the UK construction industry

  • Familiarity with the legislative framework that affects construction contracts

  • Understanding of commercial contracts

Desirable

  • Mixed contentious and non-contentious experience

  • Awareness and practical ability to manage corporate group issues

General Skills & Abilities – Essential

  • Ability to think commercially and problem solve solutions outside of the black letter law

  • Proficient in legal research skills

  • Professional written and oral communications skills

  • Proficient IT skills – familiarity with the use of Microsoft Office

  • Ability to communicate effectively with industry participants such as BESA members

  • Personable and able to work well within a small dynamic professional team and across a wider corporate group

  • Self-motivated, able to multi-task and manage competing priorities

Personal Attributes

  • Willing and flexible attitude and readiness to take on new challenges

  • Commercially aware

  • Enthusiastic, ready to make decisions, take the initiative, and originate action

  • A desire to exceed internal & external stakeholder needs

Behaviours At BESA, we expect all colleagues to demonstrate behaviours that support our culture and values:

  • Customer Empathy– We anticipate and address customer challenges to foster connection and meaningful experiences with them

  • Accountability – We keep our word and deliver the results we promise, holding others to account to do the same. We actively manage potential consequences and take ownership to address them.

  • Continuous Improvement– We are deeply curious to understand how things work for our customers, industry and organisation. We challenge the status quo and look to enhance and evolve everything we do.

  • Agility– We respond and adapt swiftly to changing circumstances.

  • Commerciality – We make informed decisions that enable profitable and/or sustainable growth.

  • Care – We create an environment where people feel valued and heard, providing a sense of belonging.

Interviews will be arranged directly with shortlisted candidates

If you're enthusiastic about this role but your experience doesn't match every requirement perfectly, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be exactly the candidate we're looking for!

raw.description:
Podpora obchodní linky - možnost 100% práce z domova

Hledáte flexibilní přivýdělek, který můžete vykonávat z pohodlí domova? Baví Vás komunikace s lidmi a zvládáte práci na počítači? Do našeho týmu hledáme kolegu nebo kolegyni, který/á nám pomůže se zpracováním poptávek zájemců o bydlení.

Co Vás na pozici čeká?

  • telefonická a e-mailová komunikace se zájemci o pronájem bydlení u společnosti Heimstaden
  • kontaktování klientů, kteří nám sami zaslali poptávku po bydlení – nejedná se o aktivní prodej ani nabízení produktů či služeb
  • ověření aktuálního zájmu o pronájem
  • zjištění základních informací a ověření bonity zájemce
  • zpracování získaných informací a předání poptávky makléři

Co od Vás očekáváme?

  • dobrou uživatelskou znalost práce na PC (MS Office)
  • příjemné a profesionální vystupování
  • dobré komunikační schopnosti a srozumitelný mluvený projev
  • spolehlivost a samostatnost
  • zájem o dlouhodobou spolupráci
  • znalost angličtiny nebo ukrajinštiny je výhodou

Co Vám můžeme nabídnout?

  • spolupráci na DPP nebo DPČ
  • možnost pracovat 100% z domova - po zaučení
  • flexibilní plánování práce podle Vašich časových možností
  • provozní dobu oddělení pondělí–pátek 8:00–16:00 a neděle 8:00–16:00
  • zázemí stabilní společnosti Heimstaden
  • dlouhodobou spolupráci

Pokud rádi komunikujete s lidmi, hledáte flexibilní práci a vyhovuje Vám možnost pracovat z domova, budeme rádi, když se nám ozvete.

Ve společnosti Heimstaden si vážíme rozmanitosti a věříme, že různé pohledy vedou k lepším rozhodnutím a silnějšímu pracovnímu prostředí.

Heimstaden BOSTAD je jedním z lídrů v oblasti rezidenčního bydlení v Evropě. Spravujeme více než 156 tisíc bytů v devíti zemích a hodnota našeho portfolia přesahuje 718 miliard českých korun. Naše zaměření je jasné – investujeme do nemovitostí s dlouhodobou vizí a vytváříme prostředí, kde se lidé cítí opravdu doma. Každý den se o to stará více než 1 800 našich kolegů, kteří svým úsilím přispívají k naplnění konceptu Přátelských domovů. Vycházíme z našich základních hodnot – DARE (Odvaha), CARE (Péče) a SHARE (Otevřenost), které nás provázejí ve všem, co děláme. Věříme, že různorodost nás činí silnějšími. Naše budovy poskytují domov lidem z celého světa a stejné principy uplatňujeme i uvnitř společnosti. Při náboru nám záleží jen na vašich dovednostech a zkušenostech – žádné jiné informace nejsou pro nás podstatné. Pokud hledáte místo, kde se můžete rozvíjet a být součástí něčeho většího, rádi vás přivítáme v týmu Heimstaden!

raw.description:
¿Qué es?

Es un profesional especializado en el diseño, desarrollo y liberación de arneses eléctricos (conjuntos de cables, conectores y componentes) para sistemas de bajo voltaje (LV) y alto voltaje (HV) en aplicaciones industriales, especialmente en la industria automotriz. Su trabajo garantiza que los sistemas eléctricos sean seguros, eficientes y compatibles con los requisitos de manufactura y calidad.

¿Cómo lo hace?

Utiliza herramientas como Siemens Capital Essentials y CATIA para crear dibujos de manufactura 2D, listas de cables, definiciones de conectores y librerías de componentes.

Colabora con proveedores, fabricantes de contratos (CM) y equipos multifuncionales para asegurar que los diseños cumplan con estándares como IPC/WHMA-A-620, ISO 26262 y USCAR-21/USCAR-2.

Resuelve problemas técnicos durante la instalación, debugging y validación de arneses, asegurando que los sistemas funcionen correctamente en entornos reales.

Participa en procesos de APQP, PPAP y gestión de ECRs para garantizar la calidad y trazabilidad de los diseños.

¿Por qué es importante?

El trabajo del Ingeniero de Arneses Eléctricos es crítico para la electrificación de vehículos y sistemas industriales, ya que:

Asegura la integración técnica entre componentes eléctricos y mecánicos.

Minimiza riesgos de fallos eléctricos en producción masiva.

Optimiza la manufacturabilidad y reduce costos en proyectos de alta complejidad.

Es clave en industrias como automotriz, aeroespacial, energía y robótica, donde la confiabilidad de los sistemas eléctricos es esencial.

Requirements

Experiencia: Mínimo 5 años en diseño de arneses eléctricos (LV/HV), creación de dibujos de manufactura 2D, listas de cables, definiciones de conectores y librerías de componentes en Siemens Capital Essentials.

Herramientas: Dominio de CATIA V5/V6 (rutado 3D) y Siemens Capital Essentials (dibujos 2D, librerías de componentes, símbolos).

Conocimientos técnicos:

Interpretación de esquemas eléctricos lógicos y físicos.

Protocolos de comunicación CAN, LIN, SAE J1939.

Restricciones físicas: protección térmica, durabilidad a vibración, selección de materiales (plásticos, calibres de cobre).

Rutado de cables en interfaces dinámicas (cadenas portacables, radios de curvatura, alivio de tensión, separación LV/HV).

Procesos de calidad: APQP, PPAP, ECRs.

Gestión: Seguimiento de BOM, manejo de proveedores y experiencia en industrialización.

Join us in transitioning away from combustion generators to a cleaner alternative for fast, measurable, and real outcomes. What we’ve achieved so far is just the beginnig 🚀

As our Business Development Manager, you win new business across the UK. Rail is one of our biggest opportunities for the year ahead and will take a large share of your time. You are free to sell wherever the best opportunities are, including construction and defence, and you own the sales cycle from first conversation to closed deal.

This is a fully remote role with plenty of time on the road, visiting customers across the UK.

Become part of our success story by...

  • Driving new business: Identify, target and secure new opportunities across the UK, with a strong focus on rail

  • Closing high-value deals: Negotiate and win six-figure orders with key decision-makers and influencers

  • A proven record of winning new business and exceeding targets, including negotiating and closing six-figure deals

raw.title: Sr. Project Manager
raw.excerpt: Who is American College of Education Founded in 2005, American College of Education continues to be a leader in professional development through our online programs.
raw.description:
Who is American College of Education

Founded in 2005, American College of Education continues to be a leader in professional development through our online programs. The mission of ACE is to deliver high-quality, affordable, and accessible online programs grounded in evidence-based content, real-world experience and relevant application that places our students’ needs first.

ACE is a mission-driven institution continually recognized for its commitment to social responsibility and positive impact. As an Impact Institution, we believe we have a responsibility to our students, alumni, employees, communities, and society as a whole. Guided by our core values, we strive to create meaningful impact that extends well beyond our bottom line.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please note that all official communication will only come from our verified company email domain @Rippling.com

Who You Are

You are a strategic delivery leader who can influence outcomes across the organization and align complex

initiatives to enterprise priorities. You bring a strong balance of execution, excellence, and strategic thinking,

ensuring delivery drives measurable business impact. You are enthusiastic about helping students achieve

their educational goals. You are comfortable operating in both structured and agile environments, applying

the right approach to achieving results. You thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and are

effective at leading cross-functional teams toward shared goals. You communicate clearly and confidently

with stakeholders at all levels, including executive leadership, and bring a strong attention to detail in

managing complex delivery efforts. You are adaptable, pragmatic, and capable of driving accountability while

fostering team effectiveness. You are comfortable working remotely and have experience collaborating with

others in a virtual environment. You possess a strong attention to detail.

As the Senior Project Manager, you are responsible for leading the end-to-end delivery of

cross-functional initiatives through a combination of strong project management discipline and agile

practices. You ensure successful outcomes by integrating people, process, and technology—while also serving

as a Scrum Master where needed to support team execution, remove blockers, and drive continuous

improvement.

Compensation

ACE is committed to paying a competitive wage while staying true to our mission of maintaining high quality,

affordable programs for our students. The starting salary range for this position is $120,000 plus all full-time

employees are eligible for an annual bonus. Offers vary depending on education, prior experience, and

expertise being applied to the role.

What We Look for in the Ideal Candidate

  • Operates with a high degree of autonomy and accountability across complex initiatives
  • Proven ability to influence prioritization and trade-off decisions at the leadership level
  • Strong ability to manage and resolve conflict across cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Experience driving alignment across competing business priorities.
  • Ability to translate strategic goals into executable delivery plans.
  • Demonstrated success improving delivery performance through metrics and process optimization.
  • Experience driving organizational change and Agile transformation.
  • Proven ability to align delivery to business strategy and measurable outcomes.
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to communicate at senior leadership levels.
  • Ability to operate in ambiguous environments and define structure where none exists.
  • Ability to lead delivery in high-pressure environments with competing priorities.
  • Drives collaboration and alignment across cross-functional teams and leadership stakeholders.
  • Demonstrates self-reliance by meeting/exceeding workflow needs. 
  • Demonstrates positive attitude and motivation, concern for students, teamwork, and excellent time management skills. 
  • Follows established processes as outlined by organization and leadership. 
  • Completes assigned duties based on daily business needs and individual skill set. 
  • Consistently produces a high volume of quality work. 
  • Capable, adapts as needed, to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines. 
  • Proven ability to work independently with limited supervision and with other department personnel. 
  • Must support and embrace the College’s Impact mission to improve the people and communities we serve through our civic engagement initiatives.  
  • Must have exceptional communication, organization, and time management skills. 
  • Must be "self-motivated" as well as creative and efficient in proposing solutions to complex, time critical problems. 
  • Must be collaborative in driving decisions and a team-player. 
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a high attention to detail. 
  • Builds and maintains student satisfaction. 
  • Recognizes and anticipates student needs. 

Day to Day Responsibilities

In this role you will wear different hats, but your skills will be especially essential in the following areas:

  • Leads the strategic application and evolution of Agile (Scrum and scaled frameworks) across multiple teams to align delivery with business objectives and measurable outcomes.
  • Leads and coordinates multiple Agile teams and large, complex cross-functional initiatives, ensuring alignment across product, engineering, and business stakeholders.
  • Defines and enforces project and initiative-level delivery governance, quality standards, and delivery best practices to improve predictability, scalability, and delivery performance.
  • Drives proactive risk, dependency, and scope management across large projects and strategic
  • initiatives, escalating and influencing executive stakeholders to resolve competing priorities and ensure delivery success.
  • Establishes and drives data-driven delivery metrics (velocity, predictability, throughput, outcome based KPIs) to continuously improve team and project delivery performance.
  • Leads cross-functional teams and influences stakeholders across all levels of the organization, while maintaining accurate project documentation.
  • Leads executive-level communication, translating complex delivery insights into clear, actionable updates for senior leadership and stakeholders.
  • Manages project financials, including forecasting, budget tracking, cost management, and ensuring alignment to business outcomes.
  • Ensures successful delivery and value realization by aligning outcomes to defined business objectives and driving post-implementation reviews and continuous improvement.
  • Champions and supports Agile maturity initiatives, continuously improving team effectiveness, delivery practices, and adoption of Agile principles.
  • Mentors Scrum Masters, less-experienced Project Managers, and team members, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and leadership development.
  • Owns delivery decision-making across assigned projects and initiatives, balancing scope, timeline, cost, and quality to achieve optimal business outcomes.
  • Aligns project objectives and delivery plans with organizational priorities while managing competing delivery demands.
  • Builds strong relationships with executive stakeholders, influencing priorities, resolving conflicts, and driving alignment across initiatives and delivery objectives.
  • Proactively seeks and confronts risk and issues openly and quickly, while effectively communicating relevant project/practice information to IT management as needed.
  • Determines new, creative ways to employ teams on projects, distribute responsibilities, share lessons learned, and implement industry best practices.
  • Identifies opportunities for internal improvement and leads the development and execution of improvement plans.
  • Accountable for end-to-end delivery and realization of measurable business outcomes, including improvements in operational efficiency, student experience, and system performance.
  • Leads change management activities associated with assigned projects and initiatives, ensuring successful adoption of new processes, tools, and capabilities.
  • Partners closely with Product Management and Product Owners to ensure alignment between business priorities, roadmap execution, and delivery capacity.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Qualifications and Education Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or combination of relevant education and experience.
  • PMP or CSM Certifications or relevant experience.
  • 5+ years serving in a Scrum Master or Agile leadership capacity across multiple teams.
  • 6-8 years of experience in Project Management or related fields.
  • Demonstrated success leading large initiatives through influence in matrixed organizations without direct authority.
  • Experience leading large, complex, enterprise-scale projects and strategic initiatives involving multiple cross-functional teams.
  • Proven ability to lead multiple teams and programs within a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
  • Experience presenting to and influencing executive leadership.
  • Experience with multiple project management techniques, including agile process with SCRUM implementation frameworks.
  • Thorough understanding of IT service offerings, technical preferences, and technical direction.
  • Deep expertise in Agile tooling (e.g., Azure DevOps) to enable scalable delivery practices, reporting, and workflow optimization.
  • Experience managing delivery across highly integrated enterprise ecosystems, including CRM, SIS, and marketing automation platforms.
  • Ability to Coach and “lead by example” the breakdown of business needs into EPIC, Features and User Stories.
  • Proven ability to drive decision-making and accountability across multiple stakeholders in ambiguous and evolving environments.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with audience in perspective.
  • Thorough knowledge and understanding of business principles, processes, and technology.
  • Strong knowledge of Teams, Word, Excel, OneNote, Visio, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
  • Excellent collaborator able to work with virtual and global cross functional teams.
  • Experience with systems and business processes to support new product introductions.
  • Knowledge of multiple existing Scrum Agile frameworks and project management methodology.
  • Strong analytical, budgetary, and critical thinking skills.
  • Proven ability to lead multiple teams and complex cross-functional initiatives within a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
  • Experience establishing delivery governance, managing project risks and dependencies, and driving
  • successful outcomes for large, complex initiatives.
  • Experience with a PPM solution.
  • Have expert knowledge and ability to identify opportunities for change and the ability to convey the
  • need for change to IT management.
  • Experience in high growth small-midsize companies, preferably in Higher Education, strongly preferred.

Our Commitment to Employees

Just as we strive to empower our students for success, we also aim to enrich the lives of our employees. For 6

consecutive years, ACE was recognized as one of Indiana’s Best Places to Work, winning the #1 spot for

medium-sized companies in 2020. In addition, ACE has earned national recognition since 2022 for being a

USA Today Top Workplace. As a virtual first organization, we celebrate diversity and are committed to

creating a family-like inclusive work environment. For our full-time employees, we offer the following

benefits:

  • Medical, dental, & vision Insurance
  • HSA and FSA options
  • Paid parental leave
  • Paid volunteer time
  • Tuition reimbursement & reduction programs
  • Generous PTO
  • 401k and employer match
  • Full-service wellness and EAP program
  • Employee recognition and awards programs
  • Employer paid life & AD&D insurance
  • Short-term disability
  • Employer paid long-term disability
  • And more…

Physical Demands

The physical demand described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to

successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee

is regularly required to communicate with and receive communications from students and ACE employees in

real time using online and other electronic media.

Commitment to Culture

At American College of Education, we’re all about building a one-of-a-kind, supportive community where

everyone—students, faculty, and staff—can thrive. Guided by our mission and values, we focus on everything

from innovative curriculum design to personalized instruction and student support to intentional planning,

inclusive initiatives, and strategic resource allocation. We’re dedicated to creating an environment that

celebrates freedom of expression, diversity of thought, open dialogue, and mutual respect. We believe in

fostering a sense of belonging and wellness so that every member of our ACE family feels empowered,

valued, and ready to reach their full potential. Together, we’re creating a vibrant, resilient, and connected

learning community where everyone matters.

Additional Notes

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or

responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may

change at any time with or without notice.

Employees are increasingly integrating AI into their roles, demonstrating its potential to boost efficiency,

accuracy, and productivity. By utilizing AI technologies, we can streamline processes, gain valuable insights

from data, and automate routine tasks, which allows employees to concentrate on more strategic and

creative aspects of their work. While AI is a beneficial tool in the workplace, if its use—such as ChatGPT,

Grammarly, Copy.ai, etc.—accounts for more than 50% of any work assignments or job responsibilities, it will

need to be reported to a direct leader.

Internet bandwidth speeds from an employee's remote work location must be a minimum of 50Mbps

download speeds and 5Mbps upload speeds. Please note if the bandwidth is shared across multiple devices

(tablets, computer, streaming, phone, etc.) you will need higher overall speeds. You can test the speed of

your connection by visiting speedtest.net Purchase, setup, installation, support, and ongoing maintenance of

reliable internet service is the responsibility of the individual.

American College of Education seeks to attract and retain a diverse staff consistent with its diverse student

body and surrounding communities. At this time we cannot consider candidates residing in Alaska,

Washington D.C., Massachusetts, South Dakota, or Alabama.

ACE is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
