raw.description:
Um dos maiores grupos de beleza do mundo, o Grupo Boticário é uma empresa brasileira presente em mais de 40 países. É dono das marcas O Boticário, Eudora, Quem Disse, Berenice?, Vult, O.U.i, Dr. JONES, TRUSS, e do marketplace Beleza na Web, além de atuar com produtos licenciados como Australian Gold, Bio Oil, Nuxe, e Pampers e sua divisão para o mercado B2B. Essa interação entre diferentes marcas, ativos, plataformas, rede de franqueados, representantes, distribuidores, varejistas, sellers e fornecedores formam o ecossistema de beleza do Grupo Boticário que oferece, ainda, soluções digitais de gestão de negócio para o varejo brasileiro por meio das suas marcas Mooz e GAVB. São mais de 19 mil colaboradores diretos, com mais de 4 mil lojas em 1.780 cidades brasileiras.

Vem fazer beleza com a gente!

O que é a Gerência de Martech ?

A gerência de Martech está inserida na diretoria de experiência e atende a área de tecnologia para times de negócio voltados ao marketing. O time possui cinco áreas de atuação: Automation (criação de plataformas), CDP e Dados (integrações), CRM (plataformas para o time de CRM), Solutions (engenharia para conteúdo, branding, mídias e social listening), e Analytics (mensuração de comportamento e engajamento).

Buscamos umaPessoa Arquiteta de Soluções (Martech) - Especialista IIIpara atuar como a principal referência técnica (Staff Engineer) para os times de engenharia de Automation e CVM Growth. Neste desafio, você será o responsável técnico por direcionar a melhor decisão de arquitetura, stack de ferramentas, integração entre ecossistemas e construção de novas soluções, além de garantir a saúde operacional de engenharia (especialmente governança e otimização de custos de Cloud / FinOps).

Como será seu dia a dia?

- Ser o responsável técnico por apoiar e direcionar a melhor solução na construção de novas ferramentas, produtos e integrações da área.

- Avaliar a viabilidade e necessidade de construção interna (desenvolvimento in-house) de ferramentas que hoje utilizamos de mercado, considerando as necessidades do negócio, complexidade de customizações e eficiência de custos.

- Apoiar nas decisões de melhor arquitetura e integração entre as diferentes stacks (CDPs, CRM, Automação, APIs).

- Apoiar tecnicamente as gerências de CDP & Automation, CRM, Solutions e CVM Tech no direcionamento estratégico do ecossistema de ferramentas.

- Cuidar da saúde operacional de engenharia (monitoramento, resiliência, débitos técnicos e governança/otimização de custos Cloud - AWS/GCP).

- Atuar como mentor técnico e referência para os times de engenharia (Automation e CVM Growth).

O que você precisa ter ou saber?

- Trajetória: Profissional com vivência sólida como Especialista / Liderança Técnica / Staff Engineer em ambientes de tecnologia de grande porte.

- Visão de Arquitetura & "Build vs. Buy": Capacidade analítica e técnica para avaliar a substituição de ferramentas de mercado por soluções proprietárias altamente customizadas.

- Tech Stack: Sólida experiência em arquitetura Cloud (AWS/GCP), , Python (Django), APIs/Apigee, Filas/Mensageria (SQS/Kafka) e Bancos de Dados (SQL/NoSQL).

- FinOps: Experiência/visão de gestão e eficiência de custos de infraestrutura em nuvem.

- Soft Skills de Executivo Técnico: Inteligência emocional avançada, forte habilidade de comunicação para atuar com alta liderança (Diretoria/VP) e negociação e influência com stakeholders não técnicos e parceiros externos.

- Orientação a Negócios: Capacidade clara de traduzir a infraestrutura técnica em impactos de negócio direto, orientando a tecnologia para os KRs da empresa.

Informações adicionais

Benefícios que cuidam e se diferenciam:

No Grupo Boticário, o cuidado é a nossa base para atingirmos resultados exponenciais. Temos um portfólio com mais de 20 benefícios para cuidar da sua saúde, bem estar e família. Confira abaixo.

Saúde:

  • Plano médico e odontológico flexíveis
  • Auxílio medicamentos e vale saúde para familiares
  • Sessões de psicoterapia gratuitas e telemedicina 24h
  • Programas contínuos de prevenção, cuidado mental e vacinação

Alimentação & bem-estar

raw.description:
About the Role:

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Clinical Pharmacist with a PharmD degree and experience in HEDIS medication adherence initiatives. The ideal candidate will play a crucial role in improving medication adherence rates among patients, ensuring compliance with HEDIS/Medicare quality measures, and driving overall health outcomes.

Key Responsibilities:

HEDIS Quality Measures:

  • Lead efforts to improve HEDIS medication adherence and other pharmacy quality measures, including but not limited to adherence to antihypertensive, cholesterol-lowering, and diabetes medications.
  • Analyze medication adherence data, identify gaps in care, and implement targeted interventions to improve adherence rates.
  • Collaborate with healthcare providers, care managers, and other stakeholders to develop and implement strategies that promote adherence to prescribed therapies.

Patient Engagement:

  • Conduct medication therapy management (MTM) sessions to address barriers to adherence, provide patient education, and ensure understanding of medication regimens.
  • Work directly with patients to identify and resolve issues related to medication adherence, including cost, side effects, and complex dosing schedules.
  • Utilize motivational interviewing techniques to encourage patients to adhere to their prescribed medication regimens.

Data Analysis & Reporting:

  • Monitor and track HEDIS performance metrics, generating reports to assess the effectiveness of interventions and programs.
  • Use electronic health records (EHR) and pharmacy data to identify patients at risk of non-adherence and develop action plans.
  • Provide regular updates to leadership on progress towards HEDIS goals and make recommendations for improvement.

Collaboration & Training:

  • Serve as a medication adherence subject matter expert (SME) within the organization.
  • Provide training and support to other pharmacists, care managers, and clinical staff on best practices in medication adherence.
  • Participate in cross-functional teams focused on quality improvement, population health management, and value-based care initiatives.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED TO HAVE

  • Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD) degree from an accredited school of pharmacy.
  • Active pharmacist license, willing to obtain licenses in TX, TN, AL and PA (company paid)
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in HEDIS-related medication adherence work, quality improvement, or population health.
  • Strong knowledge of HEDIS measures, particularly those related to medication adherence.
  • Proficiency in using EHR systems and data analysis tools.
  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work independently as well as in a team-oriented environment.
  • Experience with motivational interviewing or other patient engagement techniques is a plus.

WOULD LOVE FOR YOU HAVE

  • Experience in a managed care setting, pharmacy benefits management (PBM), or a healthcare quality improvement role.
  • Certification in Medication Therapy Management (MTM), Certified Geriatric Pharmacist (CGP), or other relevant credentials.
  • Understanding of value-based care models and their impact on medication adherence.

The salary range for this role is between $120,000.00 to $130,000.00 per year.

Interviewer

Job Industry: Charity / Social Services / Non- Profit Organization

Position Name: Volunteer Interviewer for Dog Rescue - Volunteer (Unpaid)

Job Location: Spokane, Washington, United States

Job Type: Part Time

Office Setting: Fully Remote

Remote: Yes

Compensation: Volunteer

Hours Per Week: 5 (flexible)

Role Mission

Path of Hope relies on volunteers heavily to achieve our mission. Due to the nature of volunteering, we have a high turnover of candidates. Your role is to support the continuous flow of qualified volunteers to fill open roles in the Rescue. You will interview candidates and assess whether they can integrate into the Rescue and effectively complete the role and duties as assigned.

What Winning Looks Like

Key Results Area #1 - Roles

  • Familiar with organization structure of the Rescue

  • Familiar with job descriptions and seeks to understand the purpose of each role in order to offer alternative roles, when it's determined that skills would be better suited to a different role

Key Results Area #2 - Self Motivated Work Ethic

  • Keep and update your personal schedule

  • Adherence to interview schedules with minimal rescheduling

  • Daily check ins with remote platform and leader

Key Results Area #2 - Interview Process

  • Conduct 30-minute phone interviews effectively, ensuring all key questions are covered while maintaining a professional and engaging experience for candidates.

  • Assess the suitability of candidates for specific volunteer roles based on their skills, availability, and alignment with the Rescue's Core Values and the role's Key Results Areas

  • Detailed interview notes and recommendations for each candidate.

  • Timely follow-up with team leads for role placement within 24 hours of the interview.

Needed Skills

  • Must love dogs and people. We can't save dogs without talented people.

  • Active listening with conversational style. Ability to listen for context clues on what type of role would be a good fit.

  • Self motivated without needing a leader to keep you on task

  • Manage your schedule and keep up to date. Daily check ins via remote chat

Unique Company Culture and Mission

Our Mission

At Path of Hope Rescue we save pregnant dogs and puppies from high kill shelters in the Southern United States.

Our Spokane, Washington based Rescue strives to decrease the euthanasia rate of high risk dogs in the southern United States by transporting pregnant dogs and puppies to the Pacific Northwest to find adoptive homes. We do not have a kennel or building location and are 100% foster based. We currently have two paid employees and rely heavily on volunteers and fosters as we work to build out our paid staff roles.

Our Vision.
Eliminating euthanasia of dogs in the South by decreasing the amount of dogs breeding unchecked and becoming the number one 'dog destination' in Spokane by capitalizing on Spokane's love of Rescue Dogs.

Core Values:

Transparency - sharing the good with the bad

Our Company Culture

We are freedom loving American Patriots who love dogs, love freedom and love Jesus.

No NGO status here, we don't take a single penny from the government. We are 100% funded by small donors and our adoption program, with a few small private grants here and there. We built this organization from the ground up in 2018 with $87.

We are built tough and believe that hard work pays off. We're about rolling up our sleeves and taking responsibility for our own actions. We don't do drama. There are no victims here and the system isn't out to get you, the only thing standing in your way is you and your attitude. We reward merit, not DEI or pronouns. We don't bend to the cultural rot out there.

At the core of who we are, we love dogs. At PHR you will find people who recognize your dog before they recognize you. Where it's normal for your dog to have his own Instagram and people who expect to be invited to your dog's birthday party. We are focused on building a strong, positive community, one dog and one person at a time.

We know dogs are family and should be treated that way. And we are driven by a shared passion to make sure every dog who isn't being loved, finds their way to a family. We care for each other and have created a community of people who love making a difference in this world.
